column1: Professor, please calm down. We need to approach this with caution, not excitement.
column2: 教授，请冷静。我们需要谨慎对待这件事，而不是兴奋。

column1: 'Don't want to risk anything here?' I think they forget that we're putting our necks on the line. I suppose if the pay is good that's what we do.
column2: “不想在这儿冒任何风险?”我想他们是忘了，把脑袋别在裤腰带上的是我们. 不过话说回来，只要报酬够高，这本来就是我们的活儿.

column1: 'Killbox'? Haven't heard that name for a long time. Do you think she's still upset after all these years?
column2: “杀戮箱”? 好久没听过这个名字了. 你觉得过了这么多年，她还在生气吗?

column1: 'No atomic weapons' is one of the few rules of warfare we've all agreed on. Let's take these guys out, Commander.
column2: “无原子武器”是为数不多我们都同意的战争法则之一. 指挥官，让我们除掉这些家伙.

column2: “一支主要部队”意味着战场上会有大量金属装甲. 做好持久战的准备，指挥官. 或许可以考虑换上激光武器而不是自动炮.

column1: A 'prelude' sounds like more work ahead for us, so let's get this done, Commander.
column2: “序幕”这词听起来我们还有更多的工作要做，所以让我们完成它吧，指挥官.

column1: A chance to dish out some pain back to the enemy, always my favorite.
column2: 有机会把痛苦还给敌人，永远是我最喜欢的。

column1: A consortium of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturers has been losing ground to a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} competitor every fiscal quarter for years. It's time to turn the tables with one well-timed strike at the primary {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing plant here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system.
column2: 多年来，一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}制造商财团一直在每个财务季度都输给了一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}竞争对手. 现在是时候对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的主要{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施来场精准打击，以此扭转局面了.

column1: A convoy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} doctors ministering to those recovering from the recent conflicts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have become caught behind enemy lines when the cease fire collapsed. A lance of mechs tasked with the rescue have gone missing, so we are desperate for assistance from anyone.
column2: 在停火协议破裂后，一支由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}医护人员组成的车队被困在敌后，他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上为最近冲突中受伤的人提供医疗援助. 一队负责救援的机甲已经失踪了，因此我们迫切需要任何人的援助.

column1: A family associated with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been threatening military action against their {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} neighbors on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Neither of us has any legal claim in this system, but as our allied nobles have requested help and protection, we're willing to intervene. We need a deniable force to step in and destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} threat.
column2: 一个与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}有关的家族一直威胁要对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}邻居采取军事行动. 我们双方在这个星系都没有合法的权利，可既然我们的贵族盟友寻求帮助和保护，我们就要予以干预. 我们需要一支可以撇清关系的军队介入并消除来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的威胁.

column1: A few hours ago, some enterprising lads from our organization planetside were able to seize control of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They maybe hadn't thought their entire plan through, so right now there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force on the way to level the base before our boys can download any valuable data. We need you to cover them while they finish up and escape.
column2: 几个小时前，我们组织里一些在星球另一边的激进小伙子成功夺取了一座属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究设施. 他们可能没想到整个计划的后果，所以现在有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的打击部队正赶来，准备在我们的队员下载任何有价值数据之前摧毁基地. 我们需要你掩护他们完成下载任务并安全撤离.

column1: A few months ago, we intercepted a number of highly encrypted transmissions originating from the planet, none of which we've been able to decrypt and read. We suspected that the transmissions came from a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} black site, and sent an operative to infiltrate and steal the decryption key. They reported in requesting immediate emergency extraction. We'd like you to recover the key, and the operative if they're still alive.
column2: 数月前，我们截获了大量来自该行星的高度加密传输信号，至今未能破译. 我们怀疑这些信号来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的一座黑狱，并派遣了一名特工潜入窃取解密密钥. 该特工刚刚发出紧急撤离请求. 我们希望你能找到密钥，还有那名特工，如果他还活着的话.

column1: A former {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} commander, backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, has set up his own government. To avoid any unwanted personnel conflicts, and to save our people the stress of fighting their former comrades, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} requires a Merc unit to remove this traitor and keep him from destroying his own people.
column2: 一名前{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥官，在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的支持下，建立了自己的政权. 为了避免不必要的人员冲突，并减轻我方人员与昔日同袍作战的压力，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要一支雇佣兵部队去除掉这个叛徒，防止他继续伤害自己的人民.

column1: A friend of our organization has been accused by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} of illegal activities. While under this accusation, she's unable to perform her duties for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership. Evidence to be used in an upcoming hearing is being transported to a spaceport, for safe-keeping off-planet. Your team is to intercept this convoy and destroy it.
column2: 我们组织的一位朋友被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}指控从事非法活动. 在这种指控下，她无法再为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层履行职责. 即将举行的听证会上使用的证据正被运送到一处太空港，以便安全地离开星球. 你的队伍要去拦截这支车队并且摧毁它.

column1: A heavily armed pirate band has taken control of a facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and are using it as a base of operations for raiding and terrorizing nearby settlements. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities do not have the local military resources to assault the base, given how extensively they've entrenched. We need you to destroy the base so that they can no longer use it as a staging area for their criminal acts.
column2: 一支武装严密的海盗团伙已经控制了{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处设施，并将其用作掠夺和恐吓附近定居点的作战基地. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}当局没有足够的地方军事资源来攻击该基地，鉴于海盗们的防御工事构筑得十分坚固. 我们需要你摧毁这座基地，阻止他们继续将其作为犯罪行动的集结点.

column1: A high tonnage {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance will shortly make planetfall, at the behest of a group of petty nobles and commercial interests. Intel suggests this is the vanguard of a larger force of conventional tanks and infantry, and they're scouting the region for a suitable landing site. We need a competent mercenary company to intercept the 'Mechs and stop the invasion before it gets underway. If their planet-side allies send any support, you are to wipe them out as well.
column2: 一支高吨位的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队在一群小贵族和商业利益集团的指示下，将很快进行行星空降. 情报显示这是一支更大的常规步坦部队的前锋，他们正在侦察这个地区，寻找一个合适的登陆场. 我们需要一个能干的雇佣兵公司拦截这队机甲，在入侵开始前予以阻止. 如果他们在行星侧的盟友送出任何支援，你也要把他们消灭掉.

column1: A hit-and-run operation should be straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: A hit-and-run operation sounds straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
column2: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

column1: A lance of newly manufactured {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 'mechs is being moved overland from manufacturing facilities to a their garrison. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} would like these units destroyed before they enter military service.
column2: 一队新生产的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}机甲正从制造设施经陆路运往驻地. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}希望在这些单位投入使用前将其摧毁.

column1: A lance of our heaviest mechs is in poor repair after a long patrol. We have credible intelligence suggesting that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will attempt to exploit this vulnerability. We have no other significant units available in the area so we need you to drop and run interference while we extract our mechs to a repair facility.
column2: 我们一队重型机甲在执行了长时间巡逻后状况不佳. 我们有可靠情报表明，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}将试图利用这一弱点. 我们在该地区没有其他主力部队可用，因此需要你们空降，在我们把机甲撤往维修设施的过程中进行掩护.

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.
column2: 一小队{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领土上横冲直撞. 他们一直在摧毁人口中心，焚烧农田和炼油厂，洗劫储存设施. 他们显然在想尽一切办法来驱赶我们的人民. 这是纯粹的恐怖主义. 我们需要你找到并消灭他们--一个都不能跑，也不留俘虏.

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲小队一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们烧毁居民点、焚烧农田与炼油厂、劫掠仓储设施。他们显然在尽其所能把我们的人赶走。这是纯粹的恐怖主义。我们需要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不要俘虏。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, no parlay, and no prisoners.
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲分队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们一路焚毁人口中心、烧掉田地和炼油厂、洗劫仓储设施。他们显然在尽一切所能把我们的民众赶走。这是恐怖主义，纯粹而简单。我们要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不许谈判，不留俘虏。

column1: A local mercenary is trying to make it big. He thinks by calling you out he can gain fame and fortune.
column2: 一名本地佣兵想出头。他以为向你叫板就能名利双收。

column1: A long-time enemy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has unexpectedly turned herself into local authorities, and will now be extradited to another system for trial. However, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} does not want to see her testify, and will try to stop her from leaving the planet. We've secured a convoy of armored vehicles to transport the criminal, but we need the extra fire-power of your 'Mechs to guarantee a safe path to the evacuation zone.
column2: 一名与{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}结怨已久的敌人出人意料地向当地当局自首，如今将被引渡至另一个星系受审. 然而，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}并不希望看到她出庭作证，将试图阻止她离开这颗星球. 我们已安排了一支装甲车队押送这名罪犯，但仍需你们机甲的额外火力来确保通往撤离区的道路安全.

column1: A member of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} chain of command in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been troubling us. We need this irksome operative eliminated. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives have located the target's position planetside.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，有个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥链的一名成员一直在给我们制造麻烦. 我们需要清除这个烦人的特工. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报人员已定位到该目标在行星表面的位置.

column1: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral Griffin until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的中层官员决定亲自巡逻这颗行星的一处中等危险地区. 我们尽了最大努力劝阻她，但她坚持要向民众表明，她愿意为他们的利益去冒险. 与其让她驾驶家族传承的“狮鹫”四处乱闯，被某个投机的海盗谋杀，我们宁愿你护送她，确保她的安全.

column1: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral mech until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的中层官员决定亲自巡逻这颗行星的一处中等危险地区. 我们尽了最大努力劝阻她，但她坚持要向民众表明，她愿意为他们的利益去冒险. 与其让她开着家族祖传的机甲到处乱晃，直到某个投机取巧的海盗决定置她于死地，我们更希望由你们来护送她并确保她的安全.

column1: A number of mercenary commands have gotten together to have a bit of a free-for-all fight with some cash and salvage on the line for the winner. However, it's gonna be a wild ride as everyone's IFFs are going to be switching between ally and enemy mode constantly, just to keep it interesting, as the flow of battle changes. Our employer is paying us to win this thing for them, so get in there and make us look good, Commander.
column2: 一些雇佣兵部队聚在一起，搞一场自由近战，赢家可以获得现金和战利品. 不过，这会是一场疯狂的较量，因为所有人的敌我识别系统都会不断在友军和敌军模式之间切换，只为随着战局变化保持趣味性. 我们的雇主付钱让我们为他赢下这场比赛，所以进去大显身手吧，指挥官.

column1: A partial lance of damaged 'Mechs doesn't sound too bad, Commander. If we're able to bring them down mostly intact, this could mean excellent salvage opportunities.
column2: 一支由受损机甲组成的不完整小队听起来还不错，指挥官. 如果我们能完好无损地把它们弄下来，这可能意味着有极好的回收机会.

column1: A prized {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Gladiator has challenged you to solo combat, Commander. The holovid rights have already been sold to the highest bidder and we've already been wired a cut. We can't turn this chance down so we hope you can't too! We'll throw in the holo-vid footage for {COMPANY.CompanyName}'s promotional vids.
column2: 一位受器重的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}角斗士向你发起单挑挑战，指挥官。全息影像版权已经卖给了出价最高者，我们已经收到了一笔分成。我们不能拒绝这个机会，所以希望你也别拒绝！我们还会把全息影像素材送给{COMPANY.CompanyName}用于宣传片。

column1: A prospector with a loose tongue mentioned that he'd located a possible cache of Star League technology on this backwater planet. We've assembled an expert team along with a military force to protect them. They're prepared to investigate, but we've received word that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} also learned of this cache, and dispatched their own lance to find and secure it. We'd like you to intercept this hostile lance and destroy it while the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} team conducts a thorough search.
column2: 一位多嘴多舌的勘探者提到他在这颗闭塞的行星上找到了一个疑似星际联盟技术的仓库. 我们组建了一支专家队伍，连同保护他们的军队. 他们准备进行调查，但是我们收到消息说，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}人也知道了这个仓库，并派出他们自己的小队寻找和夺取它. 我们希望你在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}队伍进行彻底搜查时，能拦截这支敌对小队，并摧毁它.

column1: A rearguard fight isn't exactly what we wanted, but we'll make it work
column2: 一场断后战并不是我们想要的结果，但我们会让它顺利完成.

column1: A regular? That's a step up from a fresh face like before. They'll likely know some of the tricks of the trade, so keep your guard up.
column2: 一个常客？那比之前那种生面孔又高一级了。他们大概懂些行内的门道，所以保持警惕。

column1: A rich {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} business man has requested that we show his arrogant step-son what real fighting feels like. We thought {COMPANY.CompanyName} could help us here. Don't hold back. This father wants to teach a real life lesson - especially for his {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} side of the family.
column2: 一位富有的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商人要求我们让他那傲慢的继子见识见识真正的战斗是什么滋味. 我们想{COMPANY.CompanyName}可以帮我们这个忙. 别手下留情. 这位父亲想给他上一堂现实的人生课——特别是冲着他那{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}血统的娘家人.

column1: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.
column2: 在对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}进行的例行轨道勘测中，我们捕捉到了来自地表的加密信号. 我们的情报专家认为，这些信号来自一个隐藏极深的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施，而这个星系本应是无人居住的. 不言而喻，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不能容忍这片地区有秘密军事基地的存在. 我们需要一家雇佣兵公司拦截一支前往该秘密基地的补给车队. 即使我们找不到他们的设施，也能通过切断补给让他们被活活困死.

column1: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一次例行轨道勘测捕捉到来自地表的加密传输。我们的情报专家相信，这些传输来自这个据称无人居住星系中一处隐蔽良好的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。不用说，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不愿容忍本地区存在秘密军事基地。我们需要一家雇佣兵公司去拦截一支前往该秘密基地的补给商队。即便我们找不到他们的设施，也能把他们饿垮。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.
column2: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意外情况: 在一处废弃设施的位置检测到能量信号. 根据我们得到的读数，可能是座机甲工厂在运转. 我们目前不具备夺取这座工厂的战略条件，所以需要你们找到并摧毁它. 如果我们行动迅速，就能在任何机甲被生产出来之前解决掉它. 当然，如果你们真的 遇到了任何新生产的机甲，也要将它们变成废铁.

column1: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意外之物：一处废弃设施的位置传出能量信号。从我们读到的数值看，那可能是一座正在通电启动的机甲工厂。我们在战略上无力宣称占有那座工厂，所以需要你找到并摧毁它。若我们行动迅速，就能在任何机甲被造出来之前解决此事。如果你真碰上任何新造出的机甲，当然，也该把它们拆成废铁。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Needs some industrial gear from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We have aquired the gear for her. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell it back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to deliver the gear to the scientist through more proactive means.
column2: 一名为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}效力的科学家需要从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}获取一些工业设备. 我们已经为她取得了这些设备. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出将设备赎回，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望拖延时间，让你通过更主动的方式将设备交付给这名科学家.

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.
column2: 一名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}企业集团的科学家成为了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}一家竞争公司的工业间谍. 她掌握着大量我们不希望落入竞争对手手中的工业机密. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出将她出售归还给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望来争取时间，通过更主动的手段将这名科学家撤离出来.

column1: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}企业集团的科学家的为来自{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的对手公司充当了工业间谍。她掌握着大量我们不愿落入竞争对手之手的工业机密。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层提出把她卖回给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望为你争取时间，让你通过更主动的手段把这位科学家救出来。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A straightforward job, Commander. This kind of back and forth is typical on Periphery worlds.
column2: 一个简单明了的任务，指挥官. 这种反反复复的事情在外围星域太典型了.

column1: A surprise attack by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} resulted in the capture of our research facility here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. At the last moment, when all was lost, a convoy managed to escape with an extremely valuable prototype. With the facility in enemy hands, we need this prototype to reconstruct the work of our scientists. Intercept the convoy before the enemy does, and escort our researchers to safety.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的一次突袭导致我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的研究设施被夺走了. 在最后关头，几乎失去一切的时候，一支车队设法带走了一件极其珍贵的原型. 由于设施已落入敌手，我们需要这件原型来重建科学家的研究成果. 在敌人之前找到这支车队，并护送我们的研究人员安全撤离.

column1: A team of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} agents has obtained the schedule and manifest of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. This convoy's cargo is extremely valuable technological components. We want you to steal them for us. Stage an ambush of the convoy, destroy the vehicles, and we'll send in a recovery team to gather the cargo. There's a bonus if you secure the area and eliminate all the convoy guards.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}特工已经获得了一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的行程和货物清单. 该车队运送的货物是极其珍贵的技术组件，我们要你替我们把这些货物抢过来. 伏击车队，摧毁他们的车辆，我们会派回收小队前来收集货物. 如果你肃清该地区，消灭了所有车队护卫的话，还会有额外奖励.

column1: A wanted war criminal has been spotted on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Unfortunately, he appears to have integrated himself into a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned mercenary company. We need you to track him down and destroy his 'Mech. If he ejects, we'll take him into custody to be tried before a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} court. If not, no harm done - you'll be paid the same either way.
column2: 一名被通缉的战争罪犯在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}出现. 不幸的是，他似乎加入了一家效忠于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的佣兵公司. 我们需要你追踪他的下落，摧毁他的机甲. 如果他弹射逃生，我们会将其拘捕并交由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的法庭审判. 如果没有，也没关系——无论哪种情况，你都会得到同样的报酬.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
column2: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在了这颗空荡荡的岩质星球上，之后不久我们就侦测到了地面发出的求救信号. 在我们抵达前，船员就被全副武装的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队俘虏了. 我们在这个星系没有足够的军事存在来进行人质营救任务，所以我们寻求你这种能干的佣兵公司来处理. 我们需要你前往关押船员的设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，然后护送他们到达安全地带.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一艘{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇坠毁在这块空荡的岩石上，此后不久我们探测到来自地表的求救信号。我们赶到时，船员已被一支装备精良的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获。我们在该星系内没有足够大的军事存在来执行人质营救行动，所以我们在找一家称职的雇佣兵公司来做。我们需要你抵达关押船员的那处设施，摧毁看守他们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，并护送他们到安全地带。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy was ambushed and looted for expensive industrial materials, and the perpetrators, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, are moving the stolen goods to a secure location. We'd like you to strike the convoy and destroy it; our salvage teams will then retrieve our goods from the wreckage.
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}车队遭到伏击，贵重的工业物资被洗劫，而幕后黑手{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，正在将这些赃物运往一处安全地点. 我们希望你袭击并摧毁这支车队; 之后我们的打捞小队会从残骸中回收属于我们的物资.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} family lost a large area of land on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, thanks to dubious legal maneuvering by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. This land includes an important ancestral military base. We need this base taken back from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} and held until this can be sorted out.
column2: 由于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}代理人可疑的法律操作，一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}家族在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}失去了大片土地. 这片土地上有一座重要的祖传军事基地. 我们需要从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}手中夺回这座基地，并坚守到问题解决为止.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program.  Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility.  We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
column2: 一座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室的研发项目正处于关键阶段. 任何干扰都可能让我们倒退十年. 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}人已经发现了这一点，并拦截了派往保护该设施的第一支机甲小队. 我们需要雇佣兵介入，为进一步增援争取时间.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program. Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility. We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
column2: 一座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室的研发项目正处于关键阶段. 任何干扰都可能让我们倒退十年. 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}人已经发现了这一点，并拦截了派往保护该设施的第一支机甲小队. 我们需要雇佣兵介入，为进一步增援争取时间.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}侦测到意料之外的信号，我们希望你去调查一下. 分析显示，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经重新激活了该星球表面的一座废弃工厂. 我们不知道这座设施的具体用途，但是考虑到他们费了大力气，它肯定非常有价值. 我们要得到它.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}探测到意外信号，我们希望你去调查。分析显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}重新启用了星球地表一座废弃工厂。我们不知道这处设施具体做什么，但看他们投入的力气，它一定很有价值。我们要它。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} philanthropist is a patron of the arts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. A favored painter has been accused of heresy by the system's religious police. These zealots are propped up by foreign {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. He'll be extradited to face trial and likely execution in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} territory. We can't allow that to happen, but we don't want to incur reprisal from the religious leaders. That's where you come in. Locate the painter, rescue him and, at the personal request of the patron, recover the painting that started this whole mess.
column2: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}慈善家是{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}艺术界的赞助人. 当地一位备受青睐的画家被该星系的宗教警察指控为异端. 这些狂热分子背后有外国{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工的支持. 该画家将被引渡到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的领土接受审判，并极有可能被处决. 我们不能让这种事发生，但也不希望招致宗教领袖的报复. 这就是你的用武之地. 找到那位画家，营救他，并应赞助人的个人请求，回收引发这一切麻烦的画作.

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} politician is looking for an armed escort to guide him safely to a diplomatic summit. We can assure you that any accusations of bribery and corruption are completely unfounded. His {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} enemies are simply stirring up the common people against him.
column2: 一名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政客正在寻求一队武装护卫，以确保他安全前往一次外交峰会. 我们可以向你保证，任何关于贿赂和腐败的指控都是莫须有的. 他的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人只是在煽动民众反对他.

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Trinary Leader has taken issue with a recently released report on military inefficencies. She has demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We would like to hire you to represent our allegations, Commander.
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}三元编队指挥官对最近发布的一份关于军队效率低下的报告颇有异议. 她要求通过决斗来与报告中的指控作斗争. 指挥官，我们希望雇佣您代表我们，为这些指控据理力争.

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warrior has issued you a Trial of Grievance through us, Commander. It's a good opportunity to show our Sibkos how mercenaries fight, so we'll pay you if you win. Now, will {COMPANY.CompanyName} be remembered for their glorious fight, or forgotten?
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士通过我们向你发起了荣誉争议试炼，指挥官. 这是向我们的Sibko展示雇佣兵如何战斗的好机会，所以如果你获胜，我们会支付报酬. 那么，{COMPANY.CompanyName}会因他们辉煌的战斗而被铭记，还是会被遗忘?

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy regularly transports rare minerals through the region. Our agents have acquired the convoy's travel plans so that you can ambush the convoy. We do not require that you recover the minerals. We just want to keep them out of the enemy's hands.
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队定期在该地区运输稀有矿物. 我们的特工已经拿到了车队的行程计划，以便你们对其进行伏击. 我们并不要求你们回收这些矿物. 只希望它们不要落入敌人手中.

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}投诚人员向我们提供了一条极其有趣且时间紧迫的信息，我们需要快速反应. 这名投诚者在加入我们之前，曾在这个星球的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作过. 她声称自己负责从一个设备中提取数据，根据她的描述来看，这个设备非常像是星际联盟时期的记忆核心. 我们不知道上面有什么数据，但绝不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}得到它.

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。[警告：丧尸]

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} detachment of fire support vehicles is on the move to a strategic location. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would prefer that they do not reach their destination.
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}火力支援车辆分队正在前往一个战略地点. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}希望他们无法抵达目的地.

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} detachment of fire support vehicles is on the move to a strategic location. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would prefer that they do not reach their destination.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}火力支援车辆分队正在前往一个战略地点. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}希望他们无法抵达目的地. [警告: 僵尸]

column1: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader has fallen behind on payments for their armored vehicles, and our leasing agent has been unable to repossess the heavily armored vehicles. We've decided that sending a more explosive message is the best way to ensure that others do not take future liberties.
column2: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人拖欠着购买装甲车的款项，而我们的租赁代理无法收回这些重型装甲车辆. 我们决定，以更具震慑力的方式行动，是确保其他人今后不敢效仿的最佳方法.

column1: According to ISF intelligence, Captain Gaku Magorian is being held prisoner in one of a dozen safe houses within the boundaries of Alamedo Province. Obviously, we can't rely on trial and error to find him, so we're going to have to narrow down the list. Our unidentified syndicate is known to maintain a forward base in this AO. Capture it so that Dr. Murad can scour the OpFor's mainframe for confirmation of Captain Magorian's whereabouts.
column2: 根据ISF的情报，贺久·马格里安船长被关押在阿拉米多省边界内的几十个安全屋之一. 显然，我们不能靠试错法去寻找他，所以必须缩小范围. 我们已知的这个未确认犯罪集团在该行动区域内有一个前沿基地. 你必须控制这个基地，以便穆拉德博士可以在敌人的主机上搜索马格里安船长的具体位置.

column1: According to Ombra, a Black Caldera convoy has been scheduled to pass through the badlands north of New Jakobstad. Engage the convoy and destroy it. Bravo Lance will then interface with the command vehicle's black box to obtain the location of the Raven prototype, as well as the R&D facility Black Caldera has been using to reverse engineer it.
column2: 根据Ombra的情报，一支Black Caldera护送队正在穿越新雅各布斯塔德北部的荒地. 袭击该护送队并将其摧毁. 然后Bravo小队将接入指挥车的黑匣子，以获取“渡鸦”原型机的位置，以及Black Caldera用来逆向工程它的研究实验室.

column1: According to Subcommander Tianyu, the warehouse should be full of mining equipment… generators, churn drills, that sort of thing. Nothing we'd be interested in, but worth a lot to the right people.
column2: 根据田雨副指挥官的说法，那座仓库里应该全是采矿设备……发电机、螺旋钻之类的东西。我们不会感兴趣，但对合适的人来说值不少钱。

column1: According to the information my team pulled from the base you captured, our target—my enemy—is one Murdoch Dhawan, a small-time political extremist from Kilarney. He's here, in this basin. Destroy him and you will be well rewarded.
column2: 根据我团队从你夺取的基地中提取的信息，我们的目标——我的敌人——是基拉尼的一个小混混式政治极端分子，名叫默多克·达万。他就在这个盆地里。摧毁他，你会得到丰厚报酬。

column1: According to the information recovered by my forensics team, our target—the person responsible for my family's suffering—is Lord Parzival Gurung, the head of a minor noble house from Atreus. Lord Gurung is well connected and well defended. If we're going to capture him, first we must strike against his bodyguard.
column2: 根据我的法医团队恢复的信息，我们的目标——那个对我家族苦难负责的人——是帕齐瓦尔·古隆领主，来自阿特柔斯的一个小贵族家族的族长。古隆领主关系网深、护卫严密。如果我们要俘获他，必须先打击他的保镖。

column1: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera Defense is storing their stolen Raven prototype at an old armory in southern New Jakobstad. We need to capture the base and recover the prototype. Conqueror, Viscacha, and Peregrine will be standing by to carry out the second half of the operation when we're done.
column2: 根据我们得到的情报，Black Caldera Defense将他们偷来的“渡鸦”原型机保存在新雅各布斯塔德南部的一处旧军械库中. 我们需要占领该基地并夺回原型机. 征服者、兔鼠和游隼将在我们完成后待命，立即执行行动的第二阶段.

column1: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera's hardened R&D facility is protected by a phalanx of LRM batteries. Using the Raven's unique capabilities, you will protect Bravo Lance from these weapons while leading them to destroy the facility.
column2: 根据我们得到的情报，Black Caldera的强化研究实验室受到LRM方阵的保护. 凭借“渡鸦”的独特技能，你可以保护Bravo小队免受这些武器的攻击，同时带领他们摧毁该设施.

column1: After a recent engagement, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have captured a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} stronghold. This has left the bulk of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in the field, with nowhere to withdraw to. We'd like you to engage those forces and destroy them in detail. The goal is to break their ability to take the field against us for the forseeable future; that means none of their units should survive.
column2: 在最近的一次交战之后，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}军队夺取了一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}据点. 这导致大量{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队遗留在战场上，无处可逃. 我们希望你能够与这些部队交战并完全摧毁它们. 我们的目标是摧毁他们在可预见的未来里可能存在的反抗能力; 这意味着他们所有的作战单位都不该生还.

column1: After a recent skirmish with our forces, the surviving units of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance escaped the battlefield. We believe they've managed to partially repair their 'Mechs, and that means they're a loose end that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would like to see tied off, permanently. Track down these survivors and finish them for good.
column2: 在与我方部队的最近一次小规模冲突后，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队的幸存单位逃离了战场. 我们相信他们已经修复了部分机甲，这意味着他们是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}希望彻底解决的隐患. 找到这些幸存者，并将他们彻底消灭.

column1: After all that, it appears that our only path to victory is to demolish their base. We have a Naval PPC at the ready, but we require a target..
column2: 折腾这么多之后，看来我们唯一的胜利之路就是摧毁他们的基地。我们有一门舰载 PPC 待命，但需要目标。

column1: Agent X is leading them Commander, I don't see his Waneta though. We may have gotten lucky. We don't know much more about him than he is really deadly.
column2: X特工正率领他们，指挥官，不过我没看到他的瓦内塔。也许我们运气不错。关于他我们知道的并不多，只知道他极其致命。

column1: Aggressors are attacking our famine relief effort on this planet. If they succeed, mass starvation will follow. They're trying to bait me into redirecting the main army and taking the field myself… but I can't let them do that. If our people are to survive, you will have to save them.
column2: 侵略者正在攻击我们在这颗星球上的饥荒救济行动。若他们得逞，大规模饥荒将随之而来。他们想引我把主力调走、亲自上阵……但我不能让他们得逞。若要我们的人活下来，你必须救他们。

column1: All right! Got her cornered in her last stronghold. I would assume she's going to be well armed. I brought a can opener and a Nut Cracker with me. Time to crack some skulls
column2: 好！把她逼到了最后的据点。我猜她会武装得很充分。我带了个开罐器和一把胡桃夹子。是时候敲碎几颗脑袋了

column1: All this covert action has my nerves wound tight. I'm glad we're finally getting to flex our muscles a bit.
column2: 这些秘密行动搞得我神经紧张. 真高兴我们终于能稍微活动活动筋骨了.

column1: Alright, we will try it your way. I think that we should kill the target, but if you want to capture him we will go with that.
column2: 好，我们按你的方式来。我认为我们应该杀掉目标，但如果你想俘获他，我们就照办。

column1: An Urbie is basically a walking dustbin with a big gun. That weapon packs a hell of a punch, but it's only so long till it's a paperweight. Keep an eye on those heat gauges, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 城市仔基本上就是个会走路的垃圾桶配一门大炮。那武器打击力惊人，但迟早会变成一个镇纸。盯紧那些热量表，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: An ally of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} stands accused of a long list of illegal, unethical and deplorable activities. Proof of her guilt was being transported to a spaceport, for safe-keeping off-planet, when it was attacked by unidentified mercenary forces. The convoy narrowly escaped and we need you to protect it while we arrange for a dropship pickup.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}盟友被指控涉及一系列非法、不道德及令人发指的活动. 她的罪证正被运送至太空港以便转移到星球之外保管，但途中遭到不明雇佣兵部队的袭击. 车队勉强摆脱了敌人，我们需要你保护车队，直到我们安排空投艇接应.

column1: An elite MechWarrior has been deployed to take command of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this system. We need a skilled mercenary force to remove this MechWarrior before they reach their command, while they're only lightly escorted. Every downed 'Mech will help our cause, so there will be a bonus for complete destruction of the target's supporting forces. Additionally, the MechWarrior's command may send out an escort unit to meet them; expect enemy reinforcements once you engage.
column2: 一名精英机甲战士已被派往指挥{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}在此星系的部队. 我们需要一支经验丰富的雇佣兵部队在他们抵达指挥岗位前将其消灭，此时他们的护卫力量还很薄弱. 每台倒下的机甲都有助于我们的事业，所以彻底摧毁目标的支援部队将获得额外奖励. 此外，该机甲战士的指挥部可能会派护卫队和他们碰头; 一旦交战，预计会有敌方增援出现.

column1: An off-season 4x4 3-way team mech deathmatch.
column2: 一场非赛季的4×4三方团队机甲死斗赛.

column1: An off-season 4x4 capture the flag match.
column2: 一场非赛季的4×4夺旗赛.

column1: An off-season 4x4 team deathmatch.
column2: 一场非赛季的4×4团队死斗赛.

column1: An off-season 8x8 capture the flag match.
column2: 一场非赛季的8×8夺旗赛.

column1: An off-season 8x8 team mech deathmatch
column2: 一场非赛季的8×8团队机甲死斗赛

column1: Apparently they are moving our target again. This time by 'Mech. We are switching this to an assassinate mission and giving you the coordinates. Good Luck, Commander.
column2: 显然他们又把我们的目标转移了。这次是用机甲运。我们把这次改成刺杀任务并给你坐标。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Apparently {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} controls a network of transports and warehouses in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, moving mostly mundane merchandise but also a very few highly valuable goods. Our clandestine research efforts have acquired the latest shipping manifests and identified an opportunity for a swift, profitable strike at a key shipping hub. If timed properly, your Mechs can attack quickly and pave the way for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} extraction team to empty the warehouse of its contents.
column2: 显然，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}控制着{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一张运输和仓储网络，运送的大部分是普通货物，但也有少数高价值货物. 我们的秘密调查获取了最新的运输清单，并发现了对一个关键运输枢纽进行快速且高收益打击的机会. 如果时机掌握得当，你的机甲就能迅速发起攻击，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的回收小队搬空仓库里的物资铺平道路.

column1: Apply pressure and we'll have our victory.
column2: 施加压力，我们就能拿下胜利。

column1: As I mentioned, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, before we can begin operations on the planet, we need to neutralize an observation post. Conveniently, we can then use the facility's resources to stage further assaults. Our information suggests the base is quite well defended, which is unsurprising, given the planet's location on multiple potentially hostile borders. Once the base is taken, we won't have to worry about errant calls for reinforcements, but to be safe, it would be best for you to hunt down all enemy forces to prevent them from retreating and spreading word of the attack.
column2: 正如我之前提到的，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}: 在我们开始对这颗星球的行动之前，我们需要先摧毁一个观察哨. 方便的是，我们可以利用该设施的资源来筹备进一步的进攻. 我们的情报显示，这个基地防守相当严密 - 鉴于这颗星球位于多条潜在敌对边境上，这并不令人意外. 一旦基地被占领，我们就不必担心敌方呼叫增援. 但为了安全起见，你最好追击所有敌军，防止他们撤退并将袭击的消息传播出去.

column1: As discussed previously {COMMANDER.LastName}, it is essential that you pounce on any defenders and capture this Neko Holding Facility before my fellow members of MEOW can be shipped away. Once under our control, we’ll have to make our hasty exit stage wherever. You'll have to keep the facility safe while we whisk any prisoners into our protection
column2: 如前所述{COMMANDER.LastName}，你必须扑向任何守军并在我的MEOW同僚被运走之前夺取这处猫娘关押设施。一旦它归我们控制，我们就得从某个地方匆匆退场。在我们把任何囚犯纳入我们的保护之下时，你得保证设施安全

column1: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble destroying the base.
column2: 只要卡莱尔的人做好他们的工作，我们应该能够毫无问题地摧毁基地.

column1: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble taking the base.
column2: 只要卡莱尔的人能完成他们的任务，我们拿下基地应该没问题.

column1: As part of a propaganda effort, we've been operating a secret holo-vid broadcasting facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. The clearest sign that our efforts are working is that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have spent months searching for the facility. Unfortunately, they've succeeded, and are launching an assault on what they believe to be an undefended installation. While our personnel prepare for evacuation and destroy all the files and documents, we need a team of mercenaries to hold off {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
column2: 作为宣传工作的一部分，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}运营一座秘密的全息影像广播设施. 我们的工作奏效了，最清晰的信号就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工花了几个月的时间搜索这座设施. 不幸的是，他们成功了，他们相信这座设施毫无防备，向它发起了进攻. 在我们的人员准备撤离并销毁所有文件档案的同时，我们需要一队佣兵去抵挡{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队.

column1: As per our earlier discussion, I'm going to drop you right on top of a Baumann Group security outpost some 20 klicks from the Dobrev's spaceport. You're going to have to capture the site and clear out its defenses. When the job's done, the Moderbjörn will use the complex's computers to drop the spaceport's defenses and remotely engage the Dobrev's docking clamps. I'd expect the OpFor's defenses to run heavy on this one, so I'd advise building your lance accordingly.
column2: 正如我们之前讨论的，我会将你们直接投送到距多布雷夫号 约20公里处的鲍曼集团安保综合设施. 你们需要占领该据点并清除其防御力量. 任务完成后，“熊妈妈”将利用哨站计算机系统瘫痪太空港防御并远程启动多布雷夫号 的泊位锁定装置. 预计敌方防御力量会很强，因此建议你据此组建你的小队.

column1: As someone wise said, \"we tactically leapfrog in a different direction.\"
column2: 正如某位智者所说:“我们只是在战术上向另一个方向跳跃.”

column1: As soon as {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership realizes what we're doing, Commander, they're going to try to destroy the convoy themselves. Expect enemy reinforcements to target the vehicles.
column2: 指挥官，一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人意识到我们在做什么，他们就会自己毁掉车队. 预计敌人的援军是冲着这些车来的.

column1: As we discussed, this will be a joint operation. As long as Gwydion Company doesn't drop the ball, I'm confident that we can handle our end of the job.
column2: 正如我们所讨论的，这将是一次联合行动. 只要格威迪恩公司不掉链子，我相信我们能完成我们这边的任务.

column1: As with every year at this festive time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} we host an arena fight for the people. This year we'd like you to be our representative. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We're placing our trust in you so please don't let us down.
column2: 和每年这个时候在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上一样，我们都会为人民举办一场竞技场近战. 今年，我们希望您能担任我们的代表. 您的双人对决将对阵{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. 我们将信任寄托于您，请别让我们失望.

column1: Assaulting fixed defenses is always a mess, Commander. Fixed gun emplacements can target your units from clear across the battlefield. Stay alert.
column2: 进攻固定防线总是很麻烦，指挥官. 固定炮台可以从战场另一边瞄准你的单位. 保持警惕.

column1: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.
column2: 假设人质还活着的话，我们要让他们保持这种状态可要费一番功夫了.

column1: Base Defense is usually a long and drawn out afair.
column2: 基地防御通常是一场旷日持久的事情.

column1: Base Destruction.
column2: 基地摧毁。

column1: BattleMechs are wreaking havoc on the general population. We have DropShips en route to evacuate as many refugees as they can carry, but the Aggressors will target them if they get the chance. I need you to deny them that opportunity.
column2: 战斗机甲正在对平民大肆破坏。我们有空投艇正在前往撤离尽可能多的难民，但侵略者一旦有机会就会把它们当作目标。我需要你让他们没有这个机会。

column1: Before the Maskirovka team can transport the scientists to the extraction point, we need to deal with the Davion forces that are closing on our position. We've located two lances of 'Mechs that are inbound, and I need you to intercept them before they get here. Once they're dealt with, we can start moving the team, and the scientists, to the extraction point. And Commander… I apologize for my curt tone earlier. I didn't brief you fully, and that was unprofessional of me.
column2: 在伪装局小队把科学家们运到撤离点之前，我们需要先解决正在逼近我们位置的达维昂部队。我们已定位两支正在赶来的机甲分队，我需要你在他们抵达前拦截他们。等他们被解决，我们就能把小队和科学家们转移到撤离点。还有，指挥官……我为先前生硬的语气道歉。我没有向你做完整简报，那是我的不专业。

column1: Before we can eliminate the person responsible for attacking my family, we must identify him. His mercenary cat's-paws, Arslan's Janissaries, have a base of operations at our first drop site. You will seize the base from them. My forensics team will then scour their computers to put a name to their employer.
column2: 在清除袭击我家族的元凶之前，必须先行确认其身份. 其雇佣的爪牙——阿尔斯兰禁卫军——在首个空降点设有行动基地. 你需要从他们手中夺取该基地. 我的取证团队将彻底搜查基地的计算机，锁定雇主身份.

column1: Before you can rid us of the Volkovites, you're going to have to deal with Razorback Company, the hired guns they imported from the Frontier. Our surveillance drones have identified the company's command-and-control 'Mech, a CP-10-Z Cyclops. Eliminate it to cripple Razorback Company and clear a path to your real target.
column2: 在清剿沃尔科维特之前，你必须先解决他们从边境雇来的佣兵部队“尖背野猪”公司. 我们的侦察无人机已识别出该部队的指挥机甲——一台“独眼巨人 10-Z”. 摧毁它即可瓦解尖背野猪公司的指挥体系，为你扫清通往最终目标的道路.

column1: Being in the limelight is great, but prepare for the worst.
column2: 身处聚光灯下很棒，但要做好最坏的准备。

column1: Being paid to get chased and shot at? Not ideal.  Fingers crossed for some extra bonuses
column2: 被雇来让别人追着打还要挨枪子? 这可不算理想. 希望能拿到一些额外奖金吧.

column1: Binton and Modge were fighting against each other on Men Lojowen. They may be allies of convenience for now, but I'll bet that'll change when they've got the \"treasure\" in their sights.
column2: 宾顿与莫奇在Men Lojowen时就互相敌对. 眼下虽是权宜结盟，但我敢打赌，一旦他们看到了宝藏，情况就会改变.

column1: Bio research station? We better be careful here, Commander. I don't fancy catching a new type of cold, if you know what I mean?
column2: 生物研究站? 我们最好小心点，指挥官. 我可不想染上什么新型感冒，你懂我的意思吧?

column1: Boots on the ground...that's us.
column2: 实地人员……就是我们。

column1: Bring enough ammo to deal with stragglers. These things get messy.
column2: 带够弹药来对付掉队者。这些事会很乱。

column1: Bringing a military ship this far out towards the Periphery is a hell of a risk. This operative must know something big.
column2: 把军用飞船开到这么远的边境地区，风险极大. 这名特工一定掌握着什么重要的东西.

column1: Brutal, but undeniably effective. A cored 'Mech isn't going to end up repaired and back in battle against you. Sounds like a lot of fighting, though; be prepared.
column2: 残忍，但无可争辩的有效. 一部被毁掉核心的机甲不会修好后重回战场与你对抗. 不过，听起来有很多战斗，做好准备.

column1: Buckle up, Commander.  This sounds like an extremely tough fight.  You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: Buckle up, Commander. This sounds like an extremely tough fight. You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

column1: Buckle up, Commander. Two heavily-armed lances? This is going to be tough.
column2: 做好准备，指挥官. 两支全副武装的小队? 这会有点艰难.

column1: By attacking and securing the refinery, we will divert resources to our Employer, and make it more difficult for our opponent to wage war.
column2: 通过攻击并夺取这座炼油厂，我们将把资源引向我们的雇主，并让对手更难发动战争。

column1: By now you know the drill. We will be firing our Naval Gauss Rifle from orbit, We can only keep it charged so long. Get the beepy things in the Target zone so we can blow a hole in this base.
column2: 到现在你该熟悉流程了。我们将从轨道上发射舰载高斯步枪，我们只能让它充能这么久。把那些会叫的东西放进目标区，好让我们在这座基地上炸出一个洞。

column1: Captain Magorian is being held in a subterranean bunker attached to a complex just ahead of us. We're going to sneak a scout lance in, rescue the captain, and bug out. If all goes according to plan, the Moderbjörn's combat drones will distract the bunker's garrison and keep it out of our hair for the duration of the operation.
column2: 马格里安船长被关押在前方建筑群的地下掩体中. 我们将派遣侦察小队潜入，救出船长后立即撤离. 如果一切按计划进行，“熊妈妈”的战斗无人机将全程牵制地堡的驻军，确保行动不受干扰.

column1: Capturing this Prison is going to be tough, Commander.
column2: 夺取这座监狱会很艰难，指挥官。

column1: Capturing this base is going to be tough, Commander. We'll be outnumbered and possibly outgunned. I hope it's worth it.
column2: 攻占这个基地会非常艰难，指挥官. 我们将面临人数和火力的双重劣势. 希望这一切值得.

column1: Carronade sends her thanks for the assist, Commander—we're doing Gwydion Company a solid that a lot of other mercenary commands wouldn't. Our friends have taken shelter in a subterranean bunker, and a Steiner strike team has them penned in. Carronade needs us to engage and destroy the Lyrans so that she and her people can escape.
column2: 短炮向你的协助致谢，指挥官——我们在帮格威迪恩连，这是许多其他雇佣兵部队不会做的事。我们的朋友躲进了一处地下掩体，一支施泰纳打击队把他们围住了。短炮需要我们交战并消灭这些莱兰人，好让她和她的人逃脱。

column1: Clanners may be difficult to handle, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's put on our game faces.
column2: 部族分子可能不好对付，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。让我们摆出认真脸。

column1: Clever smugglers, hiding in plain sight. Now that their cover's blown, they'll probably call for military backup.
column2: 聪明的走私者，就躲在眼皮底下. 既然他们的伪装暴露了，他们可能会呼叫军事后援.

column1: Clever smugglers, hiding in plain sight. Now that their cover's blown, they're likely to call for military backup.
column2: 聪明的走私者，就躲在眼皮底下. 既然他们的伪装暴露了，他们很可能会呼叫军事后援.

column1: Colonel Lees's stronghold is just ahead of you, Commander. For all his arrogant bluster, it would seem that the Butcher of Shaul Khala is a coward at heart. I've seen no sign that he intends to meet you on the field of battle. So be it; if he won't leave his fortress voluntarily, then I will have your BattleMechs remove him by force.
column2: 利斯上校的据点就在你前方，指挥官. 尽管此人傲慢嚣张，但绍尔哈拉的屠夫本质上仍是个懦夫. 我没有看到他打算在战场上与你正面交锋的迹象. 既然如此. 如果他不愿主动离开巢穴，就让你的战斗机甲用武力把他带走吧.

column1: ComStar Reinforcments have arrived. Let us meet them in the field.
column2: 康星的增援已抵达。让我们在战场上会会他们。

column1: Command
column2: 指挥部

column1: Commander Yuetu and her Red Hare Irregulars have proven an intolerable threat to my interests and to the future of House Khulan. I need you to hunt her down and destroy her BattleMech, an \"Orion,\" I believe it's called. Smash it to pieces and bring me proof of Yuetu's death, and I will lend Shugo Yamaguchi my support.
column2: 指挥官，“月兔”和她的“赤兔军”已经对我的利益以及呼兰家族的未来构成了无法容忍的威胁. 我需要你追捕她并摧毁她的战机——一台“猎户座”，我想它就是这么叫的. 把它打成碎片，并带回“月兔”已死的证据，那样我就会给予山口修吾我的支持.

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, While you capture Maximums Base We will sneak into their production Facilities and Snatch their prototype. We are counting on you Commander
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，当你们夺取Maximums基地时，我们会潜入他们的生产设施，抢夺他们的原型机. 我们指望你了，指挥官.

column1: Commander, I don't pretend to understand what's so offensive about this painting, but they take that sort of thing seriously out here. As for retrieving the painting, apparently it's worth even more after all this controversy.
column2: 指挥官，我并不懂这幅画有什么冒犯之处，但他们对待这类事情非常严肃. 至于取回这幅画，在经历了这么多争议之后，它的价值显然更高了.

column1: Commander, I expect the defenses on the facility to be substantial. But if we were bothered by the odds, we wouldn't be mercenaries.
column2: 指挥官，我估计这座设施的防御会相当严密. 但如果我们会被可能性所困扰，我们就不会当雇佣兵了.

column1: Commander, I suspect that our employers' reluctance to commit their own forces has less to do with any extreme danger of the task, but some distaste with their merchant friend.
column2: 指挥官，我怀疑我们的雇主不愿指派自己的军队做这事，与这项任务的极端危险性没有多大关系，而是因为对他们的商人朋友的厌恶.

column1: Commander, I've chatted with this politician briefly, and he is certainly a piece of work. I suspect that his enemies may not wait until the ballot box to remove him from power.
column2: 指挥官，我和这位政客短暂交流过，他确实是个难缠的角色. 我怀疑他的敌人也许不会等到用投票箱赶他下台了.

column1: Commander, I've done some research, and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} really wants this particular rebel eliminated. Stay alert and expect the worst. That's usually a good approach.
column2: 指挥官，我做了一些调查，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}非常 想消灭这位特别的反叛者. 保持警惕，并做好最坏的打算——这通常是明智的做法.

column1: Commander, I've read a bit about this criminal and the things that she's accused of. I suspect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will do anything to eliminate her. If we take this job, we should expect trouble.
column2: 指挥官，我读过一些关于这个罪犯的资料以及她被指控的罪行. 我怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}会不惜一切代价除掉她. 如果我们接下这份活，应该预料到会有麻烦.

column1: Commander, Those guys we ran into from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} are pretty hot headed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Warriors. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
column2: 指挥官，我们遇到的那些来自{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的家伙都是些脾气火爆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士. 看来我们摊上一场决斗了.

column1: Commander, Tubbs is down there. He has supporters - mostly gladiators with no love for you. Exercise caution, but remember your goal here: drop and eliminate.
column2: 指挥官，塔布斯就在下面。他有支持者——大多是看你不顺眼的角斗士。谨慎行事，但记住你在这里的目标：投放并消灭。

column1: Commander, a pleasure. Does the idea of getting into a closed ring of DANGER to face down a RABID enemy Mechwarrior appeal to you? Okay, what if we paid well?
column2: 指挥官，很高兴见到你。想不想到一个封闭的“危险“擂台上，去正面迎战一名狂怒的敌方机师？好吧，如果我们付得很好呢？

column1: Commander, as soon as you make contact, expect any nearby enemy forces to close on your position.
column2: 指挥官，一旦与目标接触，附近的敌军很可能会立即朝你的位置靠拢.

column1: Commander, be careful: if there *is* a second attack, the raiders will go all out.
column2: 指挥官，小心点: 如果*有*第二轮攻击，那些袭击者会全力以赴.

column1: Commander, do you see those pirates over there? Well, I don't want to. All understood?
column2: 指挥官，你看到那边那些海盗了吗？嗯，我不想看到。都明白吗？

column1: Commander, find and eliminate the Iron Sparrow's courier and his bodyguard. I want Shivraj dead and whatever intelligence he's carrying in my hands.
column2: 指挥官，追踪并清除“铁麻雀”的信使和他的护卫. 我要希瓦吉的人头和他携带的全部情报.

column1: Commander, from what I understand the mechs are being piloted by either rookies or support staff. They'll likely try to escape rather than battle. They will have an escort however.
column2: 指挥官，据我所知，这些机甲要么由新兵驾驶，要么由后勤人员驾驶. 他们很可能会试图逃跑而非交战. 不过他们会有护卫.

column1: Commander, if that Demolisher has ammo on board, this could be a short and simple mission. Those things are terrifying.
column2: 指挥官，如果那辆“破坏者”载有弹药，这就可能是个简短利落的任务. 那些东西太可怕了.

column1: Commander, if that Demolisher has ammo on board, this mission might be short and simple. Those things are terrifying.
column2: 指挥官，如果那辆“破坏者”载有弹药，任务可能会简短利落. 那些东西太可怕了.

column1: Commander, if the convoy has been attacked once, we can just about guarantee that it's going to be attacked again. Somehow, I doubt {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will give up so easily.
column2: 指挥官，如果车队已经遭到一次袭击，我们几乎可以确定它还会再次遭到攻击. 我怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}不会轻易放手.

column1: Commander, if these are just mercantile goods, as they say, I wouldn't expect very aggressive defenses.
column2: 指挥官，如果像他们说的，这些只是商业货物，那我不认为会有非常激烈的抵抗.

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble.  Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，他们的部队不到一天就能赶到，却还要雇佣兵来当保姆，这说明他们预感会有麻烦. 传闻{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队就在附近，可能构成威胁.

column1: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble. Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
column2: 指挥官，他们的部队不到一天就能赶到，却还要雇佣兵来当保姆，这说明他们预感会有麻烦. 传闻{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队就在附近，可能构成威胁.

column1: Commander, if this is the real thing, it's going to be defended like you can't even imagine. This one will be tough.
column2: 指挥官，如果这是真品，那它的防护程度将超乎你的想象. 这次行动会非常艰难.

column1: Commander, in my experience, merchants will defend their profits with extreme prejudice. Expect a hostile response as soon as you kick down the door.
column2: 指挥官，根据我的经验，商人们会用极端的偏见来捍卫他们的利润. 当你把门踢开时，就该预料到有充满敌意的反应.

column1: Commander, in this match 3 lances drop, the one that survives - wins.
column2: 指挥官，这场战斗会空降3支小队，活到最后的胜利.

column1: Commander, it seems we've finally located the Production Facilities. Shall we proceed to take the whole thing down?
column2: 指挥官，看来我们终于找到了生产设施。我们直接把整个地方端掉好吗？

column1: Commander, looks like those two guys that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} crew ticked off last night were actually {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Looks like we've got ourselves a duel.
column2: 指挥官，看来昨晚被{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}船员惹恼的那两个人，实际上是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}卫兵. 看来我们要进行一场决斗了.

column1: Commander, one of our facilities has gone dark, and we're not sure why. The base is one of two {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities in the region. We have satellite imagery showing unknown 'Mechs moving in the area, and it seems as though they're preparing for an assault on the secondary base. We need you to put 'Mechs in the field, defend the secondary base, and drive them out of the primary base. Our own forces are inbound but won't get there in time to save the secondary base.
column2: 指挥官，我们的一处设施失联了 - 原因未明. 那座基地是该地区两处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施之一. 卫星影像显示，有不明机甲正在该区域活动，似乎正准备攻击第二处基地. 我们需要你派遣机甲部队，守住第二处基地，并将敌人从第一基地驱逐. 我们的部队正在赶来，但无法及时抵达救援第二基地.

column1: Commander, one of our senior operatives has defected to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They know far too much about our operations to be allowed to share their knowledge with their new friends. It seems the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} handlers have realized how valuable the knowledge our operative possesses is, because they're being held in an extremely secure facility, deep underground. Such extreme defensive measures probably makes them feel as though they're untouchable. We have a military DropShip with a naval PPC on station to demonstrate to them just how touchable they are. We need you to help us precisely target the PPC.
column2: 指挥官，我们的一名高级特工叛逃到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. 他们掌握了太多关于我们行动的信息，绝不能让他们把这些情报透露给新朋友. 显然，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}方面已经意识到这名特工所掌握情报的价值，因为他们正被关押在一处戒备森严的设施中. 如此极端的防御措施，大概让他们觉得自己坚不可摧，但我们有一艘搭载海军PPC的军用空投艇正在待命，要向他们证明所谓的“坚不可摧”不过是错觉. 我们需要你协助我们的那门PPC进行精确瞄准.

column1: Commander, our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the personnel, we need you to pacify that military base.
column2: 指挥官，我们的秘密部队已准备好夺取一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}监狱设施，那里关押着大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员. 然而，该设施受到附近一个军事基地的保护. 一旦我们夺取监狱，基地就会立即反击，宁可把监狱夷为平地也不会让我们救出那些人. 我们会尽快部署我们自己的机甲和“豹”式飞船，但在我们降落并救出人员之前，需要你先压制住那个军事基地.

column1: Commander, plausible deniability is our specialty.
column2: 指挥官，合理否认可是我们的拿手好戏.

column1: Commander, the carriers they're talking about are slow and fragile. On the other hand they could certainly provide fire support if things go south.
column2: 指挥官，他们所说的运输车速度缓慢且脆弱. 不过另一方面，如果事态恶化，它们确实可以提供火力支援.

column1: Commander, the local nets are full of news about this hearing. This job is higher-profile than our usual work. It's your call, though; if we don't take the job, another mercenary company will.
column2: 指挥官，当地的网络上到处都是有关这场听证会的新闻. 这份工作比我们平常的工作更高调. 不过，由你决定吧; 如果我们不接这份工作，其它佣兵公司就会接.

column1: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a punch.
column2: 指挥官，目标很可能行动缓慢且脆弱. 不过之所以要求我们在他们行进途中、远离固守阵地时发动攻击，是因为他们的火力非常强劲.

column1: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a wallop.
column2: 指挥官，目标很可能行动缓慢且脆弱. 不过之所以要求我们在他们行进途中、远离固守阵地时发动攻击，是因为他们的火力非常凶猛.

column1: Commander, the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} plan is sound, as long as we're okay with intentionally setting up an ambush on ourselves.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的计划是可行的，只要我们能接受故意把自己暴露在伏击之下.

column1: Commander, there is nothing glamorous about sighting targets for big guns, but the fireworks can be exciting. Just make sure you're clear of the blast radius before those shells land.
column2: 指挥官，给重炮标定目标这事没什么光彩的，但放烟花倒挺带劲. 只要确保炮弹落下前你们远离爆炸范围就行.

column1: Commander, they also mentioned that the target vehicles are currently on deployment with a secondary lance of 'Mechs. You can optionally destroy them as well, and there's a bonus.
column2: 指挥官，他们还提到目标车辆目前和一支次要机甲小队一起行动. 你也可以选择将它们摧毁，会有额外奖励.

column1: Commander, this could be a wild goose chase. Of course, if there's nothing to find, they haven't wasted the time of their own 'Mechs.
column2: 指挥官，这可能是一场无用功. 当然，如果真没什么好找的，他们的机甲也不会白白浪费时间.

column1: Commander, this installation is a vital part of Combine research efforts, and we need to ensure the enemy doesn't destroy it. We believe the opposing forces are a mercenary unit hired by our erstwhile allies in the Free Worlds League, and their intent is to disrupt the important work being done here. Your job will be to hold them off until they exhaust themselves, at which point we'll launch our own counterattack.
column2: 指挥官，这个设施是联合体研究计划的重要组成部分. 我们必须确保其不被敌人摧毁. 据信敌方部队是一支由我们以前的盟友——自由世界联盟——雇佣的佣兵部队. 他们的目的是破坏这里正在进行的重要工作. 你的任务是阻挡他们，直到他们筋疲力尽. 届时我们将发动反击.

column1: Commander, this is a bold move by the smugglers so we have to assume they have more than just a simple token force there. Be prepared for anything.
column2: 指挥官，这伙走私者敢采取如此大胆的行动，我们最好假设他们不止有一支象征性部队在那儿. 准备好应付任何情况.

column1: Commander, this is a very straightforward match: eliminate all your opposition for the win.
column2: 指挥官，这场比赛非常简单明了: 消灭所有对手即可获胜.

column1: Commander, this is an extremely time-sensitive mission and we're on a strict deadline, so I hope you can assist us. Our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilians are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the civilians, we need you to pacify that military base.
column2: 指挥官，这是一次极其紧迫的任务，我们有严格的截止时间，所以希望你能协助我们. 我们的秘密部队准备夺取一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施，那里关押了大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}平民. 然而，该设施受附近军事基地的保护. 一旦我们夺取监狱，基地就会立即反击，宁可把监狱夷为平地也不会让我们救出那些人. 我们会尽快部署我们自己的机甲和“豹”式飞船，但在我们降落并救出平民之前，需要你先压制住那个军事基地.

column1: Commander, this is definitely a contract where speed is of the essence. I expect that if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces locate the asset, they'll rally reinforcements from the captured research facility.
column2: 指挥官，这无疑是一份以速度为关键的任务. 我认为要是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队找到了目标，他们就会从被占领的研究设施调集增援.

column1: Commander, this is straight-up suicide. I don't normally countermand your orders but you're sending our MechWarriors to their doom here, rethink this!
column2: 指挥官，这简直是自杀. 我通常不会违抗你的命令，但你这是在把我们的机甲战士送上死路，请重新考虑!

column1: Commander, this isn't likely to be resolved by one dead diplomat. Situations like this are good for repeat business.
column2: 指挥官，单靠除掉一名外交官无法根本解决问题. 这类局势反而能带来持续的合作机会.

column1: Commander, this looks like the last staging area before we reach the primary target. Your endurance is appreciated, but this is not yet over. The infernal machine fights on.
column2: 指挥官，这似乎是抵达主要目标前的最后一个集结区了。感谢你的坚持，但事情还没结束。那台地狱般的机器仍在战斗。

column1: Commander, this mission is... insane. And I don't say that lightly. We're going to take a serious beating on this one.
column2: 指挥官，这个任务......太疯狂了. 我不是随便说的. 这次我们可要吃大亏了.

column1: Commander, this mission should be simple. A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} noble is participating in a patrol, as a show of support for the troops. She's insisted on using her ancestral family 'Mech, which is a Cicada CDA-2A. This should make eliminating her quite easy. Recognizing the danger, her handlers have sent along an extremely heavy supporting lance. If you're quick, and aggressive, you should be able to destroy her little Cicada before her escorts can react.
column2: 指挥官，这个任务应该很简单. 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族正在进行巡逻，以示对部队的支持. 她坚持使用家族传承的机甲，一部“知了”CDA-2A. 这让消灭她变得相当容易. 但考虑到危险，她的随行人员带来了一支非常强大的支援小队. 如果你行动迅速、攻势凌厉，应能在她的护卫反应过来之前摧毁她的小“知了”.

column1: Commander, this seems like a rough fight. We'll be the shield that blocks the head of the spear. If any support units do make a showing, only engage if you're in a good position after dealing with the 'Mechs.
column2: 指挥官，这看起来将是一场激烈的战斗. 我们将充当挡在矛尖前的盾牌. 如果有任何支援部队出现，只有在你处理掉机甲并处于有利位置时，再与之交战.

column1: Commander, this seems like a straight up duel. It's based in an established arena so I guess it's as good as we'll get to 'safe'.
column2: 指挥官，这看起来是一场纯粹的决斗。它设在既有的竞技场里，所以我想这已经是我们能接近“安全”的极限了。

column1: Commander, this should be a pretty simple smash and run job. I expect {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would do it themselves, but don't want to be blamed for the destruction of the goods. That's in our wheelhouse.
column2: 指挥官，这应该是一个相当简单的“破坏然后逃跑”工作. 我估计{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}本想亲自做这件事，但又不想因为摧毁了货物而受到指责. 那是我们擅长的事.

column1: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again, without too many questions. There's a bonus from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's up to you.
column2: 指挥官，这事带有政治意味，让我有些紧张. 我建议我们直接行动，处理车队，然后再离开，不要引发太多问题. 如果我们清理掉所有敌军，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会有额外奖励，但是否这样做由你决定.

column1: Commander, this will be grueling. Swap out pilots when you can.
column2: 指挥官，这会很折磨人。有机会就轮换机师。

column1: Commander, this won't be an easy task. We're going up against a well-defended enemy stronghold, and we may be outnumbered and outgunned. But if you think it's worth the risk, we'll do our best to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，这不会是件容易的事。我们要对付一座防御良好的敌方要塞，而且可能在数量与火力上都处于劣势。但如果你认为值得冒险，我们会尽力成功。

column1: Commander, we can expect to face experienced pilots in elderly 'Mechs and vehicles. But be careful; there could be more of these 'bandits' than {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is letting on.
column2: 指挥官，我们能预料到要面对有经验的机师开着老式机甲和车辆. 但要小心; 可能这伙人要比{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}透露的还多.

column1: Commander, we can't underestimate these old-timers, but fortunately we can expect poorly maintained 'Mechs. Finish them quickly.
column2: 指挥官，我们不能低估这帮老家伙，但所幸他们那些机甲保养不善. 迅速解决掉他们.

column1: Commander, we have a developing situation and need an unorthodox solution, which we're hoping your team can provide. Six hours ago, a heavily-armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force landed near one of our research facilities and took control of it. That facility is stuffed with critical intelligence and research data, all of which is being accessed and transmitted off-planet right now. We simply don't have enough local firepower to dislodge them. We've got a plan, though. We're going to bait a third party into helping us destroy the base and its intel. You're the bait.
column2: 指挥官，我们遇到一个正在发展的事态，需要非常规的解决方案. 希望你的团队能提供帮助. 六个小时前，一支全副武装的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}突击队降落并控制了我们的一处研究设施. 该设施内存有至关重要的情报和研究数据，目前正在被访问并向外传输. 我们当地的兵力不足以将其夺回. 但我们有个计划——我们要引诱第三方来帮我们摧毁该基地及其数据. 而你们就是那个诱饵.

column1: Commander, we have another agent trying to safely return to base. We need you to retrieve and deliver them to us. The agent's knowledge is crucial to providing us with strike coordinates.
column2: 指挥官，我们又有一名特工正试图安全返回基地。我们需要你去接应他们并把人交给我们。这名特工掌握的情报对提供打击坐标至关重要。

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment.  We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet.  They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface.  This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again.  There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要紧急部署. 数月来我们一直在追捕一群{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子，最终我们追踪到了这颗行星. 他们虽然已经潜伏，但今天早些时候，我们的一支轨道部队发现他们在地面上移动. 这是我们首次确认目标出现，我们希望你立即将其击毙，以防他们再次逃脱. 对作战区域还来不及进行全面勘察，你们需要在无预警状态下介入.

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要紧急部署. 数月来我们一直在追捕一群{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子，最终我们追踪到了这颗行星. 他们虽然已经潜伏，但今天早些时候，我们的一支轨道部队发现他们在地面上移动. 这是我们首次确认目标出现，我们希望你立即将其击毙，以防他们再次逃脱. 对作战区域还来不及进行全面勘察，你们需要在无预警状态下介入.

column1: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追缉一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于追踪到这颗行星。他们已转入地下，但今天早些时候我们一个轨道单位发现他们在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击目标，我们希望你能立即将其拿下，别让他们再次溜走。时间不够对行动区域做完整勘测，所以你会盲飞进去。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Commander, we need your assistance in fending off an attack on one of our facilities. This base is a critical logistical center for us, primarily for food and medicine; if we lose it, our forces in the region will be hamstrung. A major {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force has deployed to the region, and we've just gotten word that they've seized an auxiliary base near the logistics facility, and are using it as a staging point for a further assault. We need you to level that auxiliary base and cut off their offensive.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你的帮助来保卫我们的一处设施. 该基地是我们重要的后勤中心，主要储存食品和药品. 如果失守，我们在该地区的部队将陷入瘫痪. 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的主力突击队已部署到该区域. 我们刚接到消息，他们占领了后勤设施附近的一个辅助基地，并将其作为进一步进攻的集结地. 我们需要你摧毁那个辅助基地，切断他们的攻势.

column1: Commander, we perform a substantial amount of scientific research here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been sabotaging our research stations, stretching our defenses thin. We need you to To deliver Military gear to the facility where she's stationed to insure her safety.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}进行着大量科学研究. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直在破坏我们的研究站，使我们的防御力量捉襟见肘. 我们需要你向驻地设施运送军用装备，以确保她的安全.

column1: Commander, we perform a substantial amount of scientific research here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been sabotaging our research stations, stretching our defenses thin. We've just learned that their ultimate target is a key scientist in our weapons development program. They've launched an assault that we believe is intended to capture her. We need you to reach the facility where she's stationed and extract her to safety.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}进行了大量的科学研究. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直以来都在破坏我们的研究站，削弱我们的防御. 我们刚刚获悉，他们的最终目标是我们武器开发计划中的一名关键科学家. 他们已经发动了一场袭击，意图将她俘获. 我们需要你前往她所在的设施，将她撤往安全地带.

column1: Commander, we should expect heavy resistance. We might get a shot at the officer alone but his guard and support units won't be far off. You'll have to either strike hard and fast then bug out, or bring enough firepower for everyone.
column2: 指挥官，我们将遭遇顽强抵抗. 或许有机会单独狙击那名军官，但其卫队和支援单位就在附近. 要么迅猛突击后立即撤离，要么就带上足以消灭所有人的重火力.

column1: Commander, we were tracking a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard DropShip through this region when we lost its signal. Orbital scans suggest the ship made landfall here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, probably hoping to go to ground and hide the military lance it was carrying. It would be convenient if that lance were to disappear, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts believe they've isolated the area the target lance is trying to hide in.
column2: 指挥官，我们在本区域追踪一艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的豹式空投艇时失去了信号. 轨道扫描显示这艘船降落在了{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，也许是希望让其搭载的机甲小队隐蔽起来. 如果这支小队消失那就方便了，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的分析人员相信他们已经锁定了目标小队可能藏身的区域.

column1: Commander, we'll get paid whether or not we find anything, so this could be a very profitable trip.
column2: 指挥官，无论我们有没有找到目标，都会得到报酬，所以这可能是一趟非常赚钱的行动.

column1: Commander, we're planning a joint patrol operation with our allies in a dangerous region of the planet. We're expecting trouble, but these joint exercises are part of a larger diplomatic effort and it's critical that they succeed. We'd like you to provide some additional firepower to ensure that both our lance and our allied lance complete the patrol and evac intact. We're expecting major enemy resistance so plan for a heavy drop.
column2: 指挥官，我们正计划在这颗行星的一处危险区域和盟友进行一次联合巡逻行动. 我们预计会有麻烦，但这些联合演习是个更大的外交事务的一部分，它们的成功非常重要. 我们需要你提供一些额外的火力，确保我们和盟友的小队能完成巡逻并安然撤离. 我们估计敌军的抵抗会较为激烈，所以请计划好一场重型空投.

column1: Commander, we're prepared to start our assault on the ComStar facility. Before we make our move, we need you to take out that military base, so that DEST can't coordinate a response. Once that base is rubble, give us the all clear. Then we'll commence our attack, break in there, and broadcast the signal to Tor.
column2: 指挥官，我们已准备对ComStar设施发动突击. 但首先你必须摧毁那座军事基地，这样DEST就无法协调反应. 一旦基地变成废墟，给我们发出信号. 届时我们将展开进攻，突破防线，并向Tor广播信号.

column1: Commander, we're preparing a series of operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. However, before we can begin, we need a secure lodgement to bring military units and supplies down to the surface. We've identified a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility that will be ideal for our purposes. We need you to land a strike force, capture the facility, and hold it until we can bring down our people to secure the location. Because this operation is covert and on an extremely tight schedule, you'll be inserting with no topographical intel.
column2: 指挥官，我们正在准备{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一系列军事行动. 但首先需要一个安全的前沿基地，用来将军事单位和补给投送到地表. 我们已经确定一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军用设施适合我们的目的. 我们需要你空降一支打击部队，夺取这座设施，并坚守到我们的人过来确保这一地区的安全. 由于此次行动是秘密进行且时间非常紧迫，部队将在缺乏地形情报的情况下实施空降.

column1: Commander, we're starting our assault. As soon as we take out the Combine military base, the Kuritans will lose their ability to coordinate a response. That's your cue to move in and capture the ComStar facility, shut down the jamming gear DEST set up there, and get our signal broadcasting. We've got a pretty big window before Tor leaves again, so the only hurry is that our DEST friends aren't going to sit on their hands after we start shooting at them.
column2: 指挥官，我们开始进攻. 一旦端掉联合体的军事基地，栗田家将丧失协调反击的能力. 然后你必须介入并接管ComStar设施，关闭DEST设置的干扰装置，让我们的信号能够广播出去. 在Tor再次离开之前，我们有相当大的时间窗口，唯一要注意的是DEST那帮人绝不会放任不管.

column1: Commander, we're trying to safely transport injured personnel to one of our facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Unfortunately, satellite surveillance has shown {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating in the region we're expecting to move our medical convoy through. We need a mercenary lance to sweep the area and eliminate any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units. Please think of this contract as a mission of mercy.
column2: 指挥官，我们正在尝试将受伤人员安全转移到位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处设施. 不幸的是，卫星监控显示有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队在我们计划经过的区域内活动. 我们需要一支佣兵小队清扫这片区域，消灭所有的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位. 请将这份合约视为一次仁慈之举.

column1: Commander, we've been tracking a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance moving through a contested area on the planet's surface. A few hours ago, our scouts reported another lance, of unknown allegiance, on an interception course. We suspect a fight is brewing, and we'd like you to act as a spoiler. Eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, and the unknown ambushers as well. We don't want to leave any witnesses.
column2: 指挥官，我们追踪到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲小队正在穿越行星表面的一个争议地区. 几个小时前，我们的侦察兵报告有另一支身份不明的小队正截击而来. 我们怀疑一场战斗即将爆发，而我们希望你充当搅局者. 消灭这支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队，以及那些身份不明的伏击部队. 我们不想留下任何目击者.

column1: Commander, we've got a priority target for you. An elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has just been spotted by our orbital surveillance, out in the open and without any local support. What's more, they've got significant damage from a previous battle. This is an opportunity for us to severely weaken opposition forces on this planet, but we have no forces in range to make the strike. We need you to engage and destroy this lance.
column2: 指挥官，我们有个优先目标给你. 一支精锐{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队被我们的轨道监视侦测到，就在露天，而且没有任何当地支援. 而且，他们在上次战斗中受到了不少的损伤. 这是我们的机会，狠狠地削弱这个星球上的敌军，但我们在范围之内没有部队能完成这次打击. 我们需要你同这支小队交战并将之摧毁.

column1: Commander, we've got a promising lead on one of the enemy's commanding units. Oh, the possibilities for what we could learn from taking them down! Let's make it happen.
column2: 指挥官，我们找到了一条很有希望的线索，指向敌军的一支指挥单位。哦，干掉他们能让我们学到的东西，可能性太多了！让我们把它变成现实。

column1: Commander, we've just received a distress signal from one of our facilities on the planet. A team of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists have seized control of the primary base, executed the base commander, and subverted the base's defense systems. Satellite imagery tells us they're preparing for an assault on the secondary base. We need a rapid response force to eliminate their assault team, and level the seized base. Our own forces are inbound but won't get there in time to save the secondary base.
column2: 指挥官，我们刚收到来自行星上一处设施的求救信号. 一队{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已经控制了主基地，处决了基地指挥官，并篡改了基地的防御系统. 卫星图像显示，他们正在准备对次级基地发动攻击. 我们需要一支快速反应部队，消灭他们的突击队，并将被占领的基地夷为平地. 我方部队正在赶来，但无法及时赶到救援次级基地.

column1: Commander, while I imagine they will fire at targets of opportunity you shouldn't rely on support from our employer's lance. They'll be making a bee line for their extraction point.
column2: 指挥官，虽然我猜想他们会攻击出现在眼前的任何目标，但您不应指望能从我方雇主的小队那里获得支援. 他们会直奔撤离点而去.

column1: Commander, while there's a lot of fighting in the region, the supply depot is well behind the current front lines. I can't help but be suspicious about their 'no intel' claim.
column2: 指挥官，尽管该地区战斗频繁，这个补给站却远在当前前线的后方. 我不得不怀疑他们“没有情报”的说法.

column1: Commander, you have to get to the target area, get the flag and extract. Or eliminate all the opposition.
column2: 指挥官，您必须抵达目标区域，夺取旗帜并撤离. 或者消灭所有敌人.

column1: Commander, you've been referred to us for your reputation for discretion and efficiency. The job is as follows: we need you to help us break the Queen out of jail. Then extract her from the area safely.
column2: 指挥官，你因谨慎高效的声名被推荐给我们。任务如下：我们需要你帮我们把女王从监狱里弄出来。然后把她安全撤离该地区。

column1: Commander, you've been very active. Active and successful. We're developing a new type of BattleMech simulator and we need new and improved data. Sound interesting? Good, because we want to analyse how you fight {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. We've arranged for an ex-{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} pilot to fight you for a data gathering exercise.
