What do you say? You'll be well rewarded.
column2: 指挥官，你一直非常活跃，而且战绩斐然. 我们正在开发一种新型战斗机甲模拟器，需要更新、更完善的数据. 听起来有兴趣? 很好，因为我们想分析你如何对抗{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队. 我们已经安排了一名前{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师与你交战，作为数据收集演习. 你意下如何? 你将获得丰厚的报酬.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance teams have picked up what we believe to be the signature of an active patrol of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mechs engaging in reconnaissance near the borders of our holdings on this planet. This is technically not a violation of our sovereignty but it's clearly provocative. We need you to send a message, by destroying the patrol 'Mechs. Should you encounter any other {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units, there will be a bonus for destroying those as well.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的侦察小组发现了一个信号，我们相信这是一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲巡逻队的活动迹象，他们正在本星球我方领地边界附近进行侦察活动. 技术上讲这不算侵犯我们的主权，但显然具有挑衅性质. 我们需要你摧毁巡逻队的机甲，从而传递一个明确的警告讯息. 如果你遇到其他的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，摧毁它们将获得额外奖励.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is tracking an extremely heavy 'Mech with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} heraldry. This provocation is almost certainly bait for a trap; we'd like you to spring this trap. Engage the heavy 'Mech, intercept the forces {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends to defend it, and destroy all of them.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}正在追踪一台带有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}纹章的超重型机甲. 几乎可以确定这台机甲是诱饵陷阱；我们希望你能触发这个陷阱. 与这台重型机甲交战，拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}派来保护它的部队，并将所有敌军彻底消灭.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about that non-tampering clause. The contract includes twenty pages of protocol for handling the sample cases we'll be Delivering.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}对那份严禁擅自拆封的条款可不是闹着玩的. 合约里包含了足足二十页的规程，专门针对我们将要运送的那些样本箱.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about that non-tampering clause. The contract includes twenty pages of protocol for handling the sample cases we'll be recovering.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}对“禁止擅自处理”条款可不是开玩笑. 合约中包含20页关于我们将要回收的样本箱处理规范的内容.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about this being an ambitious target. Expect serious, well-armed resistance. This will not be easy.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}说“极具挑战性”可不是在开玩笑. 预计会有装备精良的、激烈的抵抗. 此次行动绝不轻松.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} needs this cleaned up quietly. Our intel shows the former commander has more loyal units than our employers will admit. This fight could escalate quickly, so stay alert.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}希望这件事能悄悄解决. 我们的情报显示，这位前任指挥官掌握的忠诚部队比雇主所承认的要多得多. 这场战斗可能会迅速升级，请保持警惕.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have always been a bother, always claiming to be superior to ours. So we arranged for a Trial of Grievance against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}, and bargined for you to fight on our behalf as a slight to them. They're enraged at the implications of this, and we're more than happy to exploit it for ourselves. For the Glory of the Clan, show {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} that even our hired mercenaries are stronger than they are.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直都是个麻烦，总是声称自己比我们更优越. 因此，我们安排了一场针对{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的争议审判 (Trial of Grievance)，并协商让你代表我们出战，以此羞辱他们. 他们对这一暗示感到愤怒，而我们非常乐意利用这一点为自己谋利. 为了氏族的荣耀，向{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}证明，就连我们雇佣的佣兵也比他们更强.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has been taking an increasingly hard line against {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-affiliated corporate interests in the Rimward Periphery; {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has recently authorized the military interdiction of assets and resources from our corporate affiliates. Their behavior is tantamount to theft, and cannot go unpunished. We need you to send a message back to them by destroying one of their munitions factories on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层在缘向外围对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}下属企业的利益集团采取了越来越强硬的立场; 最近，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层甚至授权军方对我们公司附属机构的资产和资源进行查扣. 这种行为无异于盗窃，必须予以惩罚. 我们需要你摧毁他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一座军工厂，以此回敬他们一个信息.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has arranged for a holo-vid celebrity to visit {TGT_SYSTEM.name} in the hopes of rallying the morale of the local citizens. This is an opportunity for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} psy-ops to instead make them understand how dangerous the region really is. Deploy your lance, find the target, eliminate him. Destroy his bodyguards if you feel so inclined.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经安排一位全息影视明星前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，以提升当地民众的士气. 这正是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}心理战部队发挥作用的好机会，让他们真正明白这片区域有多危险. 派出你的小队，找到目标，消灭他. 如果你想的话，也可以一并消灭他的护卫.

column1: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} wouldn't send a dropship if they didn't mean business. So if we take this job, we should stay alert down there.
column2: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}要是不打算来真的，是不会派出空投艇的. 所以如果我们接下这份任务，在地面上就必须保持警惕.

column1: Commander. Your lance versus the Galaxy Commander, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Free this world!
column2: 指挥官。你的分队对上星系指挥官，以及他敢叫来的任何增援。解放这颗行星！

column1: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在战场上的行为丝毫称不上得体，它一直把我们的医院和医疗物资作为目标. 我们正计划将物资转移到更安全的地点，但还有一支车队缺乏合适的护卫. 这就是你的任务所在. 尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队将因试图拦截我们所有分散的运输而摊开，你可以预料这支车队不会被忽视.

column1: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 违背战场上一切体面与可接受的行为，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在把目标对准我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队还没有适当护卫。这就需要你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会因试图拦截我们所有分开的货运而被摊薄，但你可以预料这一批不会无人注意。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Corbu's time-share is in a civilian housing development, not a military base. We're gonna have to hustle if we want to protect it.
column2: Corbu的分时产权在民用住宅区，而不是军事基地. 我们要是想保护它，动作就得快点了.

column1: Darius is pretending he has useful advice to offer.
column2: 达里乌斯正在假装自己有什么有用的建议可提。

column1: Davion has no way of knowing we abandoned the stasis tubes. If it were me, I'd be doing everything I could to torch the convoy, too.
column2: 戴维恩不可能知道我们已经放弃了静滞舱. 如果是我，我也会不惜一切代价焚烧车队.

column1: Davion's got to know what's on those vehicles by now. If it were me, I'd be trying to torch them at this point, too.
column2: 戴维恩现在肯定已经知道那些车上装的是什么了. 如果我是你，到了这个地步也会想放火烧掉.

column1: Defending two assets at the same time, fun times.
column2: 同时防守两处资产，真有意思。

column1: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be simple, or it could be terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
column2: 根据那里生产的东西，这可能很简单，也可能很可怕. 我也希望能更具体一些，但我们的雇主甚至不知道我们究竟在和谁作战.

column1: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be trivial or terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
column2: 根据那里生产的东西，这可能微不足道，也可能很可怕. 我也希望能更具体一些，但我们的雇主甚至不知道我们究竟在和谁作战.

column1: Descend on the Flak Jackals and punch a hole in their lines. Make them pay for the Federation citizens they've killed, Commander—it is imperative that this pirate filth learn the cost of crossing the Federated Suns.
column2: 突袭高炮豺狼，在他们防线上打穿一个洞。让他们为杀害的联邦公民付出代价，指挥官——必须让这些海盗渣滓明白冒犯联邦太阳的代价。

column1: Desperation is good for business. I'd guess a broken cease-fire means we're likely to encounter military units on our way to the pickup; stay alert, Commander.
column2: 铤而走险对生意有好处. 我猜停火协议的破裂意味着我们可能会在接应的路上遇到军队; 保持警惕，指挥官.

column1: Don't underestimate the Schrek, Commander. It's tough as hell and carries three PPCs, and has the heat capacity to fire them non-stop.
column2: 别低估“史瑞克”，指挥官. 它装甲坚固，配备3门粒子加农炮，且散热系统能支持持续射击.

column1: Drive a Wedge, Secondary Line, Attacking the Hammer, Strenghtening Anvil Response are classic military tactics to break this kind of engagement; choose or adapt what you require, Commander.
column2: 楔入突击、二线部署、攻击铁砧、加固应对是打破这类交战的经典军事战术；指挥官，按需选择或调整吧。

column1: Drop is looking good, should see our target shortly.
column2: 投放看起来不错，很快就能看到我们的目标。

column1: Due to logistical issues we have only a single heavy air asset to task with the destruction of an isolated enemy force. We'd like to hire you to fill out the unit and temporarily place our asset under your control. Arrangements like this have generally worked well for us in the past, however our liability department insists on a deposit of 50% of your negotiated compensation for the safe return of our aircraft. We realize that losses are the reality of combat, but unfortunately some commanders are less than careful with units not regularly attached to their company. I'm sure you can understand our position.
column2: 由于后勤问题，我们仅有一架重型空中单位可用于摧毁一支孤立的敌军部队. 我们想雇佣你们来补足编制，并将我们的单位暂时交由你们指挥. 这类安排在过去通常效果不错，但我们的法务部门坚持要求，为确保我方航空器安全返回，需暂扣你们协商报酬的 50% 作为押金. 我们明白战斗损失在所难免，但遗憾的是，有些指挥官对待非本连队常备单位时确实不够上心. 相信你们能理解我们的立场.

column1: Embarrassing to have an enemy stealing data right out from under your nose. I'm guessing the opfor won't have had time to get any of the facility defenses online, so at least there won't be turrets.
column2: 让一个敌人在你的鼻子底下窃取数据是很尴尬的. 我猜敌军没时间让该设施的防御力量上线，所以至少不会有炮台.

column1: Even if we can't cut the head off the Emerald Dawn, we should be able to inflict a lot of damage.
column2: 即便无法斩断翡翠黎明的首脑，我们仍能对其造成重创.

column1: Even though {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} supposedly believes the facility is 'undefended', I'm still expecting a stand-up fight, Commander.
column2: 尽管据说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}认为该工厂是“不设防的”，但我仍然认为会有一场硬仗，指挥官.

column1: Even with a portion of Dobrescu's sentries out chasing shadows in the Museum District, the Ziegelhaus will be heavily defended. You'll need to hit the structure hard, while at the same time protecting Militia HQ from an expected Steiner counterattack. Good hunting, Commander. Show Hauptmann-General Dobrescu that his excesses will not be tolerated.
column2: 即便多布雷斯库的部分驻军正被博物馆区的佯动牵制，砖房仍守备森严. 你需以重火力强攻该建筑，同时提防施泰纳部队预期中的反扑，确保民兵总部无恙. 祝狩猎顺利，指挥官. 让霍普特曼·多布雷斯库将军明白，他的暴行绝不会被姑息.

column1: Every month, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends out another supply convoy loaded with military hardware and valuable electronics. They guard it heavily, so we're not asking you to hit the main force; no sense in throwing away good mercenaries. Instead we want you to pick off the tail end of the convoy. The cargo isn't as valuable as what they send out in the vanguard, but it won't be as heavily defended. Take the convoy out, and we'll send in our people to grab whatever's still intact. We don't really want to get shot at, so we'll pay a bonus if you take out all the defenders, as well.
column2: 每个月，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}都会派出一支装满军用物资和贵重电子设备的补给车队. 他们防守严密，所以我们并不打算让你攻击主力部队; 没必要白白牺牲优秀的佣兵. 相反，我们想让你掐掉车队的尾部. 尾部的这些货物虽然不如前列的那样有价值，但也不会有重兵把守. 拿下车队后，我们会派人去回收那些还完好的物资. 我们真的不想挨枪子，所以如果你能顺便消灭所有护卫部队，我们会额外支付奖金.

column1: Every year around this time on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, we host an Trial of Position for the Sibkos. This year, we would like you to be the opening match. Your duo duel is against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Don't let our young warriors defeat you to badly.
column2: 每年大约在这个时候，我们都会在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}为训练群举办一场定位试炼. 今年，我们希望你们能作为开场赛. 你们的双人决斗将对阵{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. 别让我们的年轻战士赢得太轻松.

column1: Every year we {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}s in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continue a historic procedure with the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}s. We both field mercenaries and whoever wins claims a years worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a failed jumpship jump, so we've come to you for help.
column2: 每年，我们这些位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与当地的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}继续进行一项历史悠久的传统. 双方都会派出雇佣兵参战，获胜的一方将赢得一整年的美食和佳酿. 一直以来帮助我们的雇佣兵最近因一次失败的跃迁事故而意外全军覆没，所以我们前来寻求你们的帮助.

column1: Every year {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} continues a historic tradition with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We both field mercenaries in a Trial of Possession, and whoever wins claims a year's worth of good food and fine wines. Our usual mercenaries who help us were recently and unexpectedly wiped out by a misjump, so we have come to you for help.
column2: 每年，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}中的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}都会与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}延续一项历史传统. 双方都会派遣佣兵参加一场夺取审判 (Trial of Possession)，获胜者将获得一整年的美食和美酒. 一直帮助我们的常用佣兵最近因一次意外的跃迁故障而全军覆没，因此我们只能前来寻求你们的帮助.

column1: Expect Some of the Mercs to be less than honest.
column2: 预料部分佣兵不会那么诚实。

column1: Expect some of the Mercs to be less than honest.
column2: 预料部分佣兵不会那么诚实。

column1: Expect sustained attacks from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}
column2: 预期{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}会持续进攻

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Assault Tank Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯突击坦克锦标赛决赛。

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Heavy Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯重型锦标赛决赛。

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Heavy Tank Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯重型坦克锦标赛决赛。

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Light Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯轻型锦标赛的决赛。

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Medium Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯中型锦标赛决赛。

column1: FINAL of the Solaris Medium Tank Championship.
column2: 索拉里斯中型坦克锦标赛决赛。

column1: Failure to preserve both facilities will be recorded as a failed contract regardless of enemy losses.
column2: 未能保住两处设施将被记录为合约失败，无论敌方损失如何。

column1: Fifteen years ago we lost track of a facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence believed it had been permanently shut down. A month ago, an orbiting spy satellite picked up signs that the facility had been brought back online. Our current guess is that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was dispatched to bring the base back up to operational capacity. We'd rather not have sensitive radar backed by armed turrets and flak batteries aimed at the skies of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'd like you to clear their team out and hold the facility while our own people land to scour it for useful intel.
column2: 15年前我们失去了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里一座设施的踪迹，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员相信它已经被永久关闭了. 一个月前，一颗轨道间谍卫星探测了到这座设施重新上线的信号. 我们目前的猜测是有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}被派去让这座基地恢复了运转能力. 我们不希望武装炮台和高炮组支持的灵敏雷达瞄准着{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的天空. 我们要你清除他们的队伍，在我们自己的人降落，搜索有用的情报之前守住设施.

column1: For a fresh face you're blowing through expecations, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. More of the same, so keep at it and we'll make a champion of you yet!
column2: 作为一个新人，你的表现远超预期，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。再接再厉，我们迟早会把你打造成冠军！

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence.  Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent.  We've set up a security net to capture her.  But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs.  If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 几个月以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}一直遇到麻烦，当地人被煽动去谈论叛乱、反抗、独立. 根据顶级{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}分析师的报告，我们相信有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传者正在此地活动，煽动不满. 我们已经布下了一张安全网来捕捉她. 但我们无法覆盖所有可能的突破口，因此需要额外的一支机甲小队. 如果她企图从你们负责的区域溜走，就把她的部队打成废铁.

column1: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence. Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent. We've set up a security net to capture her. But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs. If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
column2: 几个月以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}一直遇到麻烦，当地人被煽动去谈论叛乱、反抗、独立. 根据顶级{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}分析师的报告，我们相信有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传者正在此地活动，煽动不满. 我们已经布下了一张安全网来捕捉她. 但我们无法覆盖所有可能的突破口，因此需要额外的一支机甲小队. 如果她企图从你们负责的区域溜走，就把她的部队打成废铁.

column1: For weeks now, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting territory near {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-controlled land. Previous surveys of this land shows nothing of interest, yet there they are. Whatever it is that they've found, we don't want them to have it. Go in there and destroy them.
column2: 过去几周里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队一直在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}控制的地区附近侦察. 以往对这片土地的勘测显示那里没有任何值得注意的东西，但现在他们偏偏在那里活动. 无论他们发现了什么，我们都不希望他们得到它. 去那里把他们全部消灭.

column1: For your first deployment, you will rendezvous with Azura \"Cheval\" Damestroir of the Mitchel Planetary Militia. She and her lance have been scout-hunting in northern Gauthier's wealthy Museum District, and it appears that they've caught a Lyran scout. Assist her lance in defeating it, then proceed to your next rendezvous point.
column2: 首次部署任务中，你将与米切尔行星防卫军的“骑士”阿祖拉·戴米斯托尔中尉会合. 她的小队一直在高蒂尔北部的贵族博物馆区执行侦察猎杀任务. 目前似乎已咬住一架天琴侦察机甲. 请协助其小队歼灭目标，随后前往下一集结地点.

column1: For your first deployment, you will take the field alongside Ombra and the rest of Bravo Lance. Together, you will sweep the AO for hostiles, eliminating any Capellan units you find along the way. Bravo Lance has endured a great deal of punishment over the past few months and will need your help to come through this deployment in one piece.
column2: 在你第一次出击时，你将与Ombra和Bravo小队的其他成员一起上战场. 你们将共同清扫敌军，消灭途中遇到的任何卡佩拉单位. Bravo小队在过去的几个月中承受了巨大的损失，这次任务将需要你的帮助，确保他们能顺利完成，并完好无损地回归.

column1: Foreign forces have established a forward base on our territory. We need you to go in and destroy their invasion capabilities.
column2: 外军已在我们领土上建立前进基地。我们需要你突入并摧毁他们的入侵能力。

column1: Forewarned is forearmed, sure, but it's still meant to be a trap. This could get dicey.
column2: 凡事有备无患，没错，但这终归是一个陷阱. 这可能要冒一些风险.

column1: Forward base is a little misleading, Commander. I've heard rumours it's more a spy station. Let's go find out what's going on.
column2: “前沿基地”这个说法可能有些误导，指挥官. 我听说传闻中它更像是一座间谍站. 我们去查清楚到底发生了什么.

column1: Found another group of Traitors. Let's see if they know anything about where I can find Sybil.
column2: 又发现一群叛徒。看看他们知不知道我在哪儿能找到西比尔。

column1: Frankly, Commander, I'm surprised you're not as frustrated and exhausted by this situation as I am; after all, you've had to be the boots on the ground, so to speak, of this entire farce. I've decided to forestall any possible future problems by literally bringing the big guns to bear on the situation. I have a military DropShip, the Fujin, waiting on station, and you're going to provide it with targeting information. Nephrite is in a fortified bunker, meeting right this moment with representatives from both Davion and Steiner. I'm tired of chasing them. Let's obliterate them instead.
column2: 我真的很想知道，这种情况不会像我一样让你沮丧和消耗，指挥官.毕竟，在整场闹剧中，你必须做腿部工作.我已经决定，绕过所有潜在问题，引入真正意义上的重型枪支. Fujin，一艘军用空投艇，处于待命状态，您将接管目标获取. Nephrite 在一个加固的掩体中，目前正在与戴维恩和施泰纳家族的代表会面.我不想再去打猎软玉了.相反，我建议彻底销毁.

column1: From what I've heard, we're looking at a seasoned Solaris veteran, Commander. Make sure we're sending our best. We can't afford to pull punches here.
column2: 据我所知，我们要面对的是一位经验丰富的索拉里斯老手，指挥官。务必派出我们最好的人。这里可不能手下留情。

column1: Front lines, Commander --- and there's serious cash on the table for taking these guys down.  Just remember: don't get dead before you collect.
column2: 前线，指挥官——而且干掉这些家伙有一大笔钱可赚. 记住: 在拿到钱之前别死掉.

column1: Garrilac may seem like kind of a joke, but you shouldn't underestimate Mason's Marauders. I've heard stories about their effectiveness on the field.
column2: 加瑞拉克或许像个笑话，但你不该低估梅森的掠夺者. 我听过他们在战场上的威名.

column1: Garrilac's lance is on the ground and waiting for you. Destroy them.
column2: 加瑞拉克的编队已着陆等候各位. 摧毁他们.

column1: Get ready, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Our 'Mechs are about to soak up a lot of incoming fire.
column2: 准备好，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 我们的机甲即将承受大量 来袭火力.

column1: Get ready, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. This is shaping up to be an interesting day.
column2: 做好准备，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这将是非常有趣的一天.

column1: Get to Reflux Point! Don't forget to change into bike mode for Movement modifiers.
column2: 前往逆流点! 别忘了变换为机车模式以获得移动修正.

column1: Gettin' this prison be goin ta be rough sailin'. I don't 'ave much faith that th' warden will 'ave any useful information anyway.
column2: 把这个监狱弄到手会是趟艰难的航行。我也不太相信那个典狱长会有什么有用的情报。

column1: Getting food and medical supplies delivered is a very humanitarian goal.
column2: 把食物与医疗物资送到，是非常人道主义的目标。

column1: Glad you could join us, Commander. The Local Government Leader has decided to try and take one of our bases. I want you to take these mechs and put them through their paces.
column2: 很高兴你能加入我们，指挥官. 当地政府首脑决定试图夺取我们的一处基地. 我要你驾驶这些机甲，让它们经历实战考验.

column1: Glad you're still with us. Since setting up this outpost we have been constantly harassed by the Red Corsair and her pirate goons. They must be making a tidy profit since she can afford some seriously advanced technlogy. Let's protect the base and give our personnel a chance to recuperate
column2: 很高兴你还活着。自打建起这座前哨，我们就不断遭到红海盗和她的海盗喽啰骚扰。他们一定赚得盆满钵满，因为她买得起一些相当先进的技术。让我们守住基地，给手下人一个喘息的机会

column1: Good day, Commander. Mission intelligence is as follows: conditions on the ground do not allow for dropping 'Mechs of heavy tonnage, or particularly large numbers of them. You're being tasked with deploying a fast strike force into a hostile zone. Bring the best you can squeeze into a small package.
column2: 日安，指挥官。任务情报如下：地面条件不允许投放重型吨位的机甲，也不允许投放特别多的数量。你的任务是把一支快速打击部队投放进一处敌意区域。在有限载荷内塞进你所能带的最好的东西。

column1: Good evening, Commander. One of my minions has the details of the base that we would like removed. With prejudice. I need you to retrieve them.
column2: 晚上好，指挥官。我的一名手下手里有那座我们希望拆除的基地的详情——不留余地。我需要你去把它们取回来。

column1: Good on you for being on the right side of this conflict, {COMMANDER.Callsign}… I know it couldn't have been an easy decision. And speaking of difficult matters, you're about to have a fight on your hands. House Liao has sent a detachment of 'Mechs to finish your job for you, and unfortunately, Razorback Company is no position to deal with 'em.
column2: 你能站在这场冲突正确的一方，值得称赞，{COMMANDER.Callsign}……我知道这个决定不容易。说到棘手的事——你马上就有仗要打了。廖氏家族派出了一队机甲来替你完成任务，可惜剃刀背连可没能力应付他们。

column1: Good times, large explosions, maybe a plot twist. Sounds like a fun time.
column2: 好时光、大爆炸，也许还有个剧情转折。听着挺有意思。

column1: Great now we are going to free an AI that has gone mad. Doesn't anyone take the holovid warnings from the late 20th century seriously.
column2: 好极了，现在我们要去释放一个已经疯掉的AI。难道没人把20世纪末那些全息影像警告当真吗。

column1: Guerillas on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} are surprisingly well-armed and well-supplied, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are taking unacceptable losses in recent engagements. We've tracked the weapons back to a hidden supply base operated by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. That base needs to be destroyed.
column2: 出乎意料的是，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的游击队都是全副武装，补给齐全，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在最近的交战中蒙受了难以接受的损失. 我们追踪武器追溯到了一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}运作的隐藏补给基地. 必须摧毁那座基地.

column1: Guerrilla strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the guerrillas and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the guerrilla forces.
column2: 游击队针对我们设施的袭击越来越多了，根据我们的情报来看，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助游击队，以轻武器、炸药和医疗用品的形式提供后勤支援. 我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，并且在它抵达游击队之前就消灭它.

column1: Guerrilla strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the guerrillas and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the guerrilla forces.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 针对我们设施的游击袭击有所增加，我们的情报说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助这些游击队，并以轻武器、炸药和医疗物资的形式提供后勤支援。我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}补给车队，在它抵达游击队之前将其摧毁。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Guess the surveillance picked up something sensitive that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would prefer stay a secret.
column2: 我猜这次监视发现了一些敏感的东西，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}更希望这些信息保持机密.

column1: Guess this facility is shutting down. Good news for us though.
column2: 看来这处设施要关停了。不过这对我们是好消息。

column1: Guess we will go in and capture the base. Should provide more information on what these Pirates are actually doing.
column2: 我想我们就进去夺取基地吧。应该能提供更多关于这些海盗到底在干什么的信息。

column1: Handle this and we're done here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 处理好这件事，那么我们在此的任务就完成了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}.

column1: Have you seen the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} holo-vid show \"Mercenaries\"? Yes, we're being asked to kill its star, Brock Armstrong. He knows his way around a 'Mech and will have two full lances as escorts.
column2: 你看过{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的全息影像节目《雇佣兵！》吗? 是的，我们被要求杀掉其主演布洛克·阿姆斯特朗. 他精通机甲操作，并有两支完整机甲小队护航.

column1: He sounded awfully sure of himself. Let's wipe the smile off of that smug son of a bitch's face.
column2: 他听起来自信得令人不安. 让我们把那个自鸣得意的混蛋脸上的笑容抹掉.

column1: Headshot Avoidance
column2: 避免爆头

column1: Heh, sounds like we are to be the opening act, Commander.
column2: 嘿，听起来我们是开胃菜，指挥官.

column1: Here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been an oppressive presence for some time, which has led to a number of revolutionary leaders rising up from the common people to strike at the status quo. One such leader has been targeted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} for elimination. It's in the interest of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership that this rabble rouser survives.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}长期以来一直施行压迫统治，这导致了一些革命领袖从平民中崛起以打破现状. 其中一位领袖已成为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的清除目标. 确保这位革命者活着符合{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层的利益.

column1: Here we go chasing ghosts again, Commander. I think she will have an aneurysm if we run into Jimmy.
column2: 又来了，我们又在追鬼影，指挥官。我想我们要是撞上吉米，她会气得血管爆掉。

column1: Hey, Commander {Commander.LastName}. We just so happen to have a four-man gladiator team who are looking to cut their teeth in some new 'Mechs. Obviously, we can't bang up our own metal - we need that stuff! But you? Well, we can throw a handful of cash at you if you want to step in and help them practice.
column2: 嘿，指挥官{Commander.LastName}。我们恰好有一支四人角斗小队想在新机甲上练练牙口。显然，我们不能把自己那身铁皮弄坏——我们还需要它！但你呢？嗯，如果你想上场帮他们练练，我们可以给你扔一把现金。

column1: His 'Mech may be heavy, Commander, but I don't see a lot of 'Mech repair facilities out here, so this might not be as difficult as it looks.
column2: 他的机甲或许很重，指挥官，但我没看到这附近有多少机甲维修设施，所以事情可能没有看起来那么棘手.

column1: Hits Bypass Armor
column2: 命中无视装甲

column1: Hits Ruin Aim
column2: 命中破坏了瞄准

column1: Hits Slow Movement
column2: 命中减缓了移动

column1: Hold the base while ComStar units arrive.
column2: 在康星部队抵达前守住基地。

column1: Hold the line for as long as you can!
column2: 尽可能久地守住阵线!

column1: Holy hell, they want us to fight a DropShip with our mechs? They have got to be kidding, but that's why they're paying us the big bucks.
column2: 我去! 他们居然想让我们用机甲去对付一艘空投艇? 他们一定是在开玩笑吧? 不过，这就是他们愿意给我们开出高价的原因.

column1: Hope you're holding up okay, Commander. We got word that a caravan carrying an ally of ours was near the area where you were fighting the pirate leadership. We now need you to retrieve an agent of ours who infiltrated their ranks.
column2: 希望你撑得住，指挥官。我们得到消息，一支载着我们一位盟友的商队曾在你与海盗首领交战区域附近。我们现在需要你去接回我们一名已潜入他们内部的干员。

column1: Hopefully they keep that stuff to themselves, so we don't get involved.
column2: 希望他们能自己保管好那些东西，这样我们就不会卷进去了.

column1: Hopefully we have bought the clan leaders enough time to gather.
column2: 但愿我们已经为部族首领们争取到足够时间聚集。

column1: Hopefully we'll not be surprised as our employers.
column2: 希望我们不会像雇主那样被打个措手不及.

column1: Horvat's going to stack the odds against us, just like Agent Jones said. If we're going to do this, our MechWarriors will have to be ready.
column2: 霍瓦特肯定会像Jones特工说的那样给我们设局. 如果真要行动，我们的机甲战士必须严阵以待.

column1: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous.  We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site.  Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

column1: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
column2: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

column1: House Liao's occupation force is moving on our Mech Bay in force, Commander. I know that you've had no time to refit or repair your BattleMechs, but I'm going to need your assistance all the same. In light of this, I've authorized the deployment of a Steiner asset—the very rare and precious BattleMech that you just delivered to this site—to assist you, with one of my own MechWarriors to pilot it.
column2: 指挥官，廖氏家族的占领军正大举逼近我们的机甲库。我知道你还没来得及改装或修理你的战斗机甲，但我还是需要你的协助。鉴于此，我已授权部署一件施泰纳资产——你刚送到这里的、极为稀有珍贵的战斗机甲——来协助你，并由我的一名机甲战士驾驶。

column1: House Steiner has constructed a military stronghold within our territorial boundaries. We have artillery in place to destroy it, but we need you to place targeting beacons in key locations before we can pull the trigger. While you work, a mercenary lance from Gwydion Company will keep any Steiner reinforcements off your backs.
column2: 施泰纳家族在我们的领土内建立了一个军事要塞. 我们已部署炮兵准备将其摧毁，但在开火前，需要你们在关键位置布设信标. 在你们执行任务期间，格威迪恩公司的一支雇佣兵机甲小队将负责阻挡施泰纳的任何增援部队，确保你们无后顾之忧.

column1: House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so be careful. When the Capellans pick you up on their sensors, I imagine that all hell is gonna break loose.
column2: 施泰纳家族根本不应该在这个星系出现，所以小心点. 当卡佩拉人通过他们的传感器发现你时，我想一切混乱都要来了.

column1: How relevant can intel from the ass end of nowhere really be? We're still being paid, so I suppose it doesn't matter, honestly.
column2: 从这鸟不拉屎的地方收集到的情报能有多大价值? 老实说，反正有人付钱，所以我想这并不重要.

column1: Hunt down and eliminate Dominik \"Whistler\" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that his personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.
column2: 追踪并消灭“口哨客”多米尼克·赵. 他是“高炮胡狼”的领袖之一. 注意，他的个人战斗机甲配备了大量失落科技武器和装备.

column1: Hunt down and eliminate Orchid \"Thresher\" Zhao, one of the two leaders of the Flak Jackals. Be advised that her personal BattleMech is equipped with LosTech weaponry and equipment.
column2: 追踪并消灭“长尾鲨”奥基德·赵. 她是“高炮胡狼”的领袖之一. 注意，她的个人战斗机甲配备了大量失落科技武器和装备.

column1: I am getting odd IFF readings from the planet, Commander. It looks like they have been... altered.
column2: 指挥官，我从那颗行星上收到古怪的敌我识别读数。看起来它们被……改动过。

column1: I am going to put this ship in a bottle, even if it kills him. That little bastard stole from me, made me chase him all around the Sphere, and now he taunts me from inside a base. Use extreme prejudice eliminating him.
column2: 我要把这艘船装进瓶子里，哪怕这要了他的命。那小混蛋偷了我的东西，让我绕着内天体追了他一圈，现在他还躲在一座基地里嘲弄我。用极端手段消灭他。

column1: I am not sure if our reputation with Pirates is going up or down right now Commander.
column2: 我不确定我们现在在海盗那里的名声是在上升还是下降，指挥官。

column1: I am so glad you answered our call, Commander. These Clanners know no mercy and they have just about driven us underground at this point. I trust you are familiar with doing violence and we'll leave the small details of this operation to you.
column2: 我很高兴你响应了我们的召唤，指挥官。这些氏族人毫无怜悯，他们此刻几乎把我们逼到地下去了。我相信你熟悉动武这套，行动的小细节就交给你了。

column1: I am surprised we have enough forces to complete this, Commander.
column2: 我很惊讶我们还有足够的兵力完成这件事，指挥官。

column1: I approve of your choice of 'Mechs for this mission, Commander. This ought to be just the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.
column2: 我赞成你为这次任务选择的机甲，指挥官. 这应该正是乔斯总督所希望展示的力量. 另外，我还有额外的支援可以提供，多亏了普拉斯将军. 不过，你需要先清除防空小队，以便支援机甲可以部署. 记住: 我们在轨道上的空投艇Gungnir，只能在行星上空停留有限的时间进行火力支援. 动作要快，指挥官.

column1: I be glad we see eye ta eye commander. Let's burn this prison ta th' ground 'n show th' Planetary Government no one pilfers from me. I be sick o' this goose chase. Let's destroy 'n loot me piece.
column2: 我很高兴我们看法一致，指挥官。咱们把这座监狱烧成灰，让行星政府知道没人能从我这偷东西。我受够这场追捕了。咱们毁掉那玩意儿，把属于我的那份拿走。

column1: I can only imagine what Yang is going to say to the idea of infecting one of our 'Mechs with hostile code.
column2: 我只能去想象一下，对于让我们的一部机甲感染恶意代码这主意，杨会怎么说.

column1: I can only imagine what kind of junk-heaps these locals are going to be piloting. Bring along something tough, Commander.
column2: 我只能想象这些当地人将要驾驶什么样的垃圾. 带上些硬货吧，指挥官.

column1: I can only imagine what kind of junk-heaps these locals are going to be piloting. I'm expecting Urbies. Bring something tough, Commander.
column2: 我只能想象这些当地人将要驾驶什么样的垃圾. 我预计是“城市”. 带上些硬货吧，指挥官.

column1: I can't imagine any use for those guns in this system that isn't bad, but I suppose that's to be expected.
column2: 我实在想不出这批武器在本星系能有什么正当用途——虽然这也在意料之中.

column1: I can't imagine why our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends didn't let us know they'd invited a bunch of wealthy merchants to visit. We'd have prepared a welcoming party for them at the spaceport. Instead, it looks like we're going to have to meet up with them out in the field. Luckily, we know where they are; the drivers of their little convoy were pretty happy with the payoff we gave them. We want you to go down there and escort our new friends to safety.
column2: 我想不出为什么我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}朋友不让我们知道他们邀请了一大群富有的商人来访问. 我们本可以在太空港为他们准备一个欢迎会. 相反，看来我们得在野外会见他们了. 幸运的是，我们知道他们在哪儿; 他们那支小车队的司机们对我们付给他们的款项相当满意. 我们要你下到那里，护送我们的新朋友前往安全地带.

column1: I don't believe that \"mission of mercy\" line for a second, but there isn't anything here to be concerned about.
column2: 我一点也不相信什么“仁慈之举”，不过看起来这里倒也没有什么值得担心的.

column1: I don't buy the 'ancestral fortress' part of this, but the legal maneuverings check out. Commander, a merc company coming in could resolve this quickly and prevent a large-scale conflict.
column2: 我不太认同所谓的“祖传堡垒”说法，但法律操作没问题. 指挥官，一家佣兵公司介入可以迅速解决问题，并防止大规模的冲突.

column1: I don't have to tell you that speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: I don't know what kind of show of force they were expecting aside from \"Boom, your base is gone,\" Commander.
column2: 我知道?不，他们还希望展示什么样的武力，指挥官——除了“轰，你的基地坏了！”

column1: I don't like fighting other mercenaries, but that's the nature of the business.
column2: 我不喜欢和其他雇佣兵作战，但这就是生意.

column1: I don't like the idea of jumping into a battle with this little preparation or intelligence, Commander. Be careful with this one.
column2: 我不喜欢这样没有准备或没有情报就跳进一场战斗，指挥官. 请小心这次的任务.

column1: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
column2: 这情况听着不妙，指挥官. 没有卫星覆盖就意味着没有地形情报. 我们将进入一个没有地图的未知区域.

column1: I don't like the sound of this.
column2: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子。

column1: I don't like the unspecified 'some cargo', Commander, but whatever it is, it's probably just as bad if left in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hands.
column2: 我不喜欢那个未具体说明的“一些货物”，指挥官，但无论那是什么，大概总好过让它们落入{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的手上.

column1: I don't trust Hadley—or Sweeney, or whatever her name really is—for a second, but she should be secure enough in the repair bay's makeshift brig. My advice? Let's go in expecting a double cross, and let's monitor Hadley's cell. At the first sign of trouble, we double back and get her to Lady Cunningham.
column2: 我一秒也不信任哈德利——或者说斯威尼，不管她真名叫什么——但她待在维修舱那个临时牢房里应该足够安全。我的建议？我们进去时就假定会被摆一道，并盯住哈德利的牢房。一有麻烦的迹象，我们就折返把她交给坎宁安女士。

column1: I doubt they'll have been able to get more than a single backup lance over to this remote island in the time they'll have before we show up, guns blazing.
column2: 我怀疑，在我们全力进攻这里之前，他们根本来不及向这个偏远岛屿增援超过一支后备机甲小队.

column1: I get worried when enemies make stupid choices like moving in the open. It makes me think we're about to have a trap sprung on us.
column2: 当敌人做出愚蠢的选择，例如在开阔地移动时，我会感到担心. 这让我觉得会有陷阱在等着我们.

column1: I have a bad feeling about this, Commander. If they want that 'Mech torched, I'm guessing it's relatively powerful. Be careful.
column2: 我对此有一种不好的感觉，指挥官. 如果他们想要烧掉那部机甲，那我猜它相当强大. 多加小心.

column1: I have a sneaky suspicion Jimmy has some serious Plot armor Commander.
column2: 我有个偷偷的猜测，吉米身上有很厚的剧情装甲，指挥官。

column1: I have to hand it to this guy. At least he cares enough about his son to teach him a thing or two. Even if that means a knock on the head... or two.
column2: 我不得不佩服这家伙. 至少他对儿子上心到愿意教他点东西. 哪怕这意味着要吃一记……或者几记当头棒喝.

column1: I have tracked Sybil and her last supporters to this planet. I need her eliminated.
column2: 我已追踪西比尔和她最后的支持者到这颗行星。我需要她死。

column1: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations it's not meant to be a real fight. This {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor is crazy. Let's uphold the truth... for a price.
column2: 我真不知道该说什么，指挥官. 人们说想要“与指控斗争”时，可不是指真的要打架. 这个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督真是疯了. 那就让我们捍卫真相吧……当然，得收点钱.

column1: I just don't know, Commander. When people say they want to 'fight' allegations, it's not meant to be a real fight. These {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Clanners are crazy. Everything is a fight for them.
column2: 我只是不太确定，指挥官. 当人们说要“与指控斗争”时，那通常不是指真正的打斗. 这些{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的氏族成员都疯了. 对他们来说，什么事都能变成一场战斗.

column1: I know this was your call, Commander, but frankly I'd prefer to just torch their \"materials\" and leave. This is vile.
column2: 我知道，这是你的决定，指挥官，但说实话，我宁愿把这些“材料”烧掉，尽快离开这里. 这真的很糟糕.

column1: I know what your man has done. Lady Marina may be fool enough to trust in mercenaries, but I've had agents watching you from the start—and now I find my suspicions confirmed. Prepare yourself to face the full wrath of the Liao Reserves, Commander—I will claim the contents of that vault you so covet, and then I will bury you in it.
column2: 我知道你的人做了什么。玛丽娜女士也许蠢到去信任雇佣兵，但我从一开始就派了特工监视你——如今我发现我的怀疑得到了证实。准备好面对廖氏预备队的全力怒火吧，指挥官——我要夺取你如此觊觎的那个金库里的东西，然后我会把你埋在里面。

column1: I need you to take down the pirate Dropship before they can take off. This could be quite dangerous, but it may be our only hope of saving the Sphere.
column2: 我需要你在那艘海盗空投艇起飞之前把它拿下。这可能会相当危险，但这也许是我们拯救内天体的唯一希望。

column1: I prefer to operate solo, but if they want us to play babysitter, I suppose that's what we'll do.
column2: 我更喜欢单独行动，但如果他们要我们做回临时保姆，我想我们也只能照做了.

column1: I really don't like going in with this little information, Commander. This seems very rushed and poorly prepared.
column2: 我真的不喜欢在信息这么少的情况下行动，指挥官. 这看起来非常仓促，准备也很不充分.

column1: I really like 'loud and fatal' as a job description, Commander. I may get it put on a plaque.
column2: 指挥官，我真的很喜欢用“响亮而致命”来形容我们的工作. 我要把它写在牌匾上.

column1: I really think the pirates are in for a surprise - or a laugh.
column2: 我真觉得这些海盗要大吃一惊了——或者大笑一场。

column1: I refuse to believe it's going to be that easy, Commander. Keep your eyes peeled; this seems too simple.
column2: 我不相信会这么容易，指挥官. 睁大你的眼睛……这看起来太简单了.

column1: I still believe that this mission would be more effective if you had chosen to bring heavier 'Mechs, but the orbital strike should still be the show of force that Margrave Joss was hoping for. Also, I have additional support to provide, thanks to Kommandant General Plath; you'll need to clear the antiair defenses before the support lance can land, though. Remember: Gungnir, our DropShip, can remain on station to fire at the planet only for a limited time. Move quickly, Commander.
column2: 我仍然认为如果你选择携带更重的机甲进行这次任务会更有效，但轨道轰炸应该仍能展现出乔斯总督所希望的力量. 此外，多亏了普拉斯将军，我还有额外的支援可以提供. 不过，你需要先清除防空小队，以便支援的机甲可以部署. 请记住: 我们在轨道上的Gungnir 空投艇，只能在行星上空停留有限的时间进行火力支援. 动作要快，指挥官.

column1: I still believe this approach is a mistake, Commander, but I'll continue to defer to your judgment. For both our sakes, let's hope you're right and that capturing this base will be a better long-term plan than simply obliterating it. The ISF reports that the facility is defended by both Davion 'Mechs and turrets, which strongly suggests there's something there worth protecting. You'll need to eliminate any hostile forces before my people can move in and sweep the base for our target.
column2: 我仍然认为这种方式是个错误，指挥官，但我还是会听从你的判断. 为了我们双方着想，希望你是对的. 从长远来看，占领这个基地比直接摧毁它要更好. ISA的报告称该设施由戴维恩家族的机甲和炮台共同防御，这强烈表明那里有值得保护的东西. 在我的人进入基地搜寻目标之前，你需要消灭所有敌对力量.

column1: I still can't believe that we don't even know who we're fighting against. It is what it is, I guess.
column2: 我仍然无法相信，我们甚至都不知道自己在与谁作战. 算了，就这样吧.

column1: I suppose the target probably should have known what he was getting into. Lay down with dogs...
column2: 我想目标已经知道他接下来会发生什么. 近墨者黑......

column1: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist
column2: 我觉得自己已经数不清这到底有多少层背叛了. 这算是四重反间计吗? 这位科学家肯定不简单.

column1: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist.
column2: 我觉得我已经搞不清这里有多少层的背叛了. 这算是四重背叛吗? 这科学家可真不简单.

column1: I think even their hype-man is starting to believe himself. We might actually have a shot here, Commander.
column2: 我觉得连他们的吹鼓手都开始信自己了。这一场我们也许真有机会，指挥官。

column1: I wish I could offer you more time to rearm and reequip, Commander, but I'm not sure how much longer the Maskirovka team can hold out. It's only a matter of time before someone looks into the hangar where my people are hiding and the shooting starts. We need to take that facility before the Davion forces realize they have unwelcome guests. Thankfully they don't seem to have gone on higher alert, so the base should be relatively undefended, at least as far as any facility on the Federated Suns border can be undefended.
column2: 我很想给你更多的时间来整备军械，指挥官，但我不确定欺敌局小队还能坚守多久. 一旦有人搜查我方人员藏匿的机库，交火便不可避免. 我们必须在戴维恩部队察觉异常前夺取该设施. 幸运的是，敌军似乎尚未提升警戒等级，所以基地防御相对较弱——至少就恒星联邦边境设施的常态而言.

column1: I wonder what we did to get this grievance? Was it that stuff I did on Tuesday?
column2: 我想知道我们到底做了什么才招来这场争议? 难道是我星期二干的那件事?

column1: I wouldn't buy the stuff about an honest fight, Commander. Some of these fights are known for audience participation.
column2: 我不太相信那套关于公平对决的说法，指挥官。有些比赛以观众参与而闻名。

column1: I wouldn't count on the defenses being particularly weak, Commander. Like the lady said, this is a border world, so everything's going to be bristling with guns and 'Mechs.
column2: 我不会指望防御特别薄弱，指挥官. 正如那位女士所说，这是个边境世界. 所以，一切都会布满枪炮和机甲.

column1: I'd prefer to handle things ourselves, but if they want us to play babysitter, I suppose that's what we'll do.
column2: 我更喜欢亲手掌控局势，但要是他们要我们做回临时保姆，我想我们也只能照做了.

column1: I'd say this is a terrible idea, but those Cataphracts are beasts. Just make sure it doesn't get killed, or we don't get paid.
column2: 我得说这是个糟糕的主意，但“重装骑兵”机甲确实是头猛兽. 只是务必保证它别被干掉，否则我们拿不到报酬.

column1: I'd usually expect well trained pilots with expensive gear Commander, but this time I'm not so sure. You'll have to assess the situation for yourself, but all this 'training' of theirs might just be nonsense. As always, use caution. We can't fail now.
column2: 指挥官，通常我会预期遇到训练有素、装备昂贵的机师，但这次我不太确定。你只能自己判断局势了，而他们那套“训练”可能纯属胡扯。一如既往，谨慎行事。我们现在不能失败。

column1: I'll ask the obvious question: how do we know they won't just keep the bioweapons for themselves? Then again, if we second guessed every job, we'd be broke.
column2: 我要问一个很明显的问题: 我们怎么知道他们不会仅仅把这些生物武器留给自己呢? 再说一遍，如果每个活我们都要马后炮一番，那我们早就破产了.

column1: I'm assuming that 'hardware' means 'weapons', Commander. This should be a fairly standard base defense.
column2: 我假设'硬件'意味着'武器'，指挥官. 那这儿应该有着相当标准的基地防御力量.

column1: I'm dropping you at the Baumann Group's armory, Commander. Hit it hard enough, and the prison's garrison should come running, clearing the way for the Moderbjörn to rescue Captain Magorian with its drones.
column2: 我正在鲍曼集团军械库降落，指挥官. 只要攻击力度足够，监狱驻军就会赶过来，为“熊妈妈”用无人车营救马格里安船长清除障碍.

column1: I'm glad she has confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out for Grim; she should be a priority target.
column2: 我很高兴她对我们有信心，但坦白说，我更希望战场上有一些增援。留心格里姆；她应该是个优先目标。

column1: I'm glad that we're gonna have Jailbird and her lance on our side for this, but we should keep our eyes open for Cheval. She didn't sound like she was planning on sitting this one out quietly.
column2: 我很高兴“监狱鸟”和她的小队能加入我们，但我们要留意“骑士”. 她听起来可不像打算袖手旁观的样子.

column1: I'm glad that you decided to listen to reason, Commander—you'd be surprised how many so-called mercenaries lack the savvy to jump on an opportunity like this when it presents itself. Now, the LosTech cache that I'm sending you after is close to our location, but there's a catch: it's sealed away in a defunct mineshaft. I've got a way in, though. Follow my instructions, and we'll all get rich.
column2: 我很高兴你决定听从理性，指挥官——你会惊讶地发现，有多少所谓的雇佣兵在机会来临时缺乏抓住它的精明。现在，我派你去找的那处失传科技储藏点离我们位置很近，但有个条件：它被封在一处废弃的矿井里。不过我有进去的办法。照我的指示做，我们都能发财。

column1: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field.
column2: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我更希望在战场上有些增援。

column1: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out for Song; they should be a priority target.
column2: 我很高兴，他们对我们有如此大的信心，但老实说，我更喜欢战场上有增援. 留意我们的主要目标，宋.

column1: I'm glad they have confidence in us, but frankly I'd prefer some reinforcements on the field. Keep an eye out.
column2: 我很高兴他们对我们有信心，但说实话，我宁愿战场上有些增援. 保持警惕.

column1: I'm glad to hear that, Pillow. An easier mission is always more favorable to us. Let's get in there and take out their production facilities.
column2: 听到这个我很高兴，枕头。任务轻松些对我们总是更有利。我们进去把他们的生产设施端掉。

column1: I'm glad we're gonna have Cheval and her lance on our side for this, but we should keep our eyes open for Jailbird. She didn't sound like she was planning on sitting this one out quietly.
column2: 我很高兴“骑士”和她的小队能加入我们，但我们要留意“监狱鸟”. 她听起来可不像打算袖手旁观的样子.

column1: I'm guessing our employers know that a hammer blow is coming, so we'll expected to take the brunt of the attack until their reinforcements arrive on the field.
column2: 我猜我们的雇主知道一场激战就要来了，所以期待我们在他们的援军赶到战场前首当其冲.

column1: I'm guessing the 'technology' is some broken piece of scrap, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is willing to pay to recover it. We go in and get out before they even know what hit them.
column2: 我猜这项“技术”只是一些破铜烂铁，但是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}愿意付钱来回收它. 我们在敌人还没反应过来之前就进去然后出来.

column1: I'm guessing these 'civilians' are some kind of covert operatives, for this much metal to be put on the field to extract them.
column2: 我猜这些平民应该是什么秘密特工吧，要不然怎么会投入这么多机甲去把他们救出来.

column1: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.
column2: 今天真是美好的一天，指挥官. 你知道为什么吗? 我刚从我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的朋友那里拿到了最新的后勤数据. 结果发现，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地里，将堆满极一些其珍贵的货物——正是我们想要弄到手的东西. 你占领基地，我们来洗劫，这样我们双方都能拿到报酬.

column1: I'm not at liberty to give you many details on this sensitive matter. What I can tell you is as of last night we lost contact with a site housing a very valuable witness-in-protection in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. If this has anything to do with the reason for protection I'd expect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} groups to be involved. Get there and figure out what's going on.
column2: 关于这件敏感事务，我无权向你透露太多细节. 我能告诉你的是，昨晚我们与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系一处关押着极重要受保护证人的地点失去了联系. 如果这与需要保护的原因有关，我预计会有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的势力卷入其中. 赶过去，查明情况.

column1: I'm not comfortable with how little information we have about the enemy forces, Commander.
column2: 我们掌握的敌军情报如此之少，我对此感到不安，指挥官.

column1: I'm not excited about taking on someone with The Professional's reputation with an under-strength lance, but at least we'll have the element of surprise.
column2: 我对于用一支吨位不足的小队去对付“专家”这样声名在外的目标并不乐观，但至少我们还能保有突袭的优势.

column1: I'm not expecting a lot of defenders, Commander, but there are likely to be turrets. There's a bonus if we wipe out the base garrison as well; that's your call, as the situation on the ground develops.
column2: 我预计不会有很多的守卫，指挥官，但是可能会有炮台. 如果我们把基地守备部队也清理了，就会有奖金; 根据地面形势的发展，由你来决定吧.

column1: I'm not questioning your judgement about bringing a single 'Mech against this guy. All I'm saying is I could lose a lot of money on the company betting pool if this goes South.
column2: 我不是在质疑你带一台机甲去对付这家伙的判断。我只是说，要是这事搞砸了，我在公司的赌盘上会输很多钱。

column1: I'm not sure I like the idea of playing babysitter to a bunch of regulars, Commander, but I like the idea of being outgunned even less.
column2: 指挥官，我不确定自己喜不喜欢做一群正规军的临时保姆，可我更不喜欢在火力上居于劣势.

column1: I'm not sure I necessarily follow the ISF's logic here, Commander, but we're being paid to shoot the people they tell us to shoot.
column2: 我不知道，我是否会完全遵循 ISA 的逻辑，指挥官，但我们得到报酬，射杀那些想要他们射杀的人.

column1: I'm not sure the outcome will be what they want, but I don't specialize in interstellar politics. It sounds like a declaration of war to me so be prepared for more than a little resistance.
column2: 我不确定结果会不会如他们所愿，但我不擅长星际政治. 在我听来，这更像是一场宣战，所以要做好面对强烈抵抗的准备.

column1: I'm not sure why {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is being so circumspect, but they don't pay us to ask questions. There's a bonus for us if we eliminate any witnesses.
column2: 我不确定{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}为什么要如此谨慎，但他们可不是花钱让我们提问的. 如果我们消灭所有目击者，还能得到额外的奖金.

column1: I'm pleased we could agree that the direct approach is likely to be the most effective. The facility that the ISF believes Nephrite is hiding in is in a god-awful frozen wasteland. It shouldn't be too heavily defended, but there will probably be turrets. Remember that we need that facility flattened. Once the place is nothing but rubble, my people will search the ruins for our Rasalhague friend and confirm the kill. And then we can all go home, and honestly, I cannot wait. This place is wretched.
column2: 我很高兴我们能达成一致，认为直接进攻可能是最有效的. ISA认为软玉藏身的设施在一个该死的冰封荒原里. 那里的防御应该不会太强，但可能有炮台. 记住，我们需要把那座设施夷为平地. 等那地方只剩一片瓦砾，我的人就会在废墟中搜索我们那位蛇夫座的朋友并确认击杀. 然后我们都可以回家了，说实话，我已经等不及了. 这鬼地方糟透了.

column1: I'm so pleased that you've chosen to work with us, Commander. You destroyed one of our facilities at the behest of House Marik; it seems only fair that you do the same for us. Turnabout is fair play, after all. The facility will be minimally guarded, and your pay will be extremely generous.
column2: 我很高兴你选择与我们合作，指挥官. 你受马里克家族的指使摧毁了我们的一处设施，那么，为我们做同样的事似乎才公平. 毕竟，礼尚往来嘛. 该设施的守卫将是最低限度，而你的报酬将极其丰厚.

column1: I'm still reading through the three-hundred page legal document they sent our way, but so far it all seems reasonable. As for the arena, the Tennesse Valley used to be a wildlife reserve back in the day. Expect mud, and trees.
column2: 我还在读他们发给我们的那份三百页法律文件，但到目前为止一切看起来都合理。至于竞技场，田纳西谷当年是一片野生动物保护区。预期会有泥浆和树木。

column1: I'm sure that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep thinks they're very clever, but this kind of headhunting is serious. We should expect the enemy to shoot to kill.
column2: 我确信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的代表自以为很聪明，但这种猎头的方式很危险. 我们应该预料到敌人会开枪杀人.

column1: I'm willing to bet that Bogdan Tubbs is bringing friends to this drop, same as we are. Just a feeling I get. So, yeah… keep your eyes open.
column2: 我敢打赌博格丹·塔布斯这次投放会带朋友来，跟我们一样。只是我的感觉。所以，嗯……睁大眼睛。

column1: I've given your pilot a map of Men Lojowen, complete with the rough location of the Star League installation. I want you to get in there, brush aside any resistance, and loot whatever your BattleMechs can carry. You'll get your pay when my associates have the goods.
column2: 我已经把Men Lojowen的地图交给你们的机师，其中标有星际联盟设施的粗略位置. 进军那里，消除所有阻力，用机甲运走所有能携带的物品. 待我的合作伙伴收到货物后，你们将获得报酬.

column1: I've got nothing to add, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go beat up some violent drunks.
column2: 我没什么要补充的了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 走吧，揍扁那群暴力醉汉吧.

column1: I've negotiated a major bump if we DO end up finding the propagandist and eliminating her, as well as a danger-pay bonus if she has any escorts and we eliminate them as well.
column2: 我已经谈妥了，如果我们真的找到并消灭那个宣传者，会有一笔相当可观的额外报酬. 另外，如果她身边带了护卫，而我们顺手把他们也干掉了，还能再拿一笔风险补助作为奖励.

column1: I've received the coordinates for the rendezvous point from Lady Cunningham, Commander… we should be ready to roll when you are. I haven't managed to get Lady Cunningham herself on the horn—some kind of atmospheric interference is scrambling our long-range comms. But it should be pretty straightforward, all things said.
column2: 我从坎宁安女士那里收到了会合点的坐标，指挥官……你准备好我们就能出发。我没能联系上坎宁安女士本人——某种大气干扰扰乱了我们的远程通讯。不过总的来说，应该相当直接。

column1: I've received word from Margrave General Neil; our success was well received within Cavanaugh Theater Command. Margrave Neil has passed on the results of their stragetic planning session, and we've been asked to strike one of the local military installations. The goal is to completely neutralize the facility, to send a message to local forces that they are vulnerable.
column2: 我收到了尼尔侯爵将军的消息: 我们的成功给卡瓦诺战区指挥部留下了深刻的印象. 总督Neil已经传达了他们的战略规划会议结果，我们被要求打击当地的一个军事设施. 目标是彻底摧毁该设施，向当地武装部队展示他们的脆弱性.

column1: I've told Binton and Modge that you're gonna drop their \"treasure\" in a field about a hundred klicks southeast of Louth Abbey. That should put you far enough away to avoid collateral damage, so feel free to go after 'em with whatever BattleMechs you like. Just be aware that there's nothing stopping them from doin' the same to you.
column2: 我已通知宾顿和莫奇，你们会在Louth Abbey东南方向百公里处的荒野空投他们的“宝藏”. 这个距离应该能避免附带损伤，这样你就可派遣任何型号的战斗机甲出击. 只是要注意，也没有什么能阻止他们同样对你们下手.

column1: If I had to guess, Commander, I'd say the 'outlaw' part of this is just propaganda. Outlaw or not, though, the payout's the same for us.
column2: 如果让我猜的话，指挥官，我想说“不法分子”的部分只是宣传. 不管非不非法，款项对我们来说都是一样的.

column1: If Kell is saying that this will be tough, I'm inclined to believe him. Get your war face on, Commander. This is gonna be a hell of a drop.
column2: 如果凯尔都说这会很棘手，那么我倾向于相信他. 做好战斗准备吧，指挥官. 这次空降将会异常凶险.

column1: If either relay station is rendered inoperable, mission will be considered as a failure.
column2: 若任一继电站失效，任务将被视为失败。

column1: If the Moderbjörn holds up its end, we should be golden. Our lance will be in trouble if it doesn't.
column2: 如果“熊妈妈”能坚守到任务完成，我们就能大功告成. 否则我们的小队将陷入危机.

column1: If there are enough pirates there to present a problem for local authorities, we should be prepared for a tough fight, Commander.
column2: 如果那儿的海盗已经足以成为当局的问题，那我们该准备好打一场硬仗，指挥官.

column1: If these guys are that hard to track down, they must be pretty competent. Expect a tough fight, Commander.
column2: 如果这些家伙这么难追踪，那他们一定相当厉害. 预计会有场硬仗，指挥官.

column1: If they just set down, they may not be battle-ready; we might catch them with their metaphorical pants down.
column2: 如果他们刚刚落地，就可能还没有做好战斗准备; 也许我们能打他们个措手不及.

column1: If they want to show military strength here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we can do that for them.
column2: 如果他们想在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}展示军事力量，我们可以替他们办到.

column1: If they're expecting us, Commander, there's no telling how many units are going to be down there. This is going to get messy.
column2: 指挥官，既然他们已有防备，我们无法预估下方部署了多少兵力. 局势可能会变得相当棘手.

column1: If this MechWarrior is singlehandedly making a dent in pirate activity in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, he's going to be a tough enemy.
column2: 如果这名机甲战士独自一人就破坏了海盗在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的行动，那他将会是个难缠的敌人.

column1: If this cargo is valuable enough to pay us to steal it, it's going to be extremely well-defended. Be prepared, Commander.
column2: 如果这些货物的价值高到值得雇我们去偷，那它们必然会有极为严密的防护. 做好准备吧，指挥官.

column1: If this is the next season of Rough Riders, we need to not let Yang know. He'll trade our whole payment for early access.
column2: 如果这是下一季的狂野骑士 的话，那我们最好别 让杨知道. 他会用我们的所有薪水来换取提前观看的资格.

column1: If we accept this contract we'll be in for the duration of the campaign, Commander.  We'll be offered a series of contracts by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} to support their forces as they defend, and we'll take a hit to our reputation if we leave before the invasion concludes.
column2: 指挥官，如果接受这份合约，我们就得全程参与这场战役. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会在防御期间向我们提供一系列合约来支援其部队，若在入侵结束前撤离，我们的声誉就会受损.

column1: If we accept this contract we'll be in for the duration of the campaign, Commander.  We'll be offered a series of contracts by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} to support their forces as they defend, and we'll take a hit to our reputation if we leave before the raid is resolved.
column2: 指挥官，如果接受这份合约，我们就得全程参与这场战役. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会向我们提供一系列合约，以支持他们的防御行动，而如果在战斗结束前撤离，我们的声誉将会受损.

column1: If we accept this contract we'll be in for the duration of the campaign, Commander. We'll be offered a series of contracts by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} to support their forces as they invade, and we'll take a hit to our reputation if we leave before the invasion concludes.
column2: 指挥官，如果我们接受这份合约，就得全程参与这场战役. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会向我们提供一系列合约，以支持其入侵部队. 若在入侵结束前撤离，我们的声誉将受损.

column1: If we accept this contract we'll be in for the duration of the campaign, Commander. We'll be offered a series of contracts by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} to support their forces as they invade, and we'll take a hit to our reputation if we leave before the raid is resolved.
column2: 指挥官，如果接受这份合约，我们就得全程参与这场战役. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会在入侵期间向我们提供一系列合约来支援其部队，若在突袭结束前撤离，我们的声誉就会受损.

column1: If we are to draw the Steel Beast into a fight, we must first provoke him. The wholesale slaughter of his revolting followers seems like a reasonable first step. I'll point you in the right direction, you'll bring the firepower, and we'll scour this world of Bogdan Tubbs's fan club. Then we'll move on to a more high-profile target.
column2: 如果要把“钢铁野兽”引入战斗，我们必须先激怒他. 把他那些令人作呕的追随者们彻底清剿，这应该是一个好的开始. 我会为你指引方向，你只需带上你需要的火力就行了. 我们将共同涤净这颗星球上博格丹·塔布斯的拥趸，然后再转向更高调的目标.

column1: In theory, we've already done the heavy lifting on this one, but keep your eyes open. We still don't know why the Beasts of Balawat are chasing Kell's people.
column2: 理论上，我们已经完成了最艰难的部分，但务必保持警惕. 我们仍不清楚“巴拉瓦特野兽”为何追杀凯尔的人.

column1: In violation of local treaties, a significant combat unit consisting of two lances of 'Mechs has dropped on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Your task is to assault and dislodge the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. You will send a definitive message: Unsanctioned military operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} will be eliminated with extreme prejudice. Leave none standing.
column2: 一支由两队机甲构成，意义重大的作战部队已经空降到了{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，这违背了当地协定. 你的任务是攻击并驱逐{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队. 你将发出明确的信号: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}上未经批准的军事行动会被极端手段消灭. 一个不留.

column1: Instructions are to hold our position until relieved. Protect those buildings at all costs. I'll stay in contact as we move to stop the flanking pirate unit.
column2: 指令是坚守阵地直到被替换。不惜一切代价保护那些建筑。我们移动去阻截那支包抄的海盗部队时会保持联系。

column1: Intentionally provoking a patrol to get it to call for reinforcements. What does it say about our jobs that this isn't the craziest mission we've done?
column2: 故意挑衅巡逻队，迫使他们呼叫增援. 要说我们的工作，难道这不是我们做过的最疯狂的任务?

column1: Interrupted mid-stream? Not much does that, Commander. We better be ready for anything down there.
column2: 数据传了一半中断? 这事可不常见，指挥官. 咱们最好做好万全准备.

column1: Ironwood Productions' Holo-distribution facility is just ahead of you, Commander. Take it, and we will use it to ensure that the Steel Beast hears your challenge.
column2: Ironwood Productions的全息分发设施就在你前方，指挥官. 占领它，我们将借此确保“钢铁野兽”听到你的挑战.

column1: It definately feels like a festive engagement.
column2: 这确实像是一场节日般的交战。

column1: It has come to our attention that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is transporting classified information by courier in a fast moving convoy. It's in our interests if this information never reaches it's destination. We don't know which vehicle will have the information, so we need you destroy all of them.
column2: 我们注意到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正通过一支高速移动的车队，由信使运输机密情报. 如果这些信息永远无法送达目的地，将符合我们的利益. 我们不知道哪辆车辆携带了这份情报，所以需要你们将其全部摧毁.

column1: It looks like we're both on the Kurita shit list, Commander. This situation is bad and getting worse. My people are pinned down by fire from the DEST forces, and we can't use our Leopard to get into orbit. We've evacuated the Fire Lance, but the Command Lance is still stuck on-world—which concerns me personally, because I'm part of the Command Lance and one of the people who's stuck. I want to get to the bottom of this mess, but I'm going to need your help.
column2: 看来我们俩都在栗田的黑名单上了，指挥官。这局面很糟，而且还在恶化。我的人被DEST部队的火力压制住，我们没法用豹式进入轨道。我们已经撤离了火力分队，但指挥分队还困在行星上——这让我个人很担心，因为我就是指挥分队的一员，也是被困的人之一。我想把这团乱麻查个水落石出，但我需要你的帮助。

column1: It may or may not be that easy, Commander. We may be a bit behind the front lines, but a FOB is an attractive target for our prospective employer's enemies.
column2: 指挥官，事情可能没那么简单. 我们或许离前线有点距离，但前沿作战基地对我们潜在雇主的敌人来说，是一个很有吸引力的目标.

column1: It might be someone's last stand, but it's not ours, Commander.
column2: 也许这是某人的最后一战，但不会是我们的，指挥官.

column1: It might make sense to hang back and see how badly they bloody each other before leaping into the fray.
column2: 在跳进去参战之前，不妨先观望一下他们之间厮杀的有多惨烈.

column1: It must take some serious chutzpah to insist on a clause like that in your contract. I'm impressed.
column2: 坚决要求在你的合约里留下那样一条条款一定需要无所顾忌才行. 让我刮目相看.

column1: It never occurred to me that 'accountant to pirates' would be a particularly risky position. Makes sense, I suppose.
column2: 我从未想过“海盗的会计”会是一个特别危险的职位. 现在想想，倒也合情合理.

column1: It seems Morgan Kell has arrived on planet. He has challenged us to a trial of combat. We have the advantage. His entire force endured a high G burn from the jump point to get here so fast, so we will be fresh for battle. After we win, it will buy us the time I need to complete my plan.
column2: 看来摩根·凯尔已经抵达行星。他向我们发起了战斗试炼的挑战。我们占据优势。他的全部部队从跳跃点一路承受高G加速才这么快赶到，所以我们会是精力充沛的一方。等我们赢了，就能为我争取到完成计划所需的时间。

column1: It's a solid plan, Commander, as long as they're right about the defenses being light.
column2: 这是个可靠的计划，指挥官，前提是他们说的防御确实很薄弱.

column1: It's a solid plan, Commander, as long as they're right about the light defenses.
column2: 这是个可靠的计划，指挥官，前提是他们说的“少量防御力量”确实属实.

column1: It's all or nothing, Commander.
column2: 孤注一掷，指挥官。

column1: It's always a good time to shoot pirates, Commander.
column2: 任何时候都是射杀海盗的好时机，指挥官.

column1: It's entirely possible this is less of a real test and more of a lazy attempt at a false flag to sow mistrust between {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.ShortName} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. But it pays either way.
column2: 这完全有可能算不上真正的测试，更像是一次懒散的伪装行动，意在{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.ShortName}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}之间播下不信任的种子. 但无论如何，报酬照付.

column1: It's going to be a Circle of Equals. I hope they bring their own supply, because I don't know if we have enough sugar packets onboard.
column2: 这将是一场“平等之环”(Circle of Equals). 我希望他们自己带补给，因为我不知道我们船上是否有足够的糖包.

column1: It's hard for me to overstate what a terrible idea it is to go into a mission with no terrain intel. There could be anything down there.
column2: 缺乏地形情报执行任务简直是糟糕透顶的主意. 下面任何情况 都有可能发生.

column1: It's not for nothing that Liao is known for being unpredictable and cunning. Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
column2: 廖氏因不可预测和精明而出名. 让我们睁大眼睛，以免收到令人讨厌的惊喜，指挥官.

column1: It's reached a point where we can no longer operate in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, Commander, and it's all thanks to a particular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be defended and given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 指挥官，我们已经到了无法再在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系中活动的地步了，这一切都要归功于一名专门负责追踪我们在该地区行动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士. 我们厌倦了任由他挑选战斗的时间和地点，所以希望你在他巡逻时给他个小小的惊喜. 他会有防备，而且鉴于他的多疑，附近很可能有增援等待，所以小心有埋伏.

column1: Jus' place th' markers, 'n we 'ave a Naval Gauss Rifle that shall zoom in 'n put a hole in that base so big that Fat Karl could walk in thar n get th' loot.
column2: 把那些标记放好，我们就有门舰载高斯步枪能嗖地射进去，在那座基地上开个大洞，大到胖卡尔都能走进去拿战利品。

column1: Jus' place th' markers, 'n we 'ave a Naval Gauss Rifle that shall zoom in 'n put a hole in that base so big, Fat Karl could walk in thar 'n get th' loot.
column2: 只管把标记放好，咱就有一门舰载高斯步枪会嗖地飞过来，在那座基地上开出一个大洞——大到胖卡尔都能走进去把战利品搬出来。

column1: Just one more area 'til we can get to the base. Stay strong, Commander.
column2: 再过一片区域我们就能抵达基地了。撑住，指挥官。

column1: Just two short missions to go.
column2: 只剩两个短任务了。

column1: Keep an eye out for Agent X, he could be a real problem for us.
column2: 留意X特工，他可能给我们带来不小麻烦。

column1: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this joker to stick to his end of the deal.
column2: 在下面保持警惕，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 我们只派一个机甲战士进去，而且我不相信这个家伙会遵守他那边的约定.

column1: Keep your eyes open down there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. We're going in with a single MechWarrior, and I don't trust this one bit.
column2: 在下面睁大眼睛，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们要只带一名机师进去，而我一点都不信这事。

column1: Lady Suiko is inbound, and she's not alone. Her old war buddies are moving in fast-two lances of 'em. Keep in mind, we've got one goal: stop her from killing Luthendorff.
column2: 翠子夫人正在赶来，而且她不是一个人. 她的老战友们正在快速推进——有两支小队. 记住，我们只有一个目标: 阻止她杀死卢森道夫.

column1: Last night a few of our crew members took some much needed R&R at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now it looks like we're stuck in a duel with two apparent {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} guards. Our crew aren't fighters so maybe you can help us out?
column2: 昨晚，我们的一些船员在当地的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧享受了一些急需的休息和放松. 期间发生了一些口角，现在看来我们不得不与两名疑似{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}卫兵进行决斗. 我们的船员并不擅长战斗，所以也许你能帮我们一把?

column1: Last night a few of your crew members took some Liberties at the local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} bar. Words were said and now you are to duel with the offended warriors of{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.
column2: 昨晚，你的几名船员在当地一家{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}酒吧里行为有些出格. 口角发生后，现在你必须与受冒犯的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士们进行决斗.

column1: Last week, radio coms with a strategic outpost was interrupted mid datastream to one of the remote relays and we've been unable to reestablish contact. Our other units are all tied up, so we need you to make contact and get a sitrep.
column2: 上周，我们与一处战略前哨的无线电通讯在一个远程中继站的数据传输中中断了，之后一直无法重建联系. 我们的其他单位都抽不开身，所以需要你们前去取得联系，并获取情况报告.

column1: Less than an hour ago, we lost contact with a covert team tasked with infiltrating a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility. The only reason for them not to respond is if their operation was blown, by discovery or counterintelligence. The research materials they were meant to collect are extremely important, and we can't afford to lose them. We need you to make a rapid and immediate deployment to the the facility, and get our people and their cargo to safety.
column2: 不到一小时前，我们和一支渗透{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施的秘密小队失去了联系. 他们不回应的唯一理由就是被发现了，或是因反间谍活动而暴露了. 他们原本要收集的研究资料极为重要，我们承受不起损失. 我们需要你迅速立即部署，前往该设施，把我们的人和他们携带的资料安全带回.

column1: Let's do this thing quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want us spending any more time on these jokers than we have to.
column2: 让我们速战速决，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 我不想在这些小丑身上多浪费一分一秒.

column1: Let's flush out this guy and restore our rating.
column2: 让我们把这家伙揪出来，恢复我们的评级。

column1: Let's go make ourselves useful.
column2: 咱们去派上点用场吧.

column1: Let's hope this heist works out the way Yang said that it would.
column2: 希望事情像杨说的那样顺利解决.

column1: Let's hope this is the last hoop we need to jump through before finding this guy.
column2: 希望这是我们找到这家伙之前的最后障碍.

column1: Let's keep our eyes open for any surprises, Commander.
column2: 让我们保持警惕，留意任何意外情况，指挥官.

column1: Let's knock this out quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I don't want to try Graf Stieglitz-Bradford's patience any more than we have to.
column2: 我们应该尽快解决这个问题，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 我不想再考验格拉夫·斯蒂格里茨·布拉德福德伯爵的耐心了.

column1: Let's make some noise, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. Do as much damage as you can. When the Zhao siblings scatter, we'll choose our target and finish this.
column2: 大干一场吧，{COMMANDER.Callsign}. 全力输出火力. 当赵氏兄妹溃散时，我们再选择一个目标并完成任务.

column1: Let's make this strike quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Bravo Lance will be holding off the Capellans while we work, and I don't want to leave them out there any longer than I have to.
column2: 让我们迅速行动，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. Bravo小队将负责拖住卡佩拉人，而我们则进行作战. 我不希望，你在外面呆的时间超过绝对必要的时间.

column1: Let's protect that merchandise, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's what we're doing this for, after all.
column2: 务必保护好这批货，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这毕竟是我们行动的核心目的.

column1: Let's see what Lady Suiko's lance of geriatric MechWarriors can do.
column2: 让我们来看看，翠子夫人那支由老年机甲战士组成的小队能有多大本事吧.

column1: Like I said, the Baumann Group's distribution center is heavily defended, so we're gonna approach this as a two-stage operation. For this first stage, you're going to descend at the outermost edge of the OpFor's territory and engage their patrolling cavalry. Take out as many vehicles and 'Mechs as you can to clear the way for an assault on the distribution center.
column2: 正如我所说，鲍曼集团的配送中心防守严密，所以我们将把这次行动分为两个阶段. 在第一阶段，你们将从敌方领地最外围着陆，与他们巡逻的骑兵部队交战. 尽可能摧毁更多的车辆和机甲，为攻击配送中心清除道路.

column1: Like the man said, we're going into this one blind, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. House Steiner isn't even supposed to have a presence in this system, so whatever we're about to walk into, we're doing it alone.
column2: 正如那人所说，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们真的什么都不知道. 施泰纳家族甚至不应该出现在这个星系中. 所以我们不能指望其他任何人，无论发生什么.

column1: Looks Like some kind of aerial show. For some reason everyone here is testing out their brand new Land Air 'Mechs. Let's give them a show.
column2: 看起来像是某种空中表演. 不知为何，这里的每个人都在测试他们全新的陆空机甲. 咱们给他们秀一场吧.

column1: Looks like Force Commander Singh's forensics team bought the false intel we planted. Let's hope it leads to the payoff we were promised.
column2: 看来辛格指挥官的取证团队信了我们植入的假情报. 希望这能带来承诺的回报.

column1: Looks like a 3 team brawl commander, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 看来是一场三队近战，指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: Looks like more fighting overpowered pirates. Least I don't see the Queen's unit marked on the map.
column2: 看来又是打那些不堪一击的海盗。至少地图上没标出女王的部队。

column1: Looks like some strong opposition, more reinforcements from local government troops.
column2: 看来抵抗相当强，还有更多来自当地政府部队的增援。

column1: Looks like we are starting to see some heavier resistance. Make whatever preparations you can and prepare for another drop.
column2: 看来我们开始遇到更顽强的抵抗了。尽可能做好准备，为下一次投放待命。

column1: Looks like we should swap out pilots as we go to conserve strength.
column2: 看来我们该在过程中轮换机师以保存体力。

column1: Looks like {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is really over a barrel here. My kind of customer.
column2: 看来{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在这儿真的一筹莫展了. 这种客户正合我胃口.

column1: Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
column2: 杰斯珀领主和他的小队正在赶来挑战你的路上. 守住工厂并让他弹射逃生，败兴而归！把他那珍贵的祖传机甲烧成冒烟的废墟！

column1: Luthendorff will not escape death again, Commander. Don't expect an easy fight. This time she'll be prepared for us. I'm picking up multiple heavy contacts on my sensors. More scrap for Luthendorff's funeral pyre.
column2: 卢森道夫这次逃不掉了，指挥官. 别指望会轻松取胜，这次她肯定有备而来. 我的传感器上显示有多个重型目标. 给卢森道夫的火葬堆再多添点废铁吧.

column1: Maintain the defense and do whatever it takes to get us out of this in one piece.
column2: 守住防线，不惜一切代价让我们完好无损地脱离此地.

column1: Make sure to swap in fresh units when possible.
column2: 有机会就确保换上新单位。

column1: Many years ago, we fought a lengthy conflict with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Recently, however, news has trickled in from a remote region of the planet: enemy forces harrying regional transportation. Eyewitness reports describe very old 'Mechs in colors from the conflict long since ended. You are to show these old MechWarriors that the war is over for them as well.
column2: 许多年前，我们曾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}进行过一场漫长的战争. 然而最近，从这个星球的偏远地区传来了消息: 敌军正在骚扰当地的交通. 目击者报告称，他们看见了有着那场早已结束的战争涂装的老旧机甲. 你的任务是让这些年迈的机甲战士明白，他们的战争已经结束了.

column1: Matis \"Bishop\" Crenshaw and his retinue are en route to a meeting with Sian Triumphant, a satellite organization of the Emerald Dawn. Intercept Crenshaw's BattleMech, destroy it, and contact my DropShip to confirm the kill.
column2: 马蒂斯“主教”克伦肖及其随行人员正前往与“翡翠黎明”的附属组织“仙安凯旋”会面. 立即拦截克伦肖的战斗机甲，摧毁它，然后联系我的空投艇以确认击杀.

column1: Mechwarriors, I have a mission for you. The local government has requested our assistance in neutralizing a group of hostile mechs. We'll be setting up an ambush and taking them out before they know what hit them. It's a simple mission, but we can't let our guard down.
column2: 机甲战士们，我有个任务给你们。当地政府请求我们协助消灭一伙敌对机甲。我们将设下埋伏，在它们反应过来之前就把它们干掉。任务很简单，但我们不能放松警惕。

column1: Mining and Drilling are a large part of war efforts. By switching these resources we will tip the scale of the fight.
column2: 采矿与钻探是战争努力的一大组成部分。通过扭转这些资源，我们将改变战斗的天平。

column1: More spies. Makes me wonder how deep ComStar infiltration actually goes.
column2: 又是间谍。让我不禁想康星的渗透到底有多深。

column1: Move fast, {COMMANDER.FirstName}! The Black Widow and the Bounty Hunter are on their way.
column2: 快，{COMMANDER.FirstName}！黑寡妇和赏金猎人正在路上.

column1: Move quickly… with assault-class 'Mechs. Commander, this is absurd. I hope they're paying well.
column2: 用突击级机甲快速机动。指挥官，这太荒唐了。我希望他们给的报酬够好。

column1: Moving into the city arena will be a big change from what we've been dealing with so far. Expect a lot of narrow sight lines and vantage points.
column2: 进入城市竞技场会与我们此前应对的情况大不相同。预期会有大量狭窄视线与观察点。

column1: Ms. Hadley's prison transport is waiting for you on the planet's surface, Commander. You will meet with it at a designated rendezvous point, then escort it to a distant repair bay. The personnel there stand ready to hold Ms. Hadley and patch up the prison transport APCs. When they're finished, you'll be free to press on to the extraction point.
column2: 哈德利女士的囚车正在星球地表等候，指挥官. 你需要在指定接应点会合，然后护送她前往远处的维修站. 那里的人员已准备羁押哈德利女士并修补囚车装甲. 完成后，你可自由前往撤离点.

column1: Much less waste when its only two mechs facing off in the field, even less if they pay us to fight for them.
column2: 当战场上只有两台机甲对决时，浪费就少得多了; 如果他们付钱让我们替他们打，那就更少了.

column1: My agents have traced Colonel Basil Lees to a stronghold in the basin ahead. I want you to raze it to the ground, and destroy anything that attempts to protect it. Show this Davion animal what the Draconis Combine does to those who would slaughter its people.
column2: 我的特工已经追踪到巴泽尔·利斯上校在前方盆地的一处据点. 我希望你将其夷为平地，摧毁一切试图保护它的东西. 向这头戴维恩猪展示，天龙联合体会对那些屠杀其人民的人做什么.

column1: My contacts in the Maskirovka tell me that you rejected Commander Elliathy's offer. A wise decision, Commander. Bring down the remainder of Razorback Company, and nothing will stand between you and the seditionist camp.
column2: 我在欺敌局的联络人告诉我，你拒绝了艾莉希指挥官的提议. 明智的决定，指挥官. 摧毁尖背野猪公司的残余部队，叛军营地便将门户大开.

column1: My daughter will arrive shortly at a private compound, and Luthendorff is on the way to greet her. Intercept and eliminate this criminal. But be on guard—she has bodyguards with her, although I expect you to easily outmaneuver and outsmart them.
column2: 我女儿很快会抵达一处私人庄园，卢滕多夫正在前往迎接她的路上。拦截并消灭这个罪犯。但要提防——她身边带着保镖，不过我相信你能轻易地机动胜过、智取他们。

column1: My guess is that there was a credible threat made on the colony, and that's why they're pulling out. Expect fighting, Commander.
column2: 我猜在殖民地上有一个可信的威胁，那就是他们为什么撤退了. 预计会有战斗，指挥官.

column1: My people on the ground have picked up a lance of Davion BattleMechs on their sensors, Commander. If you move on Lees without dealing with them, they'll be in position to outflank you.
column2: 我在地面上的人通过传感器发现了一支戴维恩战斗机甲小队，指挥官. 如果你直接攻击利斯而不处理他们，他们将有机会迂回包抄你.

column1: My read on the situation is that by 'personnel' they mean 'covert operatives'. You don't hire 'Mechs to cover the retreat of clerical staff.
column2: 我对局势的理解是，他们所说的“人员”指的是“秘密特工”. 你不会雇佣机甲来掩护文职人员的撤退.

column1: Never trust a pirate. I've got a bad feeling about this, Commander.
column2: 永远别信海盗。我有种不祥的预感，指挥官。

column1: Nice, clean, and simple. Just the kind of job I like, and just what we'd have missed if we'd taken our shadowy friend up on his offer. You made the right call, {COMMANDER.FirstName}—now let's finish this thing.
column2: 干净利落、简单明了。正是我喜欢的那种活儿，也正是我们若接受那位神秘朋友的提议就会错过的。你做了正确的决定，{COMMANDER.FirstName}——现在我们把这事办完。

column1: No ammo left? What kind of idiot set up their supply lines. Let's clean this duel up and cash in, Commander.
column2: 弹药都没了? 哪个白痴布置的补给线. 让我们干净利落地搞定这场决斗，然后收钱走人，指挥官.

column1: No good deed goes unpunished, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Not ever.
column2: 好心没好报，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 历来如此.

column1: No honor among thieves, I suppose.
column2: 盗贼之中没有任何荣誉可言，我认为.

column1: Not being ambushed by pirates in alleyways would be nice.
column2: 不在小巷里被海盗伏击就好了。

column1: Not much to say, Commander. Shoot to kill.
column2: 没什么可说的，指挥官. 往死里打.

column1: Not much to say, Commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} made a tactical fumble, and we're going to bail them out.
column2: 没什么可说的，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}造成了一起战术性失误，我们要帮他们脱离困境.

column1: Not much to say, Commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} made a tactical fumble, and we're going to bail them out. The convoy lead is privately offering to make sure a few crates of ammo 'fall off the truck' if we get them home.
column2: 没什么好说的，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}犯了个战术失误，我们得去给他们解围. 车队领队私下提出，如果我们能把他们护送回家，他会确保几箱弹药“从卡车上掉下来”.

column1: Not the strangest contract we've been offered, if you can even call it that. Solaris 'Mechs aren't known for their conventional loadouts, Commander, so just keep that in mind.
column2: 这算不上我们接到过最奇怪的合约，如果它还能被称为合约的话。索拉里斯机甲并不以常规载荷闻名，指挥官，所以记住这一点。

column1: Now that we have secured the asset, The Company is going to be all over us.I expect heavy assortment of mercs and security guards coming after us.
column2: 既然我们已经拿到了资产，公司肯定会全力追击我们. 我预计会有各式各样的雇佣兵和安保人员追来.

column1: Now that we’ve decrypted the location of the Nyanderthal era artefact and our stolen equipment, we can drop in and claim back what is justly ours by birth right and legal purchase! Getting our equipment back takes utmost priority, as we can’t bring our musical joy to the Canopian masses without our equipment. Investigating the Nyanderthal artefact takes secondary priority, although its important, these wild goose chases turn out to be hogwash more often than not.
column2: 既然我们已经解密了尼安德特时代遗物和我们被盗装备的位置，我们就可以降落下去，夺回按出生权和合法购买本应属于我们的东西！取回我们的装备是最高优先事项，因为没有装备我们就无法把音乐的欢乐带给卡诺帕的民众。调查尼安德特遗物是次要优先事项，虽说它很重要，但这类大海捞针的追查十有八九是竹篮打水。

column1: Now that your humanitarian responsibilities have been seen to, perhaps you'll be good enough to focus your attention on your real job?
