Lord Jesper and his lance are on their way to challenge you. Hold the factory and send him home in his ejection pod, defeated and ashamed! Leave his precious ancestral BattleMech a smoldering ruin!
column2: 既然你们的人道主义责任已履行完毕，或许现在能专心处理正事 了? 杰斯珀领主和他的机甲正在路上. 守住工厂，让他坐着弹射舱颜面尽失地滚回家！把他那宝贵的祖传机甲变成冒烟的残骸！

column1: Now we are being ambushed by Clan Wolf. How can this day get any worse? I need you to head out and defend our east flank, Commander.
column2: 现在我们又遭到狼族伏击。这一天还能更糟吗？我需要你出去防守我们的东翼，指挥官。

column1: Now we're destroying a civilian prison. Are we sure this was a good idea?
column2: 现在我们又在摧毁一座民用监狱。我们确定这是个好主意吗？

column1: Obviously, our friends would prefer to salvage the lostech themselves, requiring us to clear out any defending forces. Thus, they're paying more if we clear out the defenders.
column2: 显然，我们的朋友更愿意自己去回收失落科技，这就需要我们清除所有守军. 因此，如果我们清除了守军，他们就会付更多的钱给我们.

column1: Obviously, this deployment is gonna be a little fraught. It's on us to handle it anyway.
column2: 显然，这次部署会有点棘手. 但无论如何，要靠我们自行应对.

column1: Obviously, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would prefer to salvage the lostech themselves, requiring us to clear out any defending forces. Thus, they're paying more if we clear out the defenders.
column2: 显然，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人更愿意自己去回收失落科技，这就需要我们清除所有守军. 因此，如果我们清除了守军，他们就会付更多的钱给我们.

column1: Oh boy, let's hope Jimmy isn't down there or we may not get anything.
column2: 天哪，但愿吉米不在下面，否则我们可能什么都拿不到。

column1: Oh sure, dropping in a merc 'Mech company to check your secret supply cache is the very definition of discretion. Commander, if this doesn't go sideways I may die of shock.
column2: 哦，当然，派一支雇佣兵机甲公司去检查秘密补给藏匿点，这本身就是“谨慎”的最佳定义. 指挥官，如果这事没出岔子，我可能会震惊而死.

column1: Ok so our chances of obtaining the valuable data and research have been cut short, but this way does have a higher survivability. We will be destroying their production capabilities to hopefully drive them off this rock.
column2: 好吧，所以我们获取那些宝贵数据与研究的机会已经断了，但这条路确实生存率更高。我们将摧毁他们的生产能力，希望能把他们赶出这块石头。

column1: Ok, we got some great information from the escort mission. First thing we learned was that I hate escort missions. Secondly however, is that this place serves two purposes: one is to protect the AI on a nearby planet, and two it has some nice loot.
column2: 好，我们从护送任务里得到了很棒的情报。第一件学到的事是我讨厌护送任务。第二件则是，这地方有两个用途：一是保护附近一颗行星上的AI，二是它有一些不错的战利品。

column1: Okay, Boss! We've got the hot rods, and we're on our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this—we're moving at a solid clip, but I suspect we're being followed…
column2: 好的，老板！热车已经到手，我们正在前往着陆点。我说过我还是讨厌简易座椅吗？天哪，我真是太讨厌了！你最好用通讯指引我们穿过这一带——我们跑得挺快，但我怀疑有人跟着我们……

column1: Okay, Boss! We've got the monster trucks, and we're slugging our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this; we're trudging along at a steady pace, but we're about to have company…
column2: 好，老大！我们弄到怪兽卡车了，正一路轰着往着陆区去。我说过我讨厌颠簸座吗？天哪，我可真是讨厌！你最好赶紧上通讯引导我们穿过这里；我们正以稳定速度艰难前行，但马上要有客人来了……

column1: Okay, we made it to the planet. We have everything we need except for the geo-location of the fortress where they have whatever they have, and I want it. Get down there and smash that convoy and kill whoever to get the information we need.
column2: 好，我们到行星了。我们什么都不缺，只差那座堡垒的地理位置——他们手里有什么都无所谓，我要的就是它。下去摧毁那支车队，杀掉任何人，拿到我们需要的情报。

column1: Ombra died for this, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's on us to make sure that her sacrifice counts for something.
column2: Ombra为此牺牲了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}——我们必须确保她的牺牲没有白费.

column1: Ominous, but hardly surprising. If we take this win we'll be over halfway to the top.
column2: 不祥，但并不意外。如果我们拿下这一胜，就过半了，离登顶只差一半。

column1: On one hand, a Griffin is a tough 'Mech, given the kinds of enemies we're likely to run into out here. On the other hand, any official who thinks personally patrolling is a good idea may not be the best pilot around.
column2: 一方面，考虑到我们在这儿可能遇到的敌人类型，“狮鹫”是部坚固的机甲. 另一方面，任何一个觉得亲自巡逻是个好主意的官员，大概不会是个出色的机师.

column1: On one hand, that mech can probably take care of itself, given the kind of opposition we're likely to run into out here. On the other hand, any official who thinks personally patrolling is a good idea may not be the best pilot around.
column2: 一方面，考虑到我们在这儿很可能碰上的对手水平，那台机甲大概足以自保. 另一方面，一个觉得亲自巡逻是个好主意的官员，恐怕算不上什么出色的机师.

column1: One guy in a spacer bar says the wrong thing and every major power goes scrambling after LosTech.
column2: 太空酒吧的那家伙说错了，每个主要势力都在争先恐后地争夺失落科技.

column1: One of our Civilian Liaison Teams has acquired a recently former {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} ammunition depot following the sudden death of much of the staff in an unfortunate incident. We removing the ammunition to a secure location lest if fall into the wrong hands. Your company is to provide security during the extraction.
column2: 我们的一支平民联络队接管了一座不久前还属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的弹药库，此前库内大部分人员在一起不幸的事故中突然丧生. 我们正在将弹药转移至安全地点，以免落入不法之徒手中. 你们佣兵连的任务是在转移期间提供安保.

column1: One of our DropShips was in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system when it experienced technical issues. A final message indicated a hard landing. That DropShip was carrying a valuable piece of technology as cargo, and while we are willing to write off the ship itself, we very much need to recover the cargo. Satellite imagery suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces recovered the cargo and are holding it at a nearby facility. We need you to raid that facility and recover the item.
column2: 我们的一艘空投艇在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系发生了技术故障. 最后的通讯显示它已进行了硬着陆. 那艘空投艇搭载了一件极其珍贵的技术设备，虽然我们可以放弃空投艇本身，但我们非常需要将货物找回. 卫星图像显示，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队已经回收了这批货物，并将其存放在附近的一个设施中. 我们需要你突袭那座设施，把东西找回来.

column1: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.
column2: 我们的一名VIP在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里. 我们需要带她远离那个星球，但这座建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的军队包围了. 你需要清除敌方阻力，救出VIP，并将她安全护送到指定的着陆区撤离. 请做好战斗准备——包围大使的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会轻易让你带走我们的人员. 等你把我们的VIP平安带出，我们就会付款.

column1: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。[警告：丧尸]

column1: One of our bio research stations has gone dark in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've not sure why but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} affiliated groups have been asking about purchasing some specific supplies we also use in that system. Investigate and find out what's going on.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一个生物研究站失联了. 我们不确定原因，但{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}相关组织一直在询问购买我们在该星系也使用的某些特定物资. 进行调查，查明发生了什么.

column1: One of our covert facilities was breached, Commander, in what appears to have been an inside job. A MechWarrior stationed there murdered the rest of the staff and is defecting to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, taking a valuable {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech with her. The facility is a total loss, but we don't want that 'Mech falling into enemy hands. Track down the renegade and destroy her 'Mech. We believe she's being escorted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and there's a bonus if you destroy them as well.
column2: 我们的一座秘密设施被攻破了，指挥官，看起来是内贼所为. 一个驻扎在那儿的机甲战士谋杀了其余人员，并叛逃到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，她还带走了一部宝贵的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲. 那座设施彻底毁了，但是我们不想那部机甲落入敌人手中. 追踪叛徒并摧毁她的机甲. 我们相信她正被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队护送着，如果你也能消灭他们的话，就会有奖金.

column1: One of our covert operatives was captured by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol during a routine data drop, and is being held at a secure facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need a rapid response team to raid the facility and get our operative out safely. We will pay a bonus if you're able to secure the data she was trying to deliver, as well. It's being held at a separate facility.
column2: 我们的一个秘密行动人员在一次例行情报传递时被一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队抓获了，被关押在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处安全设施里. 我们需要一支快速反应部队袭击该设施，安全地带走我们的特工. 要是你能取得她试图递送的数据，我们也会支付奖金. 它被放在一处单独的设施里.

column1: One of our people has been staying in accommodations provided by our friends, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities. She's ready to move on, though, and so we'd like you to go in and pick her up. Her current landlords probably won't let her just leave, however, so expect to settle some arguments. There might be shooting involved.
column2: 我们的一名人员一直住在我们的朋友——{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局提供的住所中. 不过，她现在准备离开了，所以我们希望你们前往那里把她接回来. 当然，她目前的“房东”恐怕不会轻易让她离开，因此做好解决一些争端的准备. 过程中可能会发生交火.

column1: One of our people has been staying in high-class accomodations provided by our friends, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities. She's ready to move on, though, and so we'd like you to go in and pick her up. Her current landlords probably won't let her just leave, however, so expect to settle some arguments. There might be shooting involved.
column2: 我们的一名成员一直住在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局提供的高级住所中. 不过她现在已经准备好离开了，所以我们希望你进去把她接出来. 不过，她现在的“房东”可不会让她就这么走了，所以预计要解决一些争端. 可能会打上几枪.

column1: One of our sources inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} law enforcement facility just reported some alarming news. Somehow, the authorities have gotten their filthy hands on one of our accountants, and they're interrogating him for all our business secrets right now. That's not something we're willing to tolerate. We can't take any chances on this one, Commander. We need you to flatten that facility.
column2: 我们在一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}执法机构内部的线人刚刚传回令人震惊的消息. 不知怎么搞的，当局抓住了我们的一名会计师，目前正逼问他，企图获取我们所有的商业机密. 这是我们绝不能容忍的. 这次我们不能冒任何风险，指挥官. 我们需要你夷平那座设施.

column1: Only marginally effective for a light tank, the Scorpion has proven effective in mass numbers. Swarms of Scorpions, easily procured due to their low cost, are an often-encountered danger on poorer worlds.
column2: 对轻型坦克来说它只能算勉强有效，但蝎式以数量证明了威力。由于采购成本低廉，成群结队的蝎式在贫困星球上屡见不鲜，是常见的威胁。

column1: Opponents whose identities we don't know give me heartburn, Commander.
column2: 那些身份不明的敌人让我很不安，指挥官.

column1: Our Employer is looking to stock up on munitions for the siege of this planet. He has asked us to secure the facility on their behalf.
column2: 我们的雇主正为围攻这颗行星囤积弹药。他请我们代他拿下那处设施。

column1: Our Hovertank unit has been ambushed and needs some repairs. Get to them and escort them to a safe place to be picked up.
column2: 我们的悬浮坦克部队遭到了伏击，需要进行一些修理. 找到他们，并护送他们到安全地点以便接应撤离.

column1: Our VTOL factory on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under threat because of rumors that we are developing a new military airframe. This gossip has reached certain parties who may send spies and saboteurs. We have arranged for a garrison force to be moved into place, but we need mercenaries to protect the factory until our forces arrive.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的VTOL(垂直起降飞行器)工厂正面临威胁，因为有传言称我们正在研发一款新的军用机身. 这些流言蜚语已传到某些可能派出间谍和破坏者的势力耳中. 我们已经安排了一支驻防部队前往该地，但在我们的部队抵达前，需要雇佣兵来保护工厂.

column1: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by the local Jarman brothers. With support from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} they continually raid our supplies and we've had enough. Using their overconfidence against them we've baited them into accepting a duel with us. Can you help us out?
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直受到当地Jarman兄弟的骚扰. 在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的支持下，他们不断劫掠我们的补给，我们受够了. 我们利用他们的过度自信，引诱他们接受与我们的决斗. 你能帮我们一把吗?

column1: Our bases in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been plagued by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. We have challenged them to a Trial of Refusal, hopefully driving them for the system once and for all.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的基地一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的侵扰. 我们已向他们发起拒绝审判 (Trial of Refusal)，希望能一劳永逸地将他们赶出这个星系.

column1: Our battles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have been a waste of resources. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has issued us a Trial of Possession for this small area of the conflict. It will be a one-on-one battle in a Circle of Equals with you taking our place, ostensibly to save our own resources.
column2: 我们与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}及其周边的战斗一直是在浪费资源. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}已向我们发出所有权试炼，以争夺冲突中的这一小片区域. 这将是一场在平等者之环中进行的一对一战斗，由你代表我们出战，表面上是为节省我们自身的资源.

column1: Our convoy is making good progress, Commander, but there's a small problem. My people are reporting the way forward is thick with Federated Suns forces, and the moment they spot the convoy, they'll converge on it, and that will be the end of our operation. I need you to deploy a lance to clear the way to the extraction zone, and keep it clear while our Leopard comes in for the pickup. The LZ is likely to be extremely hot, Commander, and the enemy will be targeting the vehicles. You need to keep them alive and get them onto that DropShip.
column2: 我们的车队进展顺利，指挥官，但有一个小问题. 我的人报告说，前方道路上布满了恒星联邦的部队. 一旦他们发现车队，就会合围过来，那我们的行动就完了. 我需要你派遣一个小队，清除通往撤离区的道路，并在我们的“豹”式空投艇前来接应时保持道路畅通. 指挥官，着陆区很可能会极其危险，敌人会以车辆为目标. 你需要保证他们活着，并让他们登上那艘空投艇.

column1: Our covert operatives on the planet have located a secret {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility that's been abandoned. We have a team inbound to this planet to strip the facility of everything valuable, but our people on the surface tripped some sort of alarm, which means the original owners are probably on their way to level the place and ensure we can't salvage anything. We need you and your people to occupy that base and keep it intact until our team arrives.
column2: 我们在该星球的秘密特工发现了一处已被遗弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施. 我们有一支小队正赶往此星球，准备带走该设施中一切有价值的东西，但我们地面的人员触发了某种警报，这意味着原来的所有者很可能正在赶来夷平这儿，以确保我们捞不到任何东西. 我们需要你和你的人占领这座基地，并保持其完整，直到我们的人抵达.

column1: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us, which is a solid argument for ownership.
column2: 我们的雇主对这个星系的合法主张并不比其他人更多，但他们有钱雇佣我们，这在所有权上也是一个有力的理由.

column1: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us. Which is a solid argument for ownership.
column2: 我们的雇主对这个星系的合法主张其实并不比任何其他人更强，但他们有钱雇我们。这本身就是主张所有权的一个有力论据。

column1: Our intelligence analysts located a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We've already pacified the base, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} made very firm job offers to the scientists at the facility. Almost all of them have accepted. We need to evacuate those scientists before their previous employers hear about their new positions.
column2: 我们的情报分析人员找到了一座位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，隐蔽良好的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究基地. 我们已经平定该基地，并且{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}向该基地的科学家提出了优渥的工作条件. 几乎所有人都答应了. 我们需要在他们的前任雇主得知消息前，尽快撤离这些科学家.

column1: Our intelligence confirms a lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units is engaged in maneuvers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. This is an aggressive action and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Hunt down the enemy lance and eliminate it.
column2: 我们的情报证实，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}参加演习，就在我们的控制区内. 这是一次侵略性的行为，如果这支小队不受阻碍地行动，那{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动就会受到威胁. 追捕并消灭这支敌方小队.

column1: Our intelligence confirms there is a lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units operating on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. All {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Hunt down the enemy lance and eliminate it.
column2: 我们的情报证实，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上我方控制的区域内活动. 只要这支小队可以不受阻碍地行动，那{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的所有行动都将面临风险. 追捕并消灭这支敌方小队.

column1: Our intelligence has identified an infamous war criminal in the service of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We do not care about the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, but the criminal must be brought to justice. And by 'justice' we mean 'dead'.
column2: 我们的情报显示，有个臭名昭著的战犯正在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}服务. 我们不在乎{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的军队，但这个罪犯必须被绳之以法. 所谓“绳之以法”，我们的意思是“必须被消灭”.

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations.  The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人出现在了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表，并且易于攻击. 消灭他将使其组织陷入混乱，并为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动扫清道路. 目标相对来说没什么防备，我们希望你能在这个机会窗口内发动攻击.

column1: Our intelligence operatives believe that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader is present and vulnerable on the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Eliminating them will leave their organization in shambles and clear the field for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded, and we'd like you to strike during this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们的情报人员相信，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人出现在了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表，并且易于攻击. 消灭他将使其组织陷入混乱，并为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动扫清道路. 目标相对来说没什么防备，我们希望你能在这个机会窗口内发动攻击.

column1: Our munitions factory on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under threat because of a rumor about a cache of Star League equipment at the site. This malicious gossip about LosTech has brought hungry wolves to our door. We have arranged for a garrison force to be moved into place, but we need mercenary units to protect the factory until our forces arrive.
column2: 我们位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的军工厂正面临威胁，原因是一则关于工厂所在地藏有星际联盟设备的传言. 这条涉及失落科技的恶意流言，已经把一群饥饿的“豺狼”引到了我们门口. 我们已经安排了一支驻军部队前往，但在他们抵达之前，我们需要佣兵部队来保护工厂.

column1: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. Because you're going in quiet, the facility shouldn't be alerted to our insertion, and the opposition should be light.
column2: 我们的特工贾瓦德正潜伏在这座小岛的海军后勤基地内，指挥官. 待你抵达设施后，他将脱离潜伏状态并登上你机甲的后座，然后你只需护送他及其携带的数据撤离该设施.“豹”式将待命接应你们. 因为你们是秘密潜入，基地不会察觉到我们的入侵，敌方兵力应该很薄弱.

column1: Our operative, Jawad, is in deep cover at the naval logistics base on this tiny island, Commander. Once you arrive at the facility, he'll break cover and board your unit in the rumble seat. Then you just need to get him and the data he carries out of the facility. We'll have the Leopard on standby to pick you up. We're going in loud, Commander, which means the facility is going to know you're coming. Be prepared for heavy resistance.
column2: 我们的特工贾瓦德正潜伏在这座小岛的海军后勤基地内，指挥官. 待你抵达设施后，他将脱离潜伏状态并登上你机甲的后座，然后你只需护送他及其携带的数据撤离该设施.“豹”式将待命接应你们. 此次我们将采取强攻策略，指挥官，这意味着设施守军会察觉你的行动. 请做好应对激烈抵抗的准备.

column1: Our operatives on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} recovered a functional piece of SLDF technology, but before they could deliver it to us, they were captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. We need a team to assault the location they're being held, recover the technology, and escape.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的行动人员回收了一项实用的星际联盟防卫军(SLDF)技术，但在他们把它送回来之前，就被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获. 我们需要一支队伍突袭拘禁他们的地方，回收这项技术并摆脱敌人.

column1: Our people took a beating in a recent engagement, Commander, and we lost an entire lance. One of our pilots was killed when their 'Mech fell over, and the last of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} survivors was able to get our 'Mech back on its feet. Now they're hoping to get it safely to their dropship and claim it for their own. We need you to stop their salvage attempt, and bring that 'Mech down. It's still an active battlefield down there, so no telling what you'll encounter.
column2: 我们的人在最近的一次战斗中遭遇了惨败，指挥官，我们损失了一整只小队. 其中一名机师在机甲倒下时阵亡，而{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}最后的幸存者设法让我们的机甲重新站了起来. 现在他们希望能将其安全运回自己的空投艇上据为己有. 我们需要你阻止他们的打捞行动，并摧毁那台机甲. 下面的战场仍然活跃，所以无法预料你会遭遇什么.

column1: Our research facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been under constant attack from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces for some time. Rather than continue to risk their lives, we are evacuating the noncombatants. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will pay handsomely for a mercenary unit to protect them from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} aggression.
column2: 一段时间以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的研究设施一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}势力的攻击. 我们不愿意让非战斗人员继续冒着生命危险，我们决定撤离他们. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}将为雇佣兵部队提供丰厚报酬，以保护他们免受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的攻击.

column1: Our scouts have observed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military engineers constructing fortified gun emplacements in a contested region. We'd like you to locate and destroy all the heavy weapons and bunkers from a specific section of their line. You are free to engage any enemy mobile forces in the AO, we will provide additional compensation at standard rates for any elements you destroy.
column2: 我们的侦察兵观察到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的军事工程人员正在一处争议区域修建加固炮台. 我们希望你们定位并摧毁其防线特定区域内的所有重型武器和碉堡. 你们可以自由攻击作战区域内的任何敌方机动部队，我们将按标准费率对你们摧毁的任何目标提供额外报酬.

column1: Our scouts have observed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units covertly surveying military and industrial targets. This increased activity from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} near several priority facilities suggests a strike is coming soon. We're tasking you with intercepting the scout lance that's identifying targets, and eliminating it before it can report back.
column2: 我们的侦察兵发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在秘密调查军事和工业目标. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在多个重点设施附近的这种频繁活动表明，一次打击可能即将发生. 我们委派你去拦截正在侦察目标的小队，并在它发回报告前将其消灭.

column1: Our sensors indicate several large groups of incoming vehicles and BattleMechs, Commander. Whoever they are, I need you to hold them off and drive them away. Above all, they cannot be allowed to free Ms. Hadley from confinement. She belongs to us.
column2: 我们的传感器显示有多支大型车辆和战斗机甲部队正在逼近，指挥官. 无论他们是谁，我都需要你挡住他们并将其击退. 最重要的是——绝不能让他们把哈德利女士从监禁中解救出来. 她是我们的.

column1: Our sources on the planet have alerted us to a convoy of vehicles being transferred to an otherwise undefended military base. If we act quickly, we can destroy that convoy before it has a chance to reinforce the base. Normally we wouldn't be concerned about a simple vehicle convoy, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives report that one of the vehicles is a fully operational Schrek PPC carrier. That's not a threat we can afford to ignore. We need you to eliminate that convoy before they make it to their base.
column2: 我们在这颗行星的情报源警告我们，一支车队正被调往一座原本防御空虚的军事基地. 如果我们行动迅速的话，就能在该车队有机会增援基地之前将其摧毁. 通常情况下，我们不会关注一支普通的车队，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员报告称，其中一辆车辆是“史瑞克”粒子加农炮运载车. 那可不是我们可以忽视的威胁. 我们需要你赶在车队到达基地之前将其歼灭.

column1: Our spies report that a veteran {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior from the Succession Wars retired to this system, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would very much like to keep him retired. Permanently if possible. We've been monitoring a DropShip in orbit around the planet, and believe that they're preparing for a pickup. We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.
column2: 我们的间谍报告称，一位继承战争时期的资深{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士已经退役到该星系，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}非常希望确保他保持退役状态——最好是永久退役. 我们一直监控着一艘环绕该行星的空投艇，相信他们正准备接走他. 我们需要你空投过去，在这名机甲战士再获起用之前截下他. 他很有可能身处一部相当厚重的机甲中，因此在交战时务必小心.

column1: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to catch her while she's still in transit, and eliminate her. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
column2: 我们对军事设施的打击创造了一个机会，指挥官. Claybrooke的军事指挥官，Chestine中校，正在逃离首都前往一个未公开的安全地点 - 大概是为了避免成为另一次打击的目标. 如果我们行动迅速，应该能在她还在途中时截住她，并将她消灭. 这个任务是卡瓦诺战区总督Iris Steiner女公爵亲自要求的，所以我们取得成功至关重要.

column1: Our strike on the military facility has presented an opportunity, Commander. The military ruler of Claybrooke, Lieutenant Colonel Chestine, is fleeing the capital for an undisclosed secure location, presumably to avoid being targeted by another strike. If we move quickly, we should be able to intercept her convoy and take her captive. This mission was requested personally by Duchess Iris Steiner, the Margrave of Cavanaugh Theater, so it is absolutely critical that we succeed.
column2: 我们对军事设施的打击创造了一个机会，指挥官. Claybrooke的军事指挥官，Chestine中校，正在逃离首都前往一个未公开的安全地点 - 大概是为了避免成为另一次打击的目标. 如果我们行动迅速，应该能在途中拦截她的车队并俘虏她. 这个任务是卡瓦诺战区总督Iris Steiner女公爵亲自要求的，所以我们取得成功至关重要.

column1: Our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} enemies are hiding restricted munitions in a series of warehouses used to distribute medical supplies. We would make a public accusation that they're hiding munitions in medical supplies, but that would reveal the source of our intel. Instead, we need you to go in and do what we cannot: destroy the warehouses.
column2: 我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人在一系列用于分发医疗物资的仓库中隐藏了受管控的军火. 我们本可以公开指控他们将军火藏在医疗物资中，但这会暴露我们的情报来源. 因此，我们需要你亲自出手完，成我们无法做到的事情: 摧毁这些仓库.

column1: Over the coming weeks, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} plans to launch a devastating offensive against {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, catching the defenders off guard and taking the planet before they can properly mobilize. They've put out a discreet call for mercenary commands like ours to supplement their forces.
column2: 未来数周内，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}计划对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}发动毁灭性攻势，趁守军不备，在其完成动员前夺取该星球. 他们已秘密发出征召令，招募我们这样的佣兵部队增援其兵力.

column1: Over the coming weeks, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} plans to launch a series of raids on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, aiming to weaken the defending forces and make off with as much materiel and wealth as possible before the defenders can properly mobilize. They've put out a discreet call for mercenary commands like ours to supplement their forces.
column2: 未来数周内，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}计划对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}发动一系列突袭，旨在削弱守军力量，并尽可能在守军完成动员前掠夺大量物资与财富. 他们已暗中征召我们这样的佣兵部队增援其兵力.

column1: Over the past few weeks we've been engaged in small stage skirmishes with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} in and around {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. The company commander must feel they can't continue their campaign because they've requested a duel to claim this local forward base. Little do they know that we've recently run out of supplies so we've very much taken them up on their offer. This is where you come in. We need you to win this for us, Commander.
column2: 过去几周里，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}及其周边区域与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}进行小规模冲突. 连队指挥官一定是觉得他们无法继续这场战役了，因为他们已经请求进行一场决斗来夺取这个前沿基地. 他们不知道的是，我们最近刚好补给耗尽，所以我们非常乐意接受他们的提议. 这就是需要你出马的地方了. 我们需要你为我们赢得这场决斗，指挥官.

column1: Perfect Call Shots and 10% Damage Boost
column2: 完美精准射击并增加10%伤害

column1: Personally, I'm not above simple robbery to pay the bills, Commander.
column2: 就我个人而言，我并不喜欢单纯靠抢劫来赚钱，指挥官.

column1: Pirate Base straight ahead, and beyond that their drop zone. Let's move up and send a message!
column2: 海盗基地就在正前方，再过去是他们的投放区。我们推进，发个信息过去！

column1: Pirates aren't known for competent planning, Commander. Still, their screw-up is our payday.
column2: 指挥官，海盗不擅长策划. 不过，他们搞砸了就是我们发财的时候.

column1: Pirates got to know what's on those vehicles by now. Might be a fight.
column2: 海盗现在肯定已经知道那些车辆上装的是什么了。可能会有一场仗打。

column1: Pirates tend not to be the best armed forces, at least.
column2: 至少，海盗往往不是装备最好的军队。

column1: Proceed to Itrom to protect its people from the aggressors. The latest intel recommends a lance that balances speed and firepower, but can deal with Itrom's searing heat. Further details will be provided upon your arrival.
column2: 前往伊特罗姆，保护其民众免受侵略者之害。最新情报建议组建一支兼顾速度与火力的分队，同时能应对伊特罗姆的灼热高温。抵达后将提供更多细节。

column1: Professor Mencius Horvat is waiting for you in the Tournament arena. He expects you to play by his rules—to let him lead a pair of your MechWarriors like lambs to the slaughter. Instead, you're going to show him the kind of firepower that your company can really bring down. Destroy him, and the MIIO will reward you accordingly.
column2: 孟修斯·霍瓦特教授正在锦标赛竞技场等你。他指望你按他的规则行事——让他像牵羊入屠宰场一样带走你的两名机甲战士。而你，要让他见识你的连队真正能倾泻怎样的火力。干掉他，MIIO 会给予相应的回报。

column1: Purrfect, now we get to witness the full firepower of this fully armed and operational… We have orbital units standing by with some particularly impressive fireworks ready to display, just for us.  You’ve got to move in and triangulate the target for us so we can accurately dispense some flashy justice. Yes, we enjoy a few explosions when we’re the ones setting them off. Additionally we have roused some local support for the battle, expect them to provide assistance as best they can
column2: 完美，现在我们可以见证这套全副武装、完全运作的……的完整火力了。我们有轨道单位待命，准备好一些特别震撼的烟火表演，专为我们展示。你得推进去并为目标做三角定位，好让我们准确地施放华丽的正义。是的，当我们是点火的那一方时，我们挺享受几次爆炸的。此外我们还为该战唤起了当地一些支援，预计他们会尽力提供协助

column1: Remember, Dominik is a sniper—he likes to sit back and punch holes in things at range, and his 'Mech is equipped to facilitate that. I'd suggest closing into knife-fight range if possible.
column2: 记住，多米尼克是个狙击手——他喜欢待在后面，在远距离上把东西打穿，而他的机甲就是为此配备的。如果可能，我建议你逼近到白刃距离。

column1: Remember, Orchid is a brawler—she likes to get in close, and her 'Mech is equipped to facilitate that. I'd suggest that you engage her from range if possible.
column2: 记住，奥琪德是个近战好手——她喜欢贴身缠斗，而她的机甲也是为此配备的。如果可能，我建议你从远距离与她交战。

column1: Remember, Viribium is an airless planet. Watch your heat levels out there.
column2: 别忘了，维里比姆是一颗没有大气层的行星. 注意机甲的热量.

column1: Remember, clearing the enemry forces here isn't our objective. Getting back the Nyans stuff is. The mechs are incidental... however they're still going to be to be shooting our 'Mechs in the ass, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
column2: 记住，清掉这里的敌军不是我们的目标。夺回尼扬的东西才是。机甲是附带的……不过它们仍然会朝我们机甲的屁股开火，指挥官。我们得保持移动。

column1: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in among their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
column2: 有传言说{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在他们的医疗物资中夹带走私受管控的军火. 至少从表面上看，我们的任务是人道主义的护送任务.

column1: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in amongst their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
column2: 有传言称{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受限弹药混在医疗物资中走私。至少表面上，我们的任务被说成是一次人道主义护送。

column1: Safe bet the Galaxy Commander has more forces near by, look out for them, this could be dangerous.
column2: 星系指挥官附近很可能有更多部队，当心他们，这可能会很危险。

column1: Satellite surveillance pictures show that a heavy lance was inserted onto the planet's surface by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip. Currently we believe they're securing their LZ, preparing for whatever operation they have planned. Before they finish securing the area, we'd like you to interrupt them. They're heavily armed so expect strong resistance.
column2: 卫星监控照片显示，有一支重型机甲小队由一艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇投放到了行星表面. 我们相信他们目前正在巩固着陆区，为接下来的行动做准备. 在他们清理完该区域之前，我们希望你阻止他们. 他们全副武装，所以预计会有强烈抵抗.

column1: Seems simple enough. Stop a local government convoy carrying a suspected traitor. No one should even care if he dies to be honest.
column2: 听起来够简单。拦下一支载着一名疑似叛徒的当地政府车队。说实话，就算他死了也该没人在乎。

column1: Seems straightforward enough, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Get in there and make it happen.
column2: 任务很明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 进场执行吧.

column1: Seismic disturbances picked up by one of our recon units on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} suggest that someone is conducting underground nuclear tests on this supposedly abandoned world. We believe the culprits are operating out of a secret {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility, and we've picked up transmissions indicating they intend to move their newly developed weapons to a hidden spaceport and then transport them off-world. Needless to say, this isn't an acceptable outcome for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}.
column2: 我们的一支侦察单位在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}收到的地震扰动显示，有人在这颗本应荒凉的星球进行地下核试验. 我们相信元凶正在一处秘密{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施中行动，而我们收到的讯息显示他们要将新研发的武器送往一座秘密太空港，运出这颗星球. 不必说，这不是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}所能接受的结果.

column1: Semi-final of the Solaris Assault Tank Championship. You have to eliminate the opponent to move to the next stage.
column2: 索拉里斯突击坦克锦标赛的半决赛。你必须消灭对手才能进入下一轮。

column1: Semi-final of the Solaris Heavy Championship. You have to eliminate the opponent to move to the next stage.
column2: 索拉里斯重型锦标赛半决赛。你必须消灭对手才能晋级。

column1: Semi-final of the Solaris Light Championship. You have to eliminate the opponent to move to the next stage.
column2: 索拉里斯轻型锦标赛半决赛。你必须消灭对手才能晋级。

column1: Semi-final of the Solaris Medium Championship. You have to eliminate the opponent to move to the next stage.
column2: 索拉里斯中型锦标赛的半决赛。你必须消灭对手才能进入下一轮。

column1: Semi-final of the Solaris Medium Tank Championship. You have to eliminate the opponent to move to the next stage.
column2: 索拉里斯中型坦克锦标赛半决赛。你必须消灭对手才能进入下一阶段。

column1: Setting aside the rumors of LosTech, this contract is an excellent opportunity to take payment in 'Mech parts and salvage rights, as {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} MechTechs are on-site for recovery.
column2: 撇开那些关于失落科技的传言不谈，这份合约是个用机甲部件和打捞权作为报酬的绝佳机会，因为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的机甲技师会在现场进行回收工作.

column1: She got through that entire briefing without saying, \"The hunter will become the hunted.\" I'm pleasantly surprised.
column2: 她整个简报都没说出“猎手终成猎物”. 令人意外地惊讶.

column1: She may have escaped us earlier, but I see her lance up ahead. Get down there and make sure there is nothing left to salvage.
column2: 她上次可能从我们手里逃脱了，但我看到她的分队就在前面。下去，确保没留下任何可打捞的东西。

column1: She really has a problem getting good intel.
column2: 她确实很难搞到好情报。

column1: Should be a simple pickup job, Commander, but remember that we're going in light, which means the pickup 'Mech is going to be more vulnerable than usual.
column2: 这应该只是个简单的接应任务，指挥官，但记住我们是轻装进入. 这意味着接应机甲会比平时更脆弱.

column1: Simply mark the three designated target zones and watch the fireworks, knowing you're doing some good in the galaxy, Commander. This facility has to be destroyed completely.
column2: 只需标出三个指定目标区域，然后看烟花绽放，同时知道自己为这个银河做了些好事，指挥官。这处设施必须被彻底摧毁。

column1: Singh still believes that Gurung was behind the attacks on his family. That's bad news for Gurung, but it's good for us. Let's do this thing and get paid.
column2: 辛格仍然认为古隆是袭击他家族的幕后黑手. 这对古隆是坏消息，但对我们有利. 按计划行事并拿到酬金.

column1: Smooth sailing so far, Commander.
column2: 到目前为止一帆风顺，指挥官。

column1: Smugglers funded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} have set up just outside our borders, causing an ongoing problem for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. We'd like to cut the head off this particular snake with a targeted, limited, and deniable strike on their leader. Ideally, this will shut them down permanently.
column2: 由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}资助的走私者已在我们的边界外建立据点，持续干扰{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动. 我们希望对他们的头目进行一次针对性、有限且可撇清关系的打击，斩断这条蛇的七寸. 理想的情况下，这将使其彻底瓦解.

column1: So, clean up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
column2: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还要把功劳让出去. 真是糟糕的局面. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会了解内情.

column1: So, pick up the mess AND give away the credit. What a raw situation. At least the MRB knows the deal.
column2: 所以，既要收拾烂摊子，还得把功劳让给别人. 真是亏大了. 至少雇佣兵审查委员会知道内情.

column1: Solaris gladiators are known for their unusual 'Mech designs. Keep an eye out and expect the unexpected.
column2: 索拉里斯角斗士以其独特的机甲设计而闻名. 保持警惕，随时准备迎接意想不到的情况.

column1: Solving the lack of available experienced units by hiring the best? Well, they at least know who to turn to!
column2: 通过雇佣最优秀的人才来解决缺少有经验部队的问题? 好吧，他们至少知道该找谁!

column1: Some of our favorite people are currently being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility. We'd like to break them out and evacuate them, but the prison's protected by a nearby military base. We're very competent at prison breaks, but less experienced at defending bases from lances of military 'Mechs. That's where you come in! We'll seize control of the prison, and then you land and shoot anyone who tries to keep us from evacuating our dear friends. In fact, it would probably be best if you simply destroyed their base entirely. Wouldn't do to have them tracking us!
column2: 我们的一些挚友正被关押在一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}监狱设施中. 我们想救他们出来并撤离，但那座监狱由附近的军事基地保护. 我们在越狱方面很在行，但在抵挡一整支军事机甲小队攻击基地这方面却缺乏经验. 这正是需要你们出手的时候！我们将夺取监狱控制权，而后你们降落并消灭任何企图阻挠我们撤离的敌人. 事实上，你们最好干脆把他们的基地彻底摧毁，免得他们追踪我们！

column1: Some training work sounds nice about now. It's someone still learning, so how hard can it be?
column2: 现在来点训练任务听起来不错. 对方还是个在学的新手，能有多难呢?

column1: Somehow I doubt there's a lost 'Mech factory on this backwater world. It probably manufactures low-g bicycles or something else as useless.
column2: 我有点怀疑这颗穷乡僻壤上会有什么失落的机甲工厂。它大概生产低重力自行车或者别的同样没用的东西。

column1: Somehow I doubt there's a lost 'Mech factory on this backwater world. It probably manufactures low-g bicycles or something else useless.
column2: 不知怎的，我怀疑在这颗闭塞的星球上有一座失落的机甲工厂. 也许它生产低重力自行车或其它什么无用的东西.

column1: Somehow we've let {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} get their hands on one of our less reliable suppliers. It only took them a few days to break her, and now she's ready to spill all kinds of secrets in court. That isn't in our best interests, and since you're talking to us, it's not in yours, either. We'd like to demonstrate what happens to those who snitch. She's being transported to a secure facility by ground vehicle. We don't know which vehicle she'll be in, so just take them all out. If you help us send a message by wiping out all the escorts, there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 不知怎的，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}控制了我们一位不太可靠的供应商. 他们只用了几天就攻破了她，而现在她准备出庭托出所有秘密. 这对我们没有任何好处，而既然你也在跟我们打交道，那这事对你来说也同样不利. 我们想让她明白，告密者会有什么下场. 她正由地面车辆运往一座安全设施. 我们不知道她在哪辆车上，所以只管全部干掉就行. 如果你扫荡了所有护卫，帮我们传达了信息，我们会给你一笔奖金.

column1: Somehow we've let {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} get their hands on one of our less reliable suppliers. It only took them a few days to break her, and now she's ready to spill all kinds of secrets in court. That isn't in our best interests, and since you're talking to us, it's not in yours, either. We'd like to do a little bit of witness tampering, of the fatal variety. She's being transported to a secure facility by ground vehicle. We don't know which vehicle she'll be in, so just take them all out. If you help us send a message by wiping out all the escorts, there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 不知怎的，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}控制了我们一位不太可靠的供应商. 他们只用了几天就攻破了她，而现在她准备出庭托出所有秘密. 这对我们没有任何好处，而既然你也在跟我们打交道，那这事对你来说也同样不利. 我们希望进行一些证人干预，致命的那种. 她将由地面车辆运往一座安全设施. 我们不知道她会在哪辆车上，所以只管全部干掉就行. 如果你扫荡了所有护卫，我们会给你一笔奖金.

column1: Somehow, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered one of our storehouses. If it were just drugs or stolen goods, we'd let them seize it and write it off as a loss. But it's a weapons stockpile, and those damn things are hard to move from one system to another. We'd like you to protect our guns while our people load them onto transports and we evacuate them.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局不知怎的发现了我们一处仓库. 若只是药品或赃物，我们大可以任其查封，并当作损失处理. 可那是一座军火库，这些该死的东西在星系间运输极为困难. 希望你们能在我方人员装运货物时保护这批枪炮，协助我们完成撤离.

column1: Someone's in serious trouble --- and they need our help now.
column2: 有人陷入了大麻烦——他们现在需要我们的帮助.

column1: Sometimes the best strategy is to stretch, bounce, and hope you don't snap.
column2: 有时候，最好的策略是拉伸、弹跳，并希望自己不会被崩断.

column1: Sometimes you're left with nothing but bad options. This is one of those times, but we're professionals, and it's on us to handle it.
column2: 有时候你只能从糟糕的选项里做选择. 现在就是这种时刻，但我们是专业人士，必须处理好它.

column1: Sounds like someone has a case of the Mondays.
column2: 听起来有人得了周一综合症。

column1: Sounds like someone you may have run into before Commander. I wonder, do they write the name in blood on themselves? We should ask before the battle starts.
column2: 听起来像是你以前可能遇到过的人，指挥官. 我很好奇，他们会在自己身上用血写下名字吗? 我们应该在战斗开始前问问.

column1: Sounds like they want us to bring the big guns, Commander. I'll let Yang know; he's going to want to watch.
column2: 听起来他们是想让我们带上大家伙了，指挥官. 我会通知杨一声; 他肯定想亲眼看看.

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager.  The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well.  Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要袭击一个中层管理. 目标不会孤身一人，指挥官，如果我们清除了护卫单位就会有奖金. 不过，要是事态过于危险的话，我们总可以打了就跑.

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. Not much glory, but it pays. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要袭击一个中层管理. 这不怎么光荣，可有钱拿. 目标不会孤身一人，指挥官，如果我们清除了护卫单位就会有奖金. 不过，要是事态过于危险的话，我们总可以打了就跑.

column1: Sounds like we'll be hitting a middle manager. The target won't be alone, Commander, and there's a bonus if we clean up the escorting units as well. Still, if things get too hot, we can always hit and run.
column2: 听起来我们要袭击一个中层管理. 目标不会孤身一人，指挥官，如果我们清除了护卫单位就会有奖金. 不过，要是事态过于危险的话，我们总可以打了就跑.

column1: Spazz is a nasty, nasty drug, Commander, but not really recreational in any way. If some MechWarrior wants to burn themself out on the stuff, that's on them.
column2: 斯帕齐是一种非常，非常危险的药物，指挥官，但无论如何都没有真正的消遣作用. 如果有机甲战士想用这东西燃尽自己，那随他们便.

column1: Straight out of the holovids, Commander. A showdown at high noon... or whatever time it will be on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
column2: 简直就像全息影剧里的情节，指挥官. 一场正午时分的决斗……或者说，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上不管是什么时候吧.

column1: Subcommander Tianyu isn't going to let us keep what's in this vault without a fight, and it'll take time for Yang's crew to gather up all the pieces of that SLDF 'Mech. Now that we're committed to doing this, let's do it right.
column2: 天宇副指挥官不会不战而退就将仓库里的东西留给我们——而杨的团队需要时间，收集那台SLDF机甲的所有部件. 既然我们已经决定要这么做，那就把事情做得漂亮.

column1: Swap out the fatigued pilots for fresh ones, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，把疲劳的机师换成精神饱满的。

column1: Taking down a Dropship on a full night's rest and fully repaired 'Mechs might be easier. Make sure to withdraw Commander, if you get stuck.
column2: 如果有一整晚休息和完好机甲，干掉空投艇也许更容易。指挥官，如果陷住了，务必撤退。

column1: Taking down assault 'Mechs isn't going to be easy, Commander, but if we can play them off against each other, we might make out quite well on this one.
column2: 摧毁一部袭击型机甲并不容易，指挥官，但如果我们能让他们鹬蚌相争，也许我们这次能大赚一笔.

column1: Taking fire for them isn't desirable, but it's how we earn our keep.
column2: 为他们承受火力并非理想之事，但这正是我们谋生的方式.

column1: Taking it directly to the head of the clan. Nothing like some honorable combat in the morning
column2: 直接把事摊到氏族首领面前。早上来点荣誉战斗再没有更好的了

column1: Terrorist strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the terrorists and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the terrorists.
column2: 恐怖分子针对我们设施的袭击越来越多了，根据我们的情报来看，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助恐怖分子，以轻武器、炸药和医疗用品的形式提供后勤支援. 我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，并且在它抵达恐怖分子之前就消灭它.

column1: That little bastard and his fat friend are not getting away from me. Take the fight to them Commander.
column2: 那个小混蛋和他那个胖朋友别想从我手里跑掉。指挥官，把战斗打到他们身上去。

column1: The Dobrev is gone, but its crew left an undefined amount of valuable contraband behind at the spaceport. Unfortunately, the Black Widow wants to melt every scrap of that contraband to slag. The Moderbjörn will draw the Black Widow's attention away from our AO, which should buy Yang and me enough time to ransack the spaceport. We'll be relying on your lance to protect us from anyone else who might come along.
column2: 多布雷夫号 已经离开，但它的船员在太空港留下了数量不明的贵重违禁品. 不幸的是，黑寡妇打算把这些违禁品全都熔成废渣.“熊妈妈”会负责吸引黑寡妇的注意力，把她调离我们的行动区域. 这应该能为杨和我争取足够的时间彻底搜查太空港. 我们将依靠你的机甲小队来保护我们，以防其他不速之客前来干扰.

column1: The Baumann Group's made a lot of money off of the Dobrev. We're gonna find out where they took it—and get a piece of the profits for ourselves while we're at it.
column2: 鲍曼集团靠多布雷夫赚了大钱。我们要查出他们把它带到哪儿去了——顺便给自己分一份利润。

column1: The Beasts of Balawat have units scattered all across this basin. More importantly, they've got a monster LRM boat that needs to go down before we can even try to move the convoy to a landing site. It's an assault 'Mech, Stalker-class, heavily modified for indirect fire. Destroy it and proceed to the rendezvous site.
column2: “巴拉瓦特野兽”的单位分散在整个盆地. 但更糟糕的是他们有一个怪物级远程火箭平台，在我们尝试将车队转移到撤离点之前必须先干掉它. 那是一台袭击型机甲，“潜行者”，经过大幅改装后已完全转换为间接火力. 摧毁它后前往汇合点.

column1: The Beasts of Balawat's armory is just ahead of you, Commander. Strike swiftly, take the facility, and hold it until Megan and Tempest can be extracted. The Kell Hounds and I will handle Rhee and her people. Let's do this.
column2: “巴拉瓦特野兽”的军械库就在前方，指挥官. 迅速突击，夺取设施，坚守至梅根与坦佩斯特获救. 凯尔猎犬小队会处理Rhee及其手下. 开始行动！

column1: The Clan forward base is directly ahead of you. Capture it to get the Clan Galaxy Commander's attention. We want you to make a noise and show these interlopers that the Inner Sphere isn't finished here.
column2: 部族前进基地就在你正前方。夺取它以引起部族星系指挥官的注意。我们要你闹出动静，让这些闯入者知道内层星域在这里还没完。

column1: The Davion sensor array you'll need to capture is just ahead, Commander. Take it, and Ms. Meyer will have what she needs to neutralize Lees's threat to the Argo.
column2: 你需要捕获的戴维恩传感器阵列就在前方，指挥官. 夺下它，梅耶女士就可以削弱利斯对阿尔戈号 的威胁.

column1: The Defending army has a starport nearby. We have been contracted to disable the starport so the defending army will be cut off from their reinforcements.
column2: 防守方在附近有一处星港。我们已签约要瘫痪该星港，使防守军与其增援隔绝。

column1: The Employer's Army has been locked in a stalemate with the enemy for a few days now. In the end, it's gonna come down to whichever side has the most ammo, so let's make sure it's our Employers.
column2: 雇主的军队已与敌人僵持数日。最终胜负取决于哪一方弹药更多，所以我们得确保是我们的雇主。

column1: The FedSuns are going to assume we're still back at the base getting things loaded up and ready to go, Commander. Let's give them a surprise.
column2: 恒星联邦会以为我们还待在基地里装货做撤离准备呢，指挥官. 咱们给他们个惊喜吧.

column1: The Federated Suns have constructed a forward base in the no-man's-land between their territory and ours on Flintoft's northern continent. We need you to eliminate their garrison and capture that base. We will remit payment when you've completed the job and secured the base.
column2: 恒星联邦在弗林托夫特北部大陆的领土与我方控制区间的无人地带建立了一个前沿基地. 我们需要你消灭其驻军并夺取该基地. 完成任务并控制该基地后，我们将支付报酬.

column1: The Governor of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a proxy war duel by a rival {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor. We'd like you to be his proxy in this fight. If you lose, we'll just deny it was ever agreed to. We don't want to actually risk anything here.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的总督受到一位敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督挑战，要求进行代理战争决斗. 我们希望你能在这场战斗中担任他的代理. 如果输了，我们就会矢口否认曾有过此约定. 我们可不想在这儿真冒任何风险.

column1: The ISF believes that Nephrite has already made planetfall and is tracking a FedSuns convoy moving out from the landing site. It's probable that the target is in the convoy; if we strike now, we should be able to end this little insurrection before it even begins. Engage the vehicles and destroy them all. Then, our people will sort through the remains and see if we hit our target. If we're lucky, we'll be done with this in time for dinner.
column2: ISF认为，软玉已经登陆，并且正在追踪一支从着陆点出发的恒星联邦车队. 目标很可能就在车队之中. 如果我们现在发动攻击，应该能在这场小型叛乱开始之前就将其扼杀. 攻击并摧毁所有车辆. 之后，我们的人会清理残骸，以确定是否达成了目标. 运气好的话，我们还能赶在晚饭前收工.

column1: The Khan of the clan is up ahead. End his misery, Commander
column2: 这个氏族的可汗就在前方。结束他的痛苦吧，指挥官

column1: The Pirates are trying to retake their base. Don't let them have it!
column2: 海盗正试图夺回他们的基地。别让他们得逞！

column1: The Raptors are holed up at their Salinization Plant, converting all the raw materials they can get their hands on into salt. Intercepted transmissions from the facility have been somewhat garbled, but they're apparently on the brink of setting up something called a 'salt meme economy', whatever that is. What they're up to doesn't really matter; we're going to go in, demolish their operation, take them out, and collect that bounty.
column2: 猛禽组织正龟缩在他们的盐碱化工厂里，把能搞到手的所有原材料都转化成盐. 截获的工厂通讯有些模糊不清，但他们显然快要建立起一个叫“盐模因经济”的东西了，鬼知道那是什么. 不过他们到底想干什么并不重要; 我们要冲进去，摧毁他们的行动，干掉他们，然后领走那笔赏金.

column1: The Raptors are notorious for using coordinated unit tactics, flanking, and misdirection. Be on your guard, Commander.
column2: 猛禽组织以运用协同单位战术、侧翼包抄和声东击西而臭名昭著. 请保持警惕，指挥官.

column1: The Steel Beast is back. And he's searching for revenge.
column2: 钢铁野兽回来了。而他正在寻找复仇。

column1: The Stratford Narwhal is one of Garrilac's favorite watering holes. It's also a cesspool of vice, corruption, and terrible music. Taking it out may prove more difficult than you'd think; the bar was built in the husk of an old military complex, and its MechWarrior patrons will probably attack you on sight.
column2: 斯特拉特福独角鲸是加瑞拉克喜欢的酒馆之一. 同时也是罪恶、腐败和糟糕音乐的污水坑. 端掉它可能比你想象的更困难. 这家酒吧建在一座废弃的旧军用设施遗骸中，而且里面的机甲战士常客很可能一见到你就会立刻发动攻击.

column1: The Target has gone to ground, apparently a Stable has set up base for him here to retreat to. I say we blow it sky high and end our Tubb-y friend.
column2: 目标已转入地下，显然有一家马疚在此为他设了据点供他退守。我说我们把它炸上天，了结我们这位胖乎乎的塔布朋友。

column1: The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM],FWLM]] Force Commander is currently traveling between installations on an inspection tour. He is heavily guarded, with two escorting lances of 'Mechs piloted by veterans who have served with him for years. However, this is still the best opportunity we'll have to strike at the League's command structure in Claybrooke.
column2: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMarikFWLM]  自由世界联盟军队]]的部队指挥官目前正在各设施之间进行视察旅行。他护卫森严，有两支由跟随他多年的老兵驾驶的机甲小队护航。但即便如此，这仍是我们打击克莱布鲁克联盟指挥体系的最佳机会。

column1: The bar for an 'honest' fight in these parts is set so low it's usually underground. Be cautious, Commander.
column2: 在这一带，“诚实“对决的门槛低到通常在地下。谨慎点，指挥官。

column1: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and destroy the facility.
column2: 指挥官，通讯设施并未如我们所愿察觉到我们的存在。这意味着我们能让你的队伍在无人察觉的情况下着陆并摧毁该设施。

column1: The communications facility has not been alerted to our presence, as we'd hoped, Commander. That means we will be able to land your team unnoticed and disable the facility. The defenses will be light; it has one lance as a garrison and one lance as a patrol element, plus fixed gun emplacements. However, I'd still recommend caution, given the limited force strength we were able to drop and still remain covert. As mentioned, the covert approach means we have limited intel about the base itself, so you'll be operating somewhat blind at first.
column2: 正如我们所希望的那样，通信基地尚未察觉我方行动，指挥官. 这意味着你的部队可秘密降落并瘫痪该设施. 防御不会很强，驻守机甲仅有一个编队，巡逻另有一个编队，外加固定炮台. 尽管如此，鉴于为保持隐蔽只能投入有限兵力，我仍建议谨慎行事. 如前所述，隐蔽行动导致我们对基地情报掌握有限. 因此，初期行动将带有一定未知性.

column1: The contract does not specify any retrieval, Commander. We are to bring the base down and destroy the tech with it.
column2: 合约没有指定任何回收项目，指挥官. 我们要把基地毁掉，连同技术一起摧毁.

column1: The contract is void if either station falls to enemy action.
column2: 如果任一发电站被敌方攻陷，合约即告无效.

column1: The destruction of either plant would trigger a humanitarian crisis affecting thousands of civilians.  No pressure, Commander.
column2: 摧毁任一座工厂都会引发一场影响数千平民的人道主义危机。别紧张，指挥官。

column1: The enemy has to be expecting an attempt to break their siege, so there will be significant resistance.
column2: 敌人肯定会料到有人要尝试图突破他们的包围，所以会有激烈抵抗.

column1: The fine print on the contract doesn't specify anything about a fair fight. Just saying.
column2: 合约的小字部分可没规定什么公平对决。我就随口一说。

column1: The forces protecting this planet have departed and a local militia has sprouted up in its place. The militia are fighting a losing battle against some especially well-equipped pirates, with no connections to any other group you've encountered. Your assistance in this sensitive matter is requested.
column2: 保护这颗行星的部队已经撤离，取而代之的是一支当地民兵。那支民兵正与一些装备特别精良的海盗打一场必败之仗，那些海盗与你此前遭遇过的任何团体都没有关联。请你协助处理这一敏感事务。

column1: The implication, of course, is that if we're not quick enough, we'll have multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units up our exhaust vents.
column2: 这话的潜台词当然是——如果我们行动不够迅速，就会有成群的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队紧追在我们屁股后面.

column1: The intel you got from the Iron Sparrow's courier points here, to the warehouse you'll find just ahead. Take it for House Liao until the Liao Reserves arrive to relieve you.
column2: 你从“铁麻雀”信使那里获取的情报，指向你前方的这个仓库. 为廖氏坚守该据点，直至廖式预备队前来换防.

column1: The last of the Volkovites have packed themselves onto a series of transport vehicles, and they're ready to roll. We've lined up a DropShip to take them to Joppa, but you're gonna have to get 'em there. We're nearly through this situation, Commander… just a little bit further to go.
column2: 最后一批沃尔科维特人已经挤进了一串运输车辆，随时可以出发。我们已经安排好一艘空投艇送他们去约帕，但你得把他们送到那儿。我们快熬过这个局面了，指挥官……再往前走一点点就到了。

column1: The last time I checked, Binton and Modge had a bunch of combat vehicles in the streets around my time-share. Maybe a light 'Mech or two, I can't say for sure. Get 'em off my back, and then we'll conclude our business with the antique staplers.
column2: 我上次检查时，Binton和Modge在我那分时度假屋周围的街道上部署了一堆战斗车辆. 可能还有一两台轻型机甲，这我说不准. 帮我把这些尾巴清理掉，然后我们再接着谈那古董订书机的事儿.

column1: The legal justification here sounds sketchy, Commander, but we're mercenaries, not lawyers. As long as they're happy, we get paid.
column2: 这里的法理听起来很粗糙，指挥官，但我们是雇佣兵，不是律师. 只要他们高兴，我们就会得到报酬.

column1: The location of the bunker is extremely well concealed, presumably to prevent exactly the kind of orbital strike we're planning to make. For us to locate it, you'll need to download transmission data from a logistics base in the region. That should give us a rough location. The logistics base is likely to be well defended, but if we're going to keep from alerting the Capellans to our plan, you'll need to insert with a lighter lance than you may be used to. Remember that all we need is the data; any enemy forces present are incidental.
column2: 地堡的位置极其隐蔽. 估计正是为了防范我们计划实施的这种轨道打击. 为了让我们能定位它，你需要从该地区的一座后勤基地下载传输数据. 这应该能给我们一个大致的位置. 后勤基地很可能防守严密，但要想不打草惊蛇、让卡佩拉人察觉到我们的计划，你就得带一支比平时更轻量级的小队渗透进去. 记住，我们需要的只是数据. 任何在场的敌军都只是次要目标.

column1: The message seems to be at least as important as the cargo. If we clean up the escorts to ensure their salvage crew's safety, there's a bonus in it for us.
column2: 这个信息似乎跟货物一样重要. 如果我们清理掉护卫部队，确保他们的打捞小队安全行动，就能得到一笔额外奖金.

column1: The mission is to capture the enemy base intact. The QuadVees will be a critical asset for this mission. We need to approach the base carefully, neutralize any enemy forces, and then secure the facility. Once we have control, we can search for any intelligence that might be valuable to our cause.
column2: 任务是完整夺取敌方基地。四足机甲将是这次任务的关键资产。我们需要谨慎接近基地，清除任何敌军，然后拿下该设施。一旦控制住，我们就能搜寻任何可能对我们事业有价值的情报。

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us who can call for help. The vehicles will do what vehicles always do in fights with 'Mechs: they'll die.
column2: 指挥官，我认为唯一的风险在于敌方可能会设法派人突破我们的防线去求救. 车辆在与机甲的战斗中总会落得同样的下场: 它们会被摧毁.

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past us.
column2: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过我们身边。

column1: The only real danger I see here, Commander, is if they manage to slip someone past.
column2: 指挥官，我在这里看到的唯一真正危险，是他们设法让人溜过去。

column1: The only way we get off this planet and find out what kind of double cross the Kuritans are pulling here is to rescue Carlyle and his people.
column2: 要想离开这颗星球并揭穿栗田的阴谋，唯一的方法就是救出卡莱尔和他的部下.

column1: The opponent is not very dangerous, but you have to remain focused.
column2: 对手并不很危险，但你必须保持专注。

column1: The participants are going weapons-hot for this one, and hopefully we'll have a better outcome than the battle they're reenacting.
column2: 这次的参与者将开启武器实弹模式，希望我们的结果能比他们所重演的那场战役要好.

column1: The position of one of our lances of fire support vehicles has become untenable due to the proximity of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces. We'd like you to provide security while we relocate them.
column2: 由于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队逼近，我们的一支火力支援车辆小队所在阵地已无法坚守. 我们希望你在重新部署期间为他们提供安全掩护.

column1: The punishment for Mutiny, is called Walking the Plank. In this case I don't have a plank long enough to make them walk. So we're going to punish the Mutineers. And track down that bitch Sybil
column2: 叛变的惩罚叫做“走跳板“。这次我没有够长的跳板让他们走。所以我们要惩罚这些叛变者。并追查出那个贱人西比尔

column1: The remaining Volkovites have holed up in a sanctuary you'll find in this valley. Destroy it, and eliminate whatever resistance they can bring to bear. The eyes of the Chancellor are on you, Commander. Don't disappoint him.
column2: 残余的沃尔科维特成员已据守在这处山谷中的避难所. 摧毁它，并消灭他们能组织起的任何抵抗. 总理正注视着你，指挥官. 不要让他失望.

column1: The scion of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mercantile concern has been missing for months. We suspect a kidnapping by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, but there's been no ransom demand. A local group of sympathizers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} recently picked up a garbled message from the scion indicating that she's being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility there. Our intel failed to trace her to {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, so any loyal mechs are several jumps away. We need your help to extract her.
column2: 一名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商业家族的继承人已经失踪数月. 我们怀疑是被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}绑架了，但迄今没有收到任何赎金要求. 最近，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一组当地支持者收到了一条来自继承人含糊不清的消息，上面说她被关在当地的一个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施中. 我们的情报未能追踪到她在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的具体位置，并且所有忠心的机甲都在几个跃迁距离之外. 我们需要你帮忙救出她.

column1: The sensor array that you'll need to capture to escape this system is further ahead, but there are Davion 'Mechs between you and the facility. Kill them before they kill you.
column2: 你要想逃离这个星系，就得夺取前方那套传感器阵列，但在你和设施之间还挡着戴维恩的机甲. 趁他们干掉你之前，先把他们干掉.

column1: The situation planetside is deteriorating rapidly. Two Federated Suns lances are closing rapidly on our team's location, and without immediate intervention the operation will fail. I need you to intercept those 'Mechs and disable them before moving on to the facility where our covert team is hiding. You may handle this situation as you see fit; I have every confidence in you and your people, Commander.
column2: 行星表面的局势正在急剧恶化. 恒星联邦的两支小队正迅速逼近我们队员的位置，若不立即干预，行动将宣告失败. 我需要你去拦截并瘫痪那些机甲，然后再前往我方秘密小队藏身的设施. 你可以自行判断处理此局面，我对你和你的部下充满信心，指挥官.

column1: The sooner we can finish this, the better. Let's just… get it done.
column2: 我们越早办完这事越好。我们就……把它办了吧。

column1: The sooner we get these people to the rendezvous point, the sooner we can go home. Let's get a move on, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 越早将这些人送到接应点，我们就能越早返航. 出发吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}.

column1: The target seems to be just a low-level officer in the overall {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} scheme of things - just a link in the chain. We just need to dive in, take out the target and get out.
column2: 目标似乎只是整个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}体系中的一名低级官员——只是链条上的一环. 我们只需要潜入进去，消灭目标，然后撤离.

column1: The target we'd like your people to eliminate is a notorious killer-for-hire who goes by the name 'The Professional'. They're currently under contract with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, and they've been spotted here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, which is extremely concerning for our interests. This mercenary is cagey and cautious and will attempt escape at any indication that they're overmatched. We'd like you to land a low-tonnage lance to engage them, to give them a false sense of security, and then eliminate them before they can escape. We're prepared to offer very generous salvage terms.
column2: 我们要你的人去消灭的目标是个臭名昭著的雇佣杀手，人称“专家”. 他目前与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}签有合约，并且有人在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}看到了他们，这对我们的利益构成严重威胁. 这个佣兵谨小慎微，一旦察觉战力悬殊便会试图逃脱. 我们希望你投放一支轻型吨位的小队与其交战，让他们产生错误的安全感，然后在他们逃跑前消灭他们. 我们愿意提供极其 优厚的战利品条款.

column1: The time-frame on this is tight, since we need the artillery strike to hit while the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} representative has everyone looking in the right direction. And Commander, I wouldn't take any bets on that military base actually being abandoned.
column2: 时间非常紧迫，因为炮击必须在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的代表让所有人注意力都集中在正确方向的时候命中. 指挥官，我才不会打赌那个军事基地真的是废弃的.

column1: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Capellan command is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
column2: 传输数据已足够让我们定位到卡佩拉地区指挥部藏身的那座加固地堡. 他们自以为待在里面很安全，但我们已经在轨道上部署了一门海军用粒子加农炮，随时准备在他们建起的任何工事上轰开一个洞. 你需要将机甲部署到位，以便我们实施精确打击. 一旦我们开了这一炮，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道逃离，所以机会只有一次. 我们对你完全有信心，指挥官. 到目前为止，你的判断一直准确无误. 祝好运.

column1: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Maximum Distric Leadership is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
column2: 传输过来的数据足以让我们定位到Maximum地区领导层藏身的加固掩体. 他们以为躲在那里就安全了，但我们有一门舰载PPC就位，随时准备在他们建造的任何东西上轰开一个洞. 你需要将你的机甲移动到指定位置，以便我们进行精确打击; 一旦我们开火，我们的空投艇就必须脱离轨道并撤离，所以只有一次机会把事情做对. 我们对你充满信心，指挥官; 到目前为止你的判断一直很准确. 祝你好运.

column1: The truth is, I hate fighting other mercenaries. It seems like such a waste of perfectly good armor and myomer.
column2: 真相是，我讨厌和其他佣兵战斗. 这似乎是对优质装甲和麦约摩尔的一种浪费.

column1: The vehicles seem to be a standard supply convoy, with an escorting lance. It was simple bad luck that they happened to be scheduled to arrive just after we neutralized the base. We need to eliminate them before they arrive here and see League salvage and intel teams all over their facility. I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort, but it's possible the vehicles themselves may pose a significant threat, given the restrictions a covert operation places on your drop tonnage.
column2: 这些车辆似乎是标准的补给车队，配有护卫机甲小队. 他们恰好在基地被我们瘫痪后按计划抵达，纯属运气不佳. 必须在他们抵达并发现设施内遍布联盟打捞与情报小组前将其消灭. 我估计最多只有一支机甲小队作为护卫，但考虑到隐秘行动对投放吨位的限制，这些车辆本身也可能构成重大威胁.

column1: The vile mercenary Yuetu is on her last legs. Cut them out from under her! Safeguard my beloved son, and prevent our enemies from destroying House Khulan. If you do, I will see to Reynauld's needs, and he in turn will see to yours.
column2: 卑鄙的雇佣兵“月兔”已穷途末路——将他们彻底清除！保护我心爱的儿子，阻止我们的敌人摧毁呼兰家族. 如果你们做到，我会满足雷纳德的需求，作为回报他也会帮助你们的.

column1: The wear on the equipment and Pilots are mounting Commander.
column2: 装备与机师的损耗正在加剧，指挥官。

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} citizens here have been suffering at the hands of a local band of brigands - remnants from a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} battalion that saw action in the Third Succession War. With no prospects or funds, they've become common criminals. You are to eliminate them, down to the last 'Mech and vehicle.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的平民正受到当地一群强盗的折磨——这是一个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}营残部，这个营参加过第三次继承战争. 由于既没有前途也没有资金，他们堕落成了普通的罪犯. 你的任务是将他们全部消灭，包括最后一部机甲，最后一辆车.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves.  Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的设施如果无力自保，那就得龟缩一隅了. 总之，指挥官，这应该是个非常简单明了的任务.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves. Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的设施如果无力自保，那就得龟缩一隅了. 总之，指挥官，这应该是个非常简单明了的任务.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s agents are using this installation as their forward base.  They were discovered by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence and has deployed a substantial force to eliminate them. Lacking military power to mount a defense, the agents are falling back. Assist them in conducting a safe evacuation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的特工正利用此设施作为前沿基地. 他们已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报部门发现，且敌方已部署一支庞大的部队来消灭他们. 由于缺乏军事力量进行防御，这些特工正在撤退. 请协助他们安全撤离.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s intelligence-gathering facility has been compromised. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units are mobilizing a significant strike element to neutralize the site and its occupants. Our employer is initiating a full data purge to mitigate liability and prevent sensitive material from being captured. Our mission is to delay the enemy advance long enough to ensure the purge is completed, then guard the withdrawal of personnel from the installation.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的情报搜集设施已被泄露. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在动员一支重要的打击力量，以摧毁该设施及其人员. 我方雇主正在启动全面数据清除，以减轻责任并防止敏感材料被俘获. 我们的任务是延缓敌军的推进，确保数据清除完成，然后护卫人员从设施中撤离.

column1: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is being challenged by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forces as they alledge it is a cover for military personnel and units. Diplomatic efforts have failed and a military strike is on their way as we speak. The site will be abandoned but all personnel must evacuate safely. Your mission is to ensure their secure extraction.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的制造设施正遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的质疑，他们声称该设施是掩护军事人员和作战单位的幌子. 外交握旋已经失败，一场军事打击正在向这里袭来. 设施将被遗弃，但所有人员都必须安全撤离. 你的任务是确保他们安全撤离.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior is headed to a major military compound on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, where they'll take command of a company-sized 'Mech force, and become untouchable. They're en route to the encampment, but until they arrive, they're vulnerable.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的机甲战士正前往{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的一处大型军事基地，他们会在那儿接管一支连级机甲部队——届时将再难触及. 现在他们正赶往营地，但在抵达之前，他们仍然处于脆弱状态.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have just finished a very ambitious operation. They rounded up two dozen members of a rival criminal organization and they're holding them in a secure detention facility. We're not happy with the idea that those scumbags get to live out their lives in comfort and safety behind bars. We want you to give them a bit more severe sentencing.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}这儿的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局刚刚完成了一个极富野心的行动. 他们凑了两大敌对犯罪组织的人，关押在一处安全拘禁设施里. 我们对这个主意并不高兴，那些人渣会在铁窗后舒适安全地度过一生. 我们要你给他们来点更加严厉一点的判决.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have recently taken a shipment of military vehicles, including an operational Demolisher. This represents an unacceptable buildup of force on this world, but also presents us with an opportunity. We have people in place prepared to steal those vehicles, but without 'Mechs providing an escort, they'll be attacked as soon as {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command notices they're leaving without orders. Get the vehicles to an extraction point, and keep them intact.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局近日接收了一批军用车辆，包括一辆可操作的“破坏者”. 这不仅意味着该星球军事力量的危险增长，也为我们创造了机会. 我们已安排人员窃取这些车辆，但没有机甲护卫的话，一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部注意到它们没有命令就离开，那它们就会遭到攻击. 将车辆护送至撤离点，并确保其完好无损.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} control of this world is nearly absolute. We've identified a point of vulnerability, however: they move supplies and weapons by convoy, and those convoys are lightly defended by a single lance of 'Mechs. If we destroy enough of their supply convoys, their other operations will be weakened enough for our forces to move in and take advantage of their fragility. We don't want to tip our hand, however, so we'd like you to engage in a little guerilla warfare on our behalf.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}对这颗星球的控制几乎是绝对的. 不过，我们发现了一个薄弱点: 他们通过车队运送补给和武器，而这些车队只由一支机甲小队轻度护卫. 如果我们摧毁足够多的补给车队，他们的其他行动就会被削弱，从而足以让我方部队趁虚而入，利用他们的脆弱性. 不过，我们不想过早暴露意图，所以希望你能代表我们进行一些小规模的游击战.

column1: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is an illegal intrusion into our territory, and a cover for military personnel and units. Our efforts to resolve this through diplomatic channels have been rebuffed, so we are now turning to a military solution. The facility must be destroyed.
column2: 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施是对我方领土的非法入侵，并且还是军事人员和部队的掩护点. 我们试图通过外交途径解决此事，但遭到了拒绝，因此现在只能诉诸军事手段. 这处设施必须被摧毁.

column1: Theft and banditry on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have become a tremendous problem of late, to the point that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} corporate interests can't safely move goods overland. We need a mercenary company capable of defending our convoy and deterring any hostile force that may want what it's carrying. Payment will be remitted upon our receipt of the convoy and the successful evac of your lance.
column2: 最近，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的匪患和盗窃已经成为了一个大问题，以至于{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的企业无法安全地在陆地上运输货物. 我们需要一家佣兵公司来保卫我们的车队，并威慑任何企图抢夺货物的敌对势力. 等我们接到车队并且你的小队成功撤离后，我们就会把报酬支付给你.

column1: Their command structure is fleeing, with an escorting lance... I wouldn't expect more than a single lance as an escort.
column2: 他们的指挥体系正在逃跑，带一支护航小队……我不指望护航超过一支小队。

column1: There are no static weapon emplacements on this facility and I couldn't pin their negotiator down on whether any of the VTOL assets on site are going to be of any use.
column2: 这个设施没有任何固定防御工事，而且我也没能从他们的谈判代表那里套出话，搞不清现场的那些垂直起降飞行器资产到底能不能派上用场.

column1: There aren't many solo operators in this region who I'd describe as 'highly skilled'. I wonder if it's anyone we know?
column2: 在这一地区，能被我称为“技术高超”的单干户可不多. 我很好奇是不是我们认识的人?

column1: There is a Warrior in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a Circle of Equals. As they are Bloodnamed, we feel that you cannot brush them off as easily as some drunk in a bar. It would bring great honor to our Clan if you would arrive and show them your might.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一位战士，除非你，指挥官，亲自到场在平等者之环中与之战斗，否则绝不退让. 由于他们拥有血脉名号，我们认为你无法像打发酒吧里的醉汉那样轻易敷衍过去. 如果你能到场并向他们展示你的实力，将为我们氏族带来巨大的荣誉.

column1: There is a small {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that has been attacked by raiders. Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power. We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale. We'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
column2: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}有座小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地遭到了盗匪的袭击. 他们最近的攻击比之前那次更有组织性，装备也更好，这表明盗匪在接受敌对势力的后勤和战术支持. 这种规模的袭击我们可能无法承受第二次了. 我们想雇佣你来提供额外的防御性支援.

column1: There is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region. We have the equipment to level it, however our recon capability has been diminished. We would like you to take a team and attack the installation. Place beacons for our artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
column2: 该区域有一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地. 我们有夷平它的装备，但侦察能力已受损. 我们希望你们派一支小队攻击该设施，为我们的火炮放置目标指示信标，然后在我方炮火摧毁基地时撤离.

column1: There is probably more to this than {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} are saying, but our role would be limited to escorting a convoy of personnel carriers to an evac point. The remainder of this situation is someone else's problem.
column2: 这可能比{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}说的还要复杂，但我们的角色仅限于护送一队运兵车到撤离点. 其他的局面就是别人的问题了.

column1: There she is - up in that base. I want my 'Mech back. Bring it in, and we'll clear the area of these traitors. I'm sure you understand the need for vengeance when your name is on the line and they've stolen your fighting machines.
column2: 她就在那儿——在那座基地里。我要拿回我的机甲。把它带出来，我们就替这片区域清掉这些叛徒。我相信你能理解，当你的名字被挂在上面、而他们偷走了你的战斗机甲时，复仇是多么必要。

column1: There shouldn't be any surprises here, Commander. The target is expecting a pickup so she'll be aboard in a matter of moments. The data might be tougher but it's your call if you want to go after it.
column2: 这里不应该有任何意外，指挥官. 目标预估到要被接走，所以很快就会上船. 数据可能会更难获取，但是否去找它由你决定.

column1: There were far more prisoners than originally anticipated, but thankfully due to your company's bravery and my quick thinking we were able to rescue them all. However, in the kerfuffle, one of the weeb leaders responsible for this outrage has blockaded our escape route. We’ll have to teleport behind them and take their forces down before we can escape. Don't let these fools stand in our way for a moment longer, let's show them the fury of a Canopian scorned.
column2: 俘虏比最初预估的多得多，但幸亏有你们连队的勇敢和我的机敏，我们得以把他们全部救出。不过在一阵混乱中，一个应对这场暴行负责的二次元头目封锁了我们的逃生路线。我们得瞬移到他们背后，在逃离之前先解决他们的部队。别让这些蠢货再多挡我们一刻，让他们见识被激怒的卡诺帕人的怒火。

column1: There's a convoy of military weaponry being transported in the open on the planet's surface. Normally we'd simply handle it ourselves, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has caught wind of our presence and hired a highly-skilled professional mercenary to cover the convoy's route and intercept any attackers. Being highly-skilled professionals yourselves, we thought perhaps you could pay a visit to this hired gun -- and destroy the convoy while you're at it.
column2: 行星地表有一支军用武器车队正在公开运输. 通常情况下，我们会自己处理此事，但{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层察觉到了我们的存在，并雇了一支技术高超的职业佣兵来掩护车队的路线，拦截攻击者. 鉴于你们自己也是技术高超的职业人士，我们认为也许你们能够去会一会这群雇来的人——并顺便摧毁车队.

column1: There's a minor {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base in this region, and we'd like to remind them that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is aware of their base and they should not become complacent. Destroying a handful of the facility's structures should send the proper message. The base is likely to be guarded; destroy the units guarding it and there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 这一地区有一座小型{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们想提醒他们{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}知道他们的基地，他们不应该洋洋自得. 破坏设施的一些建筑物应该可以传达正确的信息. 这座基地可能受到保护; 消灭保卫部队，你就会得到奖金.

column1: There's a very interesting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy scheduled to cross through a relatively uninhabited area of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We believe the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That could be an enormous payday for us. We want you to blow that convoy apart, and we'll pick through the remains.
column2: 有一支非常有趣的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队计划穿越{TGT_SYSTEM.name}一片相对无人居住的地区. 我们相信这支车队运载着武器，其中至少包括一套完好的星际联盟时期的武器系统. 对我们来说，这可以大捞一笔. 我们想让你击溃那支车队，然后我们会仔细回收残骸.

column1: There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, involved in keeping the peace. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's started talking to the authorities, and making threats about exposing our business. We want you to put a stop to that. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}上有一个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士，参与维系和平. 他帮我们解决一些行动，反过来，我们也为他提供了在公开市场上买不到的东西，如果你懂我意思的话. 但他已经开始和当局对话，并威胁要曝光我们的交易. 我们要你叫停此事. 他可能会试图脱身. 别让他逃跑了.

column1: There's got to be more to this story than just a simple kidnapping, Commander.
column2: 看来这里面并不单单只是一宗绑架那么简单，指挥官.

column1: There's not a lot of detail here, Commander.
column2: 这里细节不多，指挥官。

column1: There's worse ways to make money than influencing a whole new generation of pilot's fighting styles. Sounds fun!
column2: 影响整整新一代机师的战斗风格，这赚钱方式也不算差. 听起来很有趣!

column1: These 'Militia' as they call themselves are freeborn Clan Wolf warriors. They don't belong in the inner sphere, and I am trying to drive them out. Break through their front lines then we will take down their base.
column2: 这些自称“民兵“的人是狼族氏族的自由出生者战士。他们不属于内天体，而我在试图把他们赶出去。突破他们的前线，然后我们就拿下他们的基地。

column1: These 'debt collectors' have BattleMechs. Cheating only pays the enforcers, it looks like.
column2: 这些“讨债人“有战斗机甲。看来作弊只养肥了执法者。

column1: These are going to be lightly armored targets, Commander. The real challenge will be keeping them from making a run for it.
column2: 这些都是轻装甲目标，指挥官. 真正的挑战是阻止他们逃跑.

column1: These days 'war criminal' basically means anyone on the other side of the battlefield. I wouldn't worry about that 'trial' comment. There won't be one.
column2: 如今的“战争罪犯”基本上就是指战场另一边的任何人. 我可不会在意那句“审判”的话——根本不会有审判的.

column1: These missions never go smoothly.
column2: 这些任务从来不会顺利。

column1: These pirates loot and pillage. No need to feel sorry for them, Commander.
column2: 这些海盗抢劫掠夺。无需为他们难过，指挥官。

column1: They haven't told us what, precisely, the facility is producing, but given the strength of enemy forces on the ground, it's something worth protecting.
column2: 他们没有明确告诉我们这个设施在生产什么，但根据地面敌军的防御强度判断，显然是一些非常有价值的东西.

column1: They just happened to be transporting valuable cargo through a rival's territory, and their DropShip just happened to go down? Sure.
column2: 他们只是碰巧在敌对势力的地盘上运输重要货物，而他们的空投艇也恰好出事了? 真是巧合.

column1: They may be incidental but they're going to be shooting our 'Mechs in the ass, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
column2: 他们或许无关紧要，但他们可会朝着我们的 机甲屁股开火，指挥官. 我们得保持机动才行.

column1: They pick these empty worlds for conducting exercises in hopes of keeping it a secret. Too bad for them, I suppose.
column2: 他们挑选这些空旷星球进行演习本想保密. 可惜运气不好.

column1: They seem confident, but the opposition is firing on our 'Mechs, Commander. We're going to need to stay on the move.
column2: 他们看起来很自信，但对手正在向我们的机甲开火，指挥官。我们需要保持移动。

column1: They want us to take on a 20-year veteran of the Succession Wars with an underweight lance. This is going to hurt, Commander.
column2: 他们想让我们用一个缺编的小队去对抗一位在继承战争中服役了20年的老兵. 这仗会打得很疼，指挥官.

column1: They're putting us between the hammer and the anvil, Commander. A 'Mech repair facility is a juicy target.
column2: 他们让我们腹背受敌，指挥官. 机甲修理厂可是个诱人的目标.

column1: They're using us so the raid can't be traced to them. Shooting your own people... This is an ugly situation for them to be in, but nobody said the Periphery was a safe place to work.
column2: 他们在利用我们，这样袭击就无法追究到他们身上. 向自己人开枪......对他们来说是个很糟糕的局面，但没人说过外围是个安全的地方.

column1: They've got to be kicking themselves for letting their VIP go out without more security. Their screw-up is our payday, though.
column2: 他们一定很后悔让他们的VIP在没有加强安保的情况下就出去. 不过，他们搞砸了就是我们发财的时候.

column1: Things are going well. It seems Kell has lured the Corsair out for single battle. However, I have come upon information this was not her real goal. We discovered there is a nuclear warhead device being set up in the potential area of the duel. We will need you to deploy to draw off any defenders while we attempt to gain access and disarm the device. Expect heavy resistance.
column2: 事情进展顺利。看来凯尔已经把海盗引出来进行单挑了。不过我查到情报，说这并不是她真正的目的。我们发现决斗可能发生的区域里正被安放一件核弹头装置。我们需要你部署出去引开任何守军，而我们尝试接近并拆除该装置。预期会遇到强烈抵抗。

column1: Things are never simple are they. Let's get it done.
column2: 事情从来都不简单，对吧. 我们把它搞定吧.

column1: This actually sounds like fun! I'll have you both on coms the entire time but the rest of the crew will be cheering you on from the crowd. Let's do this, Commander.
column2: 这听起来可真有趣! 我会全程保持你们俩的通讯畅通，其他船员则会在人群中为你们加油助威. 咱们上吧，指挥官.
