column1: This all seems extremely straightforward, Commander. There will likely be significant opposition, but nothing we haven't handled in the past.
column2: 这一切似乎非常简单明了，指挥官. 可能会有较多的对手，但没什么我们以前没应付过的东西.

column1: This all seems straightforward enough, Commander. There will likely be significant opposition, but nothing we haven't handled in the past.
column2: 这一切似乎够简单明了的了，指挥官. 可能会有较多的对手，但没什么我们以前没应付过的东西.

column1: This all sounds pretty straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Keep your eyes open, all the same.
column2: 听起来相当明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 但务必保持警惕.

column1: This assignment is clearly important to Force Commander Singh. Let's do this job right, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 显然，这项任务对辛格指挥官至关重要. 让我们好好完成它吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}.

column1: This base sounds like a tough nut to crack, Commander. Expect two full lances on the field, plus the turrets. We'd better bring our heaviest 'Mechs.
column2: 这个基地听起来可是块难啃的骨头，指挥官. 预计战场上会有整整两支满编小队，外加炮台. 我们最好把最重型的机甲都带上.

column1: This could be {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} using the supplies as cover, but it could also be {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} looking for plausible deniability. We'll probably never learn which.
column2: 这可能是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}利用物资作掩护，也可能是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}想撇清关系而找的托词. 我们可能永远都不会知道真相.

column1: This facility is close to where the rumors of massive tanks seem to originate. It's probably the best place to start your search.
column2: 这处设施离那些关于巨型坦克的传言似乎发源的地方很近。那里大概是你开始搜寻的最佳地点。

column1: This fight is going to be a mess and we're stepping right into it. Be on the lookout here.
column2: 这场战斗会一团糟，而我们正踏进这个泥潭. 在这里保持警惕.

column1: This fight looks like it's gonna be a cluster, be careful of betrayal Commander.
column2: 这场战斗看起来会非常混乱，小心背叛，指挥官.

column1: This has been a hell of a slog, but we're almost through it. Keep moving, Commander. Get our people home.
column2: 这一路走来真是够艰难的，指挥官，但我们快熬出头了. 继续前进. 带我们的人回家.

column1: This has been an interesting ride Commander. I wonder how this duel will play out?
column2: 这一路可真够精彩的，指挥官。我很好奇这场决斗会怎么打？

column1: This is a Solaris Assault Mech match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯突击机甲比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Assault Tank match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯突击坦克比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Heavy Mech match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯重型机甲比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Heavy Tank match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯重型坦克比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Light Mech match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯轻型机甲比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Light Tank match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯轻型坦克比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Medium Mech match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯中型机甲比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a Solaris Medium Tank match. You fight to win prize money and gain notoriety.
column2: 这是一场索拉里斯中型坦克比赛。你为赢得奖金和名声而战。

column1: This is a bit of a Catch-22 situation, Commander… we can't afford to leave these jokers standing, but I'll bet you anything that Lees sent them here to soften us up before our attack on the base.
column2: 这有点进退两难，指挥官……我们承受不起让这些活宝活着，但我敢跟你打赌，利斯派他们来这里是为了在我们攻打基地之前削弱我们。

column1: This is a hot one, Commander. It's going to be a crap shoot which one {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will decide to make their main assault. You need to prepare as if it's going to be this one.
column2: 这是个热闹的任务，指挥官. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}决定向哪支车队发起主攻就像投骰子一样. 你需要做好万一被选中的准备.

column1: This is a play-off tournament, if you lose this battle, you are out.
column2: 这是淘汰赛，输掉这场你就出局了。

column1: This is a straight-up brawl and we're on our own for this one. Stay frosty, Commander.
column2: 这是一场正面近战，这次我们只能靠自己了. 保持冷静，指挥官.

column1: This is a straightforward battle, Commander, and nothing we haven't handled before. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
column2: 这是一次简单明了的战斗，指挥官，没什么我们以前掌控不了的东西. 在这样闭塞的地方找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

column1: This is a straightforward battle, Commander. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
column2: 这是场简单明了的战斗，指挥官. 在这样闭塞的地方要找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

column1: This is a test of unused chunks in the firemission contract type.
column2: 这是火力任务合约类型中未使用块的测试。

column1: This is an invitation to the Gladiatory Divisionals. You and another fighter in steel-crunching, skull-cracking live broadcast action. Are you in or are you in?
column2: 这是角斗分区赛的邀请。你与另一名战士在碾碎钢铁、击碎颅骨的实况直播中对抗。你来不来，还是来不来？

column1: This is bizarre, Commander. We just finished a covert drop to avoid drawing attention, and now we're going to blow up a military base?
column2: 这可真够诡异的，指挥官. 我们刚完成了一次隐蔽空降以避免打草惊蛇，现在却要去炸掉一座军事基地?

column1: This is dragging out. I hope we can keep up the supply lines
column2: 这拖得太久了。希望我们能维持住补给线

column1: This is exactly the kind of morally ambiguous job that makes me uncomfortable working with pirates, Commander.
column2: 这正是那种道德上模棱两可的任务，我对与海盗合作感到不安，指挥官.

column1: This is going to be risky, but it seems like the only way to be certain that Kell's people make it home safe.
column2: 这很冒险，但它看起来是确保凯尔的人安全回家的唯一方法.

column1: This is going to get messy.
column2: 这会变得很乱。

column1: This is it, Commander. The Clan Commander has issued a batchall and you have accepted. One on one, honourable combat with the freedom of this world at stake. We'll be recording it for posterity.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。氏族指挥官发出了批战挑战，而你接受了。一对一，荣誉之战，赌注是这颗行星的自由。我们会把它录下来留给后人。

column1: This is it, Commander. We may have a rare opportunity to bring this pursuit to a close. I have negotiated a duel with the leader of the opposing force versus a combined unit from us both.
column2: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我们可能有一个难得的机会把这场追击画上句号。我已谈妥一场决斗：对方部队的领袖对上我们从双方各出一支组成的联合单位。

column1: This is it, Commander. Your lance versus the Steel Beast, and whatever reinforcements he dares to call. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
column2: 就是现在，指挥官. 你的机甲小队对上“钢铁野兽”，以及他敢叫来的任何增援. 给予他罪有应得的正义！

column1: This is it, Commander. Your one-on-one contest with the Steel Beast. Give him the justice he so richly deserves!
column2: 就是这一刻了，指挥官. 你和那头“钢铁野兽”的一对一对决. 让他尝尝他应得的正义制裁吧！

column1: This is it—the final confrontation between ourselves, the Black Widow, and the Bounty Hunter. Succeed in this, and the Moderbjörn will have all the time it needs to harvest the Dobrev's navigation logs. The secrets of the Star League lie within our grasp, Commander. I know we can do this, so let's get to it.
column2: 就是这一下了——我们、黑寡妇与赏金猎人之间的最后对决。成功之后，莫德比约恩就会有充足的时间来提取多布雷夫的导航日志。星盟的秘密就在我们掌握之中，指挥官。我知道我们能做到，那就动手吧。

column1: This is just a normal day of political and military maneuvering in the Inner Sphere, meaning it's a good payday for us.
column2: 这只是内天体政治与军事博弈中的普通一天，也意味着我们能赚上一大笔.

column1: This is odd. Pirates fighting pirates. Wait, now that I think about it... it makes perfect sense.
column2: 这真奇怪。海盗打海盗。等等，仔细一想……这完全说得通。

column1: This is our best shot at finding a way out of here, Commander. Let's get it done.
column2: 这是我们找到出路的最佳机会了，指挥官. 动手把它搞定吧.

column1: This is the contract that Lady Marina wanted us to take, Commander. It seems fairly straightforward.
column2: 这是玛丽娜女士希望我们接下的合约，指挥官. 看起来相当直接.

column1: This is the fabled 'bug swarm', Commander, come prepared for an endurance battle.
column2: 这就是传说中的“虫群”，指挥官，请做好持久战的准备.

column1: This is turning into one hell of a long haul, but the sooner we get these people out of Capellan space, the sooner we can collect our pay.
column2: 这将变成一段艰难的长途旅程，但我们越早将这些民众带离卡佩拉联邦，就能越早拿到酬劳.

column1: This isn't a normal convoy hit, Commander. The targets will be very fast, we'll need highly mobile units to spot and destroy them.
column2: 这不是一次普通的车队袭击，指挥官. 目标速度会非常快，我们需要高机动性单位来发现并摧毁它们.

column1: This job doesn't seem all that difficult, but... Turrets? Please. Never send a machine to do a MechWarrior's job.
column2: 这活似乎一点都不难，可...炮台? 得了吧. 永远别派机器去做机甲战士的活.

column1: This job seems sketchy, Commander. I suppose that's not a surprise, given the employer, but we should still be cautious.
column2: 这个活看起来很粗略，指挥官. 考虑到雇主是谁，这倒也不奇怪，但我们还是得小心行事.

column1: This logistical base is a key component of the Capellans' hold on this area of Kern. Any significant force in the region needs this base to remain operational and supplied in the field. The main facility is located in deep woods, well concealed and well defended. Expect heavy resistance before reaching it, and expect turret defenses at the base itself. A secondary base nearby houses technicians and staff; destroying it is not required, but if you manage to, it will ensure the main facility remains permanently closed and unrepairable.
column2: 这座后勤基地是卡佩拉掌控克恩这一地区的关键支撑点. 任何在该地区活动的成规模部队，都需要依靠这座基地维持运作和战场补给. 主设施坐落于密林深处，隐蔽且防守严密. 预计途中会有强大的阻力，不要忘记基地旁边的炮台. 附近还有一个驻扎着技术人员和工作人员的次要基地. 摧毁它并非必要，但如果你们能够做到，就能确保主设施永久关闭且无法修复.

column1: This might get weird, Commander.
column2: 这可能会变得很怪，指挥官。

column1: This neko holding facility was specifically designed to keep us locked up with minimal risk of escape. Unfortunately we cannot commit to fully destroying it at this time for fear of damaging any of our equipment or any information pertaining to the location of Nyanderthal era artifacts. I’ve marked key structures to eliminate so we can recover the vital objectives later. This will be tricky, as while we were evacuating the prisoners additional forces have moved in to hold this position. That, and the heavy turrets...
column2: 这处猫娘关押设施专门设计为以最小逃脱风险把我们关住。不幸的是，由于担心损坏我们的任何装备或任何与尼安德特时代遗物位置有关的信息，我们目前无法承诺把它彻底摧毁。我已标出需要清除的关键建筑，以便我们稍后能回收重要目标。这会有难度，因为在我们撤离囚犯时，又有额外部队进驻守住这个位置。再加上那些重型炮塔……

column1: This new Steiner-Davion BattleMech looks pretty damned impressive for its class. Let's hope it's enough to get us through this.
column2: 这款新的 Steiner-Davion战斗机甲看起来非常令人印象深刻. 希望它足以带我们顺利度过这一关.

column1: This ought to be a straightforward battle, Commander. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
column2: 这应该是场简单明了的战斗，指挥官. 在这样闭塞的地方要找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

column1: This planet has been under siege for a while. They are looking for some Mercs to protect the people from the aggressors.
column2: 这颗星球已被围困一段时间了。他们正在找雇佣兵来保护民众免受侵略者侵害。

column1: This seems like a mission where afterwards we'll say 'It was supposed to be undefended!', Commander. Be prepared.
column2: 这似乎就是事后我们会说，“这就是所谓的 不设防!”的那种任务，指挥官. 做好准备.

column1: This seems like the kind of setup where afterwards we'll say 'It was supposed to be undefended!', Commander. Be prepared.
column2: 这似乎就是事后我们会说，“这就是所谓的 不设防!”的那种局，指挥官. 做好准备.

column1: This seems really straightforward, Commander. I'm not too worried about 'extremely heavily armed'; I'm sure it's nothing we haven't dealt with before.
column2: 看起来非常简单明了，指挥官. 我不太担心“武装到了牙齿”; 我确信没什么我们以前没应付过的东西.

column1: This seems relatively straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's get in there and get it done.
column2: 看起来相对简单，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 进去完成任务吧！

column1: This seems simple enough, which makes me nervous. I don't like when we're asked to defend \"research\" without knowing what the research is.
column2: 这看似简单，反而令我不安. 我不喜欢在不知道研究内容的情况下执行防卫任务.

column1: This seems straightforward, Commander, though getting into a shooting fight with the FedSuns doesn't sound like my idea of a good time.
column2: 这一切看起来很直接，指挥官. 虽然我觉得与恒星联邦的枪战不是很吸引人.

column1: This seems straightforward, Commander. If things get out of hand, remember you can just blow up the buildings and make a run for it.
column2: 看起来很简单明了，指挥官. 如果局势失控，记住你可以直接炸掉建筑物然后撤离.

column1: This should be a milk run, {COMMANDER.FirstName}… Graf Stieglitz-Bradford doesn't actually care about taking down this facility; he just wants us out of the way while his strike team takes down Gwydion Company.
column2: 这应该是一趟轻松差事，{COMMANDER.FirstName}……施蒂格利茨-布拉德福德伯爵其实并不在乎拿下这处设施；他只是想把我们支开，好让他的打击队干掉格威迪恩连。

column1: This should be extremely painful.
column2: 这应该会非常痛苦.

column1: This should be straightforward. Move up, recon the depot, and then occupy it. Once we secure the area, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will send in their people to loot the place.
column2: 这应该很简单明了. 前进，侦察仓库，然后占领它. 一旦我们拿下了这块地方，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}就会派他们的人洗劫这里.

column1: This shouldn't be all that difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
column2: 这应该没那么难，但需要穆拉德博士到现场进行实际的数据侵入工作. 她已经同意和你的队伍一起去了.

column1: This shouldn't be anything out of the ordinary, Commander. Let's get it done.
column2: 这应该没什么特别的，指挥官. 让我们按计划执行吧.

column1: This shouldn't be too difficult, but we'll need Dr. Murad on the ground to do the actual data hacking. She's already agreed to go in with your team.
column2: 这应该不太难，但需要穆拉德博士到现场进行实际的数据侵入工作. 她已经同意和你的队伍一起去了.

column1: This sort of tit-for-tat never works out well, but it means steady work for us.
column2: 这种针锋相对的做法从来不能有效地解决问题，但对我们来说意味着稳定的工作.

column1: This sounds like a messy scenario, Commander. That satellite is only going to be overhead for a short time, and this place is going to be very heavily guarded.
column2: 这听起来像是个棘手的情况，指挥官. 卫星在设施上方停留的时间会很短，且该地点守备极其森严.

column1: This sounds like a messy scenario, Commander. That satellite is only going to be overhead for a short time.
column2: 这听起来像是个棘手的情况，指挥官. 卫星在设施上方停留的时间会很短.

column1: This sounds like a terrible idea, but this is why they pay us the big bucks.
column2: 这听起来是个糟糕透顶的主意，但正因如此他们才付我们大钱。

column1: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.
column2: 这个星系已被设为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划中的一个目标. 不幸的是，这项殖民计划落空了，而现在我们不得不在我们的人被敌军拦截之前从该行星的地面撤出来. 由于这次殖民是个秘密，因此多亏了对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的那些自相矛盾又靠不住的主张，我们不能让人看到我们开展大规模营救. 我们需要一个可以撇清关系的中间人.

column1: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。[警告：丧尸]

column1: This trafficking ring has to be put to a stop immediately Commander. We can't allow any more Nekos or Magistracy citizens to be captured
column2: 这条贩运链必须立即制止，指挥官。我们不能再容许任何猫娘或治安官辖区公民被掳走

column1: This whole mission makes my skin crawl, Commander. We're attacking a civilian facility on the say-so of the Kurita spy network. Just… just keep your eyes open, okay?
column2: 这整个任务都让我浑身发毛，指挥官。我们在凭栗田间谍网络的一面之词去攻击一处民用设施。就……就睁大眼睛，好吗？

column1: This will be a difficult fight, Commander. The Beasts of Balawat are former Kell Hounds; they've received some of the best training and equipment you'll find anywhere. But more than that, they've got something to prove.
column2: 这将是一场硬仗，指挥官.“巴拉瓦特野兽”由前凯尔猎犬成员组成. 他们接受过顶尖训练并配备精良装备. 但更重要的，他们需要向自己证明一些事情.

column1: This {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientist is a top weapons researcher, and extremely valuable to any faction that employs her.
column2: 这名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家是顶级武器研发人员，对任何雇佣她的派系来说都是极有价值的.

column1: Those are specialized ComStar reinforcements, Commander. Expect nothing but the best this time around.
column2: 那些是康星的特种增援，指挥官。这次除了最强的对手什么都别指望。

column1: Those aren't just reinforcements, Commander. That's our target: the CCAF commander, Lieutenant Colonel Song. As a reminder, they're a deadly MechWarrior as well as a skilled strategist. Their arrival on the field presents an opportunity—if we act swiftly, we can achieve our goals here on Kern in a single strike, making this world an easy pickup when we mount the full-scale attack. This is it, Commander. Don't screw this up.
column2: 那些不只是增援，指挥官。那正是我们的目标：CCAF指挥官，宋中校。提醒一下，他们既是致命的机师，也是娴熟的战略家。他们出现在战场上是个机会——如果我们行动迅速，就能在克恩一举达成我们的目标，让这颗行星在我们发动全面进攻时唾手可得。就是这一下了，指挥官。别搞砸。

column1: Tiesa \"Navaja\" Norkus has holed up in the Emerald Dawn's most heavily fortified stronghold, and she's using a number of civilian hostages as human shields. Unfortunately, there isn't much that we can do for those people; Lady Cunningham has made it very clear that eliminating the Emerald Dawn's leadership is imperative, and it'll be impossible for us to take out Norkus without incurring collateral damage.
column2: “剃刀”蒂萨·诺库斯龟缩在翡翠黎明最坚固的堡垒中，并挟持多名平民人肉盾牌作为掩护. 不幸的是，我们无力拯救那些人——坎宁安女士已明确表示必须消灭翡翠黎明领导层. 而我们要击杀诺库斯就难免造成附带损伤.

column1: Time for some payback. Since Sybil's unit isn't here. I am going to pound her men into the ground. Be a good minion and help me with this.
column2: 该算账了。既然西比尔的部队不在这里，我就要把她的人砸进地里。做个好手下，帮我一把。

column1: Time to bring the thunder.
column2: 是时候降下雷霆了。

column1: Time to kick the Clan Pups off this ball of rock. Engage their base and clear out any remaining Touman.
column2: 该把那些部族崽子从这块石头上踢下去了。攻击他们的基地，清掉任何残留部队。

column1: Today we will see if you can accomplish tasks by staying On Mission. Do not dissapoint us. Blow that base up by placing the beacons.
column2: 今天我们要看看你能否坚守任务目标完成任务。别让我们失望。放置信标把基地炸掉。

column1: Told you this wouldn't be simple.
column2: 我早说过这事不会简单。

column1: Tough luck for Razorback Company, but they knew what they were getting themselves into when they took sides against House Liao.
column2: 尖背野猪公司运气不佳，但他们选择与廖氏为敌时就该明白后果.

column1: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂了. 我们相信，如果我们夺取一座位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使他们重返谈判桌. 你的任务是拿下基地，并坚守直到我们的部队能够进驻.

column1: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂。我们相信，如果我们夺取并守住{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系中一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使对方回到谈判桌。你的任务是拿下该基地并守住它，直到我们的部队能够占领。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Tubbs needs to go down hard, Commander. The only acceptable measure of victory is enemy tonnage destroyed.
column2: 塔布斯必须被彻底打倒，指挥官。唯一可接受的胜利标准是摧毁敌方吨位。

column1: Turrets always make things more complicated, but this seems like a pretty routine operation, Commander.
column2: 炮台总是让事情变得更加复杂，可这似乎是个相当常规的行动，指挥官.

column1: Two more to go, Commander! You've brought quite a storm to {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and left hell in your wake. That's the kind of attitude we're looking for! Now get out there and crack some cockpit glass!
column2: 还剩两场，指挥官！你给{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}带来了一场风暴，身后留下一片焦土。这正是我们要的态度！现在出去，砸碎几块驾驶舱玻璃！

column1: Two of our sibko warriors have challenged two long-standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} warriors to a fight. As they haven't had their Trial of Position, we can not allow them to fight this match. We would like you to particpate as their proxies instead, saving {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s honor, while also showing our sibko what it means to be a Warrior.
column2: 我们氏族Sibko的两名战士向两名资深的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战士发起了一场决斗. 由于他们尚未通过定位试炼，我们不能允许他们进行这场比试. 我们希望你作为他们的代理出战，既能维护{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的荣誉，同时也能让我们的学员明白成为一名战士意味着什么.

column1: Two wrongs don't make a right, Commander, but they do make a payday.
column2: 负负不能得正，指挥官，但他们却可以成为我们的报酬.

column1: Typical hire-a-merc baby sitting job. A royal going silent is unusual though. Usually we'd hope for them to shut up. Let's hope it's just some faulty communications but expect trouble.
column2: 典型的雇佣兵保姆活儿. 不过一位贵族突然失联确实不寻常. 通常我们都巴不得他们闭嘴. 希望只是通讯故障，但要做好遇到麻烦的准备.

column1: Unpleasant as Subcommander Tianyu may be, he's getting his vault, SLDF Griffin and all. Our reputation with House Liao is worth more than a single 'Mech.
column2: 虽然天宇副指挥官是挺讨人厌的，但SLDF的“狮鹫”机甲什么的都归他了. 我们在廖氏的名声可比区区一台机甲值钱多了.

column1: Unremarkable, empty systems like this one are the perfect location for covert intelligence gathering operations. We believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} doing exactly that. Monitoring the pattern of DropShips making landings on the planet has led {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts to a remote, apparently empty facility. Until just a few days ago, when we picked up the unmasked signature of a 'Mech's fusion engine powering up. That facility isn't empty, and we want the data stored there.
column2: 像这种毫不起眼的空旷星系，正是秘密情报收集活动的理想地点. 我们相信{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}有一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施就在从事这样的活动. 通过监测多艘降落在该星球的空投艇的活动规律，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的分析人员锁定了一个偏远、看似空置的设施. 直到几天前，我们捕捉到了一台机甲聚变引擎启动暴露的信号. 那处设施并非空无一人，我们想要你帮我们夺取存放在那里的资料.

column1: Unsurprising that they want the key first. The risks you take as a covert operative.
column2: 不用惊讶他们优先要密钥. 这是身为一名秘密特工必须承担的风险.

column1: Wait, the local government Milita are Clan Wolf forces? This is Inner Sphere space. I am still trying to wrap my head around this one Commander.
column2: 等等，当地政府的民兵是狼族部队？这里是内天体空间。指挥官，我到现在还没想明白这件事。

column1: We are almost at our goal. It's not polite to tell a mercenary how to do their work, but I do advise you switch out your pilots to maintain morale.
column2: 我们快到目标了。指导雇佣兵怎么干活并不礼貌，但我确实建议你轮换机师以维持士气。

column1: We are approaching a guarded forward staging area. Pace yourself and press through, Commander. This is a marathon, not a sprint and we are almost done.
column2: 我们正在接近一处设防的前沿集结区。稳住节奏，持续推进，指挥官。这是一场马拉松，不是短跑，而我们快完成了。

column1: We are halfway there and combat exhaustion is setting in. Watch your people's status and we'll all get through this. We're fighting a war of attrition now.
column2: 我们已经走了一半，战斗疲劳正在显现。留意你手下的状态，我们都能撑过去。我们现在打的是一场消耗战。

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.
column2: 我们正在寻找一家雇佣兵公司来执行一些隐秘任务. 我们的一座基地被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}夺走了，而且我们相信即使现在依然有{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的人员正在遭受审讯. 我们不能允许这些人泄露机密，但如果有人看到我们摧毁自己的基地，那就太糟了. 我们需要撇清关系. 你们的任务是夷平该基地，特别是仓库和通讯设施. 如果能确保那里没有活着的目击者，我们将不胜感激，如果你消灭了所有的敌人我们还会支付一笔奖金.

column1: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在找一家雇佣兵公司为我们做些隐蔽工作。我们失去了一处基地，落到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}手里，并相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员此刻正在受审。我们不能让那些人泄密，但如果被看到是我们自己摧毁了基地，那就难看了。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们将不胜感激；若清除全部抵抗者，我们还会付一笔奖金。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We are offering a sizeable bounty for the head of a local outlaw. The target is a rogue {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior who has attacked {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel and facilities in this system. We need a mercenary company to find her and take her down before she takes out her aggressions on any more of our settlements.
column2: 我们要出一大笔赏金缉拿当地一名不法分子的首级. 目标是一名在这个星系中攻击了{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员和设施的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恶棍机甲战士. 我们需要一家佣兵公司找到她，在她继续攻击我们的定居点之前把她干掉.

column1: We believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has landed an elite lance on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Its continued presence inside contested territory is unacceptable, and threatens to distract our own forces into trying to track it down and engage it. We need you to locate and eliminate this lance.
column2: 我们确信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}空降了一支精英机甲小队. 该部队持续存在于争议领土的行为不可接受，并可能迫使我方分兵追踪与之交战. 我们需要你找到并消灭这支小队.

column1: We believe there is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance operating on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. All {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Patrol the area, find the enemy lance, and eliminate it.
column2: 我们相信一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系，一个我们所控制的区域活动. 只要这支小队能够自由行动，那所有{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动就都会受到威胁. 巡逻这片地区，找出敌方小队，消灭它.

column1: We can finally pack this in. Go get 'em, Commander
column2: 我们终于可以收尾了。去干掉他们，指挥官

column1: We can't let the Aggressors get away with what they're doing here, Commander. Punish them for it.
column2: 指挥官，我们不能让侵略者在这里的所作所为就这么算了。为此惩罚他们。

column1: We don't have any intelligence about other possible enemy forces on the ground, Commander, so keep your eyes open.
column2: 我们没有关于地面上可能存在的其他敌军情报，所以务必保持警惕，指挥官.

column1: We don't have to tell you speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我们多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: We don’t have to tell you speed is of the essence here.
column2: 不用我们多说，你也知道速度在这里至关重要。

column1: We get paid only for a confirmed kill, although there's a bonus for clearing out any additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. Still, it may be best to approach this as a hit-and-run operation.
column2: 只有确认了的击杀才能让我们得到酬劳，不过清除额外的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队还能得到奖励. 尽管如此，把这当作一次打了就跑的行动可能是最好的选择.

column1: We had a deal with a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's decided he's too good to work with us anymore. That's not okay. We want you to go down there and show him that it's not okay. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
column2: 我们曾经在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}和一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲战士达成过协议. 他帮我们解决一些行动，作为交换，我们会为他提供一些在公开市场上得不到的东西——你懂我的意思. 但现在他觉得自己不屑再与我们合作了. 这可不行. 我们想要你下去告诉他，这样做是行不通的. 他很可能会试图逃跑. 别让他跑掉.

column1: We had a few associates go missing recently, and where should they happen to turn up but a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} black site? We have to assume they're being interrogated right now. Normally, we'd be extremely concerned for their welfare and we'd try to rescue them, but in this case it seems likely they're beyond rescue. We need you to level that black site, to ensure any secrets they've spilled are erased.
column2: 我们最近有几位同伴失踪了，除了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的黑狱之外他们还应该在哪儿呢? 我们不得不假设他们现在正受到审讯. 通常情况下，我们会非常关心他们的安危并尝试营救，但在这种情况下，他们很可能已经无法被救回. 我们需要你摧毁那座黑狱，以确保他们泄露的任何秘密被彻底抹除.

column1: We had a spy who infiltrated this rabble-rousing lot some time ago. They have picked up valuable information and now require a field extraction. I'm sure you're familiar with the specifics.
column2: 我们有个间谍早先打入了这群煽动闹事的人当中。他们已获取了宝贵情报，现在需要一次战地撤离。具体细节想必你很清楚。

column1: We had to deal with hunger back home. Stealing food from starving people is low.
column2: 我们老家也得应付饥饿。从挨饿的人手里偷食物，太下作了。

column1: We have a BattleMech causing us trouble in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} who refuses to back down until you, Commander, show up and fight them in a duel. They call themselves Killbox. I don't know what their problem is with you but we'll pay you to get here and just deal with them. It's causing us a headache.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}遇到了一台战斗机甲，它一直给我们制造麻烦，并且声称除非你，指挥官，亲自到场与它进行决斗，否则绝不罢休. 它自称为“杀戮箱”. 我不知道它跟你有什么过节，但我们愿意付钱让你过来处理掉它. 这事让我们很头疼.

column1: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一座基地有个VIP，我们刚刚从一个当地特工那里收到一条混乱的讯息，说基地将受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的袭击. 他们是冲着VIP去的，并且清楚我们的部队无法及时赶去支援. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵小队来保护基地和我们的人员.

column1: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位贵宾，刚收到当地特工发来的混乱讯息，称基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的袭击。他们的目标就是这位贵宾，而且他们知道我军的兵力无法及时赶到救援。我们需要一支能干的雇佣兵小队来保护设施和我们的人员。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}设有一个集中补给站，用于支援多个战线的敌对行动. 由于大量部队部署在其他地方，我们需要一支雇佣兵小队来看护我们的前哨. 目前没有情报显示存在具体威胁，但谨慎起见总是好的.

column1: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have a developing situation, Commander, and we need your help to resolve it. One of our minor signals outposts on the planet was attacked and destroyed recently by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, and they're now moving in the open towards a supply depot that we cannot afford to lose. We'd like your team to set down and intercept them; they're very heavily armed, but they're making no real effort to conceal their movement. They should be a relatively simple target.
column2: 形势正在起变化，指挥官，我们需要你帮助解决它. 我们在这个星球的一座小型信号站最近被一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队攻击并摧毁了，现在他们正向一座补给站前进，这座补给站不容有失. 我们要你的队伍着陆并拦截他们; 他们武装到了牙齿，但是没有隐蔽自己的行动. 他们应该是个比较简单的目标.

column1: We have a developing situation, Commander. A significant {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force has dropped onto the planet, and are currently moving towards critical {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities. We cannot allow those facilities to be taken. We need you to intercept this force and destroy them. To ensure this mission goes smoothly, we'll be sending a lance of our own along on the mission.
column2: 我们的形势正在起变化，指挥官. 一大批{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已经空投到了这颗行星，目前正向重要的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施前进. 我们不允许那些设施被夺走. 我们需要你拦截这支军队并摧毁之. 为了确保这一任务能平稳进行，我们会派支自己的小队一起参与任务.

column1: We have a large pirate strike force moving on our base. While they try to encircle us, you'll use the opportunity to crush their forward position. Smash through their defenders and move onto their base as quickly as you can.
column2: 一支大规模海盗打击部队正向我们的基地推进。当他们试图包围我们时，你将利用这个机会碾碎他们的前沿阵地。冲垮他们的守军，尽快推进到他们的基地。

column1: We have a new report from the ISF, Commander. They've located a heavily armed lance of 'Mechs in the badlands of this cold and unpleasant planet. They're way outside the usual FedSuns patrol routes, which leads my staff to suspect this is our target, moving with a significant escort to whatever their meeting place is. If they go to ground, it's going to be extremely challenging to dig them back out, so let's avoid that eventuality by intercepting this lance immediately and turning them all into smoking craters.
column2: 我们刚收到ISF的最新报告，指挥官. 他们在这颗寒冷阴郁行星的荒原上定位到了一支全副武装的机甲小队. 他们远远偏离了恒星联邦军队的常规巡逻路线，这让我的参谋部怀疑这正是在一支强大护卫下的目标，正赶往某个会面地点. 一旦他们躲起来，再想把他们挖出来就极其困难了. 所以我们得立刻拦截这支小队. 把他们全变成冒烟的弹坑，以免后患.

column1: We have a report that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been operating a hidden surveillance base somewhere on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Unfortunately, they intercepted our spies' reports and have evacuated the base, torching everything useful. We'd like to prevent any of the data they've collected from leaving the planet. We've been able to identify their likely evacuation route, and we need you to intercept their evac convoy and destroy it.
column2: 我们收到报告，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的某处建立了一个隐藏的监视基地. 不幸的是，他们截获了我们的间谍报告，并已撤离基地，将所有有用的东西付之一炬. 我们希望阻止他们收集的数据离开这颗行星. 我们已经查明了他们可能的撤离路线，需要你拦截他们的撤离车队并将其摧毁.

column1: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
column2: 我们这里有个状况，想要你帮忙. 我们侦测到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}和{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}的联合特遣部队在这颗行星上公开活动. 我们需要猎杀他们，将他们打成渣子，可就算我们能够找着他们，我们自己的部队也无法胜任同时与那么多敌人交战的任务. 我们要你派一支小队伴随我们的队伍; 那么你们俩就能一起和敌人交战，抵消他们的数量优势.

column1: We have a small disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need it and are preparing to reactivate it. We'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in. We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的一处偏远地区有一座小型废弃基地. 目前我们需要重新启用它，并正为此做准备. 我们想雇佣你们去侦察该设施并加以防守，直到我方部队抵达. 半日内会有一支小队与你们会合，后勤小组则会在24小时内赶到.

column1: We have a very ambitious target in mind for you: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base. Thousands of tons of armor, ammunition, 'Mech parts, and personnel pass through this facility every day, all on its way to front-line fighting units. A strike at this base will seriously hinder the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, possibly even turning the tide of battle completely against them. It will be well-defended, and as soon as the assault begins the enemy will scramble reinforcements.
column2: 我们为你安排了一个极具挑战性的目标: 一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地. 每天都有数千吨重的装甲、弹药、机甲部件和人员通过这座设施流转，送往前线作战部队. 对基地来次袭击会严重阻碍{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，甚至有可能彻底扭转与他们的战斗局势. 该基地防守严密，一旦开始攻击，敌方将立即调动增援.

column1: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.
column2: 我们有个极其古怪的任务要交给你. 我们在下方的行星上有一座制造厂，并且早已察觉到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队一直在周边侦察. 我们料到他们会有所行动，但万万没想到他们竟然...事先给我们发来了警告? 显然，他们的雇佣兵联系了我们，告知了攻击时间，原因是——我照原话引述——“职业道德”. 我们完全搞不懂那是什么意思.

column1: We have an extremely time sensitive mission for you. The remains of a decimated {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} company are preparing to leave {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Strike fast and hit them before they escape.
column2: 我们有一项极为紧急的任务交给你们. 一支被打残的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}连队残部正准备撤离{TGT_SYSTEM.name}. 迅速出击，在他们逃脱之前截住他们.

column1: We have an ongoing relationship with a well-known mercenary, and one of the elements of that relationship that they insisted on was an insurance policy: if they're captured, we're obligated to mount a rescue attempt. They've been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and that's triggered the rescue clause. They managed to escape on their own but have no way off the planet, and are surrounded by hostiles. We need you to reach the facility where they're hiding and pick them up.
column2: 我们和一个知名佣兵有着持续不断的关系，那个关系中有一个他们坚持要求的要素，那是一项保险政策: 如果他们被捕，我们就有责任去尝试营救. 他们被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队抓走了，从而触发了营救条款. 他们得以自行逃走但无法离开星球，还被敌人包围了. 我们需要你到达他们藏身的设施，接走他们.

column1: We have an operation planned to raid a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base, steal everything that isn't nailed down, and sell it on the black market. There's a missing element in the plan: you. We need you to draw off a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol so that we can move into the base unopposed and load the goods. We figure that you hit the patrol, they call for reinforcements, and then you take those out as well. Then, we sell the stuff and split the take with you.
column2: 我们正计划突袭一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地，抢走所有可移动的物资并通过黑市销售. 计划中缺少一个关键环节: 你. 我们需要你引开一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队，好让我们能够无阻碍地进入基地并装载货物. 预计你攻击巡逻队后，他们会呼叫援军，那你就同样干掉那些援军. 事后我们将出售物资并与你分成.

column1: We have an operative in place in a covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.
column2: 我们在一个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究设施中安插了一名特工，在过去一年里，他一直为我们收集敏感研究数据. 现该特工通知已准备就绪，需派遣一支可否认身份的部队执行数据提取. 该研究设施未接入任何数据网络，且所有安全实验室均深埋地下，以致于无线信号被屏蔽. 为了获取信息，我们需要在设施上方直接布置卫星接收器. 你的任务是放置定位信标，使卫星能够锁定研究数据信号并下载数据.

column1: We have an operative in place in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility, and for the past year they've been gathering sensitive research data for us. They've notified us that they're ready for us to extract the data, and we need a deniable force to arrange that extraction. The research facility is not connected to any data networks, and all the secure laboratories are far enough underground that wireless data signals are blocked. To get the information out, we're going to need to position a satellite receiver directly above the site. Your task will be to place positioning beacons to allow the satellite to lock on to the research data signal and download it.
column2: 我们在一个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究设施中安插了一名特工，在过去一年里，他一直为我们收集敏感研究数据. 现该特工通知已准备就绪，需派遣一支可否认身份的部队执行数据提取. 该研究设施未接入任何数据网络，且所有安全实验室均深埋地下，以致于无线信号被屏蔽. 为了获取信息，我们需要在设施上方直接布置卫星接收器. 你的任务是放置定位信标，使卫星能够锁定研究数据信号并下载数据.

column1: We have an opportunity to eliminate a key figure in the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hierarchy in this system, which will leave their organization in chaos and ensure safety for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. The target will be relatively unguarded and vulnerable, and we'd like you to strike in this window of opportunity.
column2: 我们有机会消灭本星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}统治集团的一名关键人物，从而令他们的组织陷入混乱，确保{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}行动的安全性. 目标相对来说没什么防备，较为脆弱，我们想要你在这个机遇期发动打击.

column1: We have an opportunity to get our hands on the next season of a popular holovid series before it's sent out for general distribution. Fans will pay through the nose to get a copy even a few weeks early. All you have to do is go to the secure {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where the data is being stored, and our agent will transmit the data directly to your 'Mech. Oh, if you have a chance, pick the agent up, too? He's holed up in a secondary facility.
column2: 我们有机会在热门全息影剧新一季正式发行前搞到片源. 剧迷们甚至愿意为提前几周看到片子砸下重金. 你只需前往存放数据的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}安全设施，我们的内应将直接把数据传至你的机甲. 对了，如果有机会的话，把内应一并接走? 他目前藏身在一座辅助设施中.

column1: We have an urgent assignment that we'd like your assistance with, Commander. We have a secret listening post here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have discovered the base's location. We need time to transmit all the data we've gathered to a DropShip in orbit, but they're already advancing on the facility. Worse, we're detecting an engine signature from an assault-class 'Mech closing on the base's location. We need you to drop immediately and protect that base until we can get the data transmitted.
column2: 我们有一项紧急任务需要你的协助，指挥官. 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}设有一个秘密监听哨，而我们刚刚得知{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的特工已经发现了基地的位置. 我们需要时间把收集的数据传输到轨道上的一艘空投艇，但他们已经向基地逼近. 更糟的是，我们在靠近基地的位置侦测到了一部袭击型机甲的引擎信号. 我们需要你立即出击，保护基地，直到数据传输完成.

column1: We have an urgent problem that needs an immediate military response, Commander. We've just detected multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShips en route to one of our supply bases. Logistics bases are generally protected by automated turret systems, but this attack force is much larger than the turret systems were meant for. We want you to provide additional firepower in case the turrets aren't enough.
column2: 我们有个紧急问题，需要即刻做出军事回应，指挥官. 我们刚刚侦测到数艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇向我们的一座补给基地飞来. 后勤基地一般由自动炮台系统保护，但这支攻击部队的规模远大于炮台系统的能力. 我们要你提供额外的火力，以免炮台不够用.

column1: We have arranged a training mission on this planet. Of course, we did not inform the Local Government we would be using their forces as training dummies.
column2: 我们已在这颗星球上安排了一次训练任务. 当然，我们并没有通知当地政府我们将把他们的部队用作训练假人.

column1: We have decided to use these Mechs' advanced maneuverability to destroy the Local Government's leadership. I hope that this is within your abilities, Commander.
column2: 我们决定利用这些机甲的高级机动性来摧毁地方政府领导层. 我希望这在你能力范围之内，指挥官.

column1: We have detected an inbound dropship belonging to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Our local defense forces in the expected drop area are ill-equipped to handle a lance of 'Mechs, but with your aid we can ensure that the raid does minimal damage. We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.
column2: 我们探测到一艘隶属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的来袭空投艇. 我们在预计降落区域的地方防御部队装备不足，难以应对一支机甲小队，但有了你的协助，我们就能确保这次突袭造成的损害降到最低. 我们希望你拦截并消灭这支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲小队.

column1: We have detected an inbound dropship belonging to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Our local defense forces in the expected drop area are ill-equipped to handle a lance of 'Mechs, but with your aid we can ensure that the raid does minimal damage. We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们探测到一艘属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的空投艇正进入。我们在预计投放区域的本地防御部队无力应付一支机甲分队，但有你的协助，我们能确保这次袭击造成的损害降到最低。我们希望你去拦截那支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队并将其摧毁。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We have eyes on Sentry Team Alpha, Commander—they're patrolling the AO, just as I said they would be. Expect moderate-to-heavy resistance on the path to your objective. As a reminder, it is absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination. Do not disappoint me.
column2: 我们盯上哨兵小队阿尔法了，指挥官——他们正在巡逻行动区域，正如我所料。通往目标的路途上预期会遇到中到重度抵抗。提醒一下，这支车队抵达目的地绝对至关重要。别让我失望。

column1: We have intel that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is conducting military exercises on this backwater world. This is an opportunity to covertly advance {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} interests in the region. We need a deniable force to intercept their drills and provide them with some live-fire exercises instead. We believe there is a primary lance of 'Mechs and a supporting lance of vehicles.
column2: 我们获得情报，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在这个穷乡僻壤进行军事演习。这是秘密推进{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在该地区利益的机会。我们需要一支可否认的部队去拦截他们的演练，改为给他们提供一些实弹演习。我们相信有一支主力机甲分队和一支支援车辆分队。

column1: We have little to no intel on what you're going to find out there, Commander. Keep your eyes open; it's absolutely vital that this convoy reach its destination.
column2: 我们几乎没有任何信息，可以期待什么，指挥官，所以睁大你的眼睛. 车队到达目的地势在必行.

column1: We have long suspected that there is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research station hidden in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, and we've finally gotten wind of its possible location. We need a few brave, and plausibly deniable, mercenaries to secure the location for a dropship extraction of any valuable scientific personnel.
column2: 我们早就怀疑在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系中藏着一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究站，现在我们终于掌握了它可能的位置. 我们需要一些勇敢，且能合理撇清关系的佣兵拿下这块地方，以便让空投艇撤出任何有价值的科研人员.

column1: We have our work cut out for us on this one. We have to make sure these guys stay safe so they can get back in the fight and help us.
column2: 这一票我们得下大功夫。我们必须确保这些人安全无余，好让他们能重新投入战斗并帮助我们。

column1: We have reached the destination: The bunker containing the genetic legacy of the Reaved Clan.
column2: 我们已抵达目的地：收容被洗劫氏族基因遗产的掩体。

column1: We have reliable information that a remote {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} laboratory is attempting to reverse-engineer sensitive {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} technology in violation of the usage license. They have failed to respond to our communications that they cease and desist these unlawful operations. Therefore, we authorize you to execute the license termination clause upon that facility.
column2: 我们有可靠的信息表明，一处偏远的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}实验室正违反使用许可试图对敏感的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}技术进行逆向工程. 他们未对我们要求其停止这些非法操作的通知作出回应. 因此，我们授权你对该设施执行许可终止条款.

column1: We have tracked ComStar to this hell hole of a planet. Whatever they are hiding here, I have to have. So let's start simple. Agent X has been sighted here with his crew. Get down there and take him out.
column2: 我们追踪康星到了这颗地狱般的行星。不管他们在这里藏了什么，我都要拿到。所以从简单的开始。X特工和他的队伍在这里被发现过。下去，把他做掉。

column1: We just need to buy them enough time to do the purge and then get them out safely.
column2: 我们只需要为他们争取足够的时间来完成数据清除，然后安全地将他们撤离.

column1: We made the right call, commander.
column2: 我们做对了，指挥官。

column1: We maintain a very accurate registry of all military convoys on this planet. Recently, an analyst spotted something odd: a convoy that wasn't accounted for anywhere in our records. It's been regularly traveling along one of our standard logistical routes, and using our logistical comms, which is how it evaded detection for so long. Our signals intercepts tell us they're {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} drivers, so we have to assume they're smuggling right in our own backyard. We don't want to spook them with our own military comm chatter; we need an independent force to intercept and destroy them.
column2: 我们维持着一个极为精确的登记册，登记了这颗星球上的所有军用车队. 最近，一名分析员发现了一些异常: 一支在我们记录中没有丝毫痕迹的车队. 它一直定期沿着我们的标准后勤路线行驶，使用我们的后勤通讯，这也是它长期未被发现的原因. 我们截获的信号告诉我们，他们是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的机师，所以我们不得不假定他们就在我们自己的后院搞走私. 我们不想因为我们自己的军用通讯打草惊蛇; 我们需要一支独立的部队去拦截并消灭他们.

column1: We may not be able to take out Tiesa Norkus, but at least we can contain her. If she wants to hide behind human shields, fine—let her hide. We'll do as much damage to the Emerald Dawn as we can, and when Lady Cunningham's DropShip touches down, she can handle the hostage negotiations.
column2: 我们也许无法除掉蒂莎·诺库斯，但至少能困住她。如果她想躲在人盾后面，行——就让她躲着。我们要尽可能重创翠绿黎明，等坎宁安女士的空投艇降落，她可以处理人质谈判。

column1: We need to keep moving on this one. Looks like the ComGuard presence is thick.
column2: 这一票我们得抓紧推进。看来康卫队的存在相当密集。

column1: We need to make a deniable strike on a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. Intel shows the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That level of technology could shift the balance of power in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} - something {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership isn't willing to tolerate.
column2: 我们需要对一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队发起一次可以撇清关系的袭击. 情报显示该车队是一支武器运输队，其中至少包括一套完好的星际联盟时期的武器系统. 那个级别的技术足以改变{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的势力平衡--这是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人不能容忍的.

column1: We need to take down the Reflux Generator on this world. It seems to be the whole reason the universe seems upside down right now. Destroy the defenses and get ready for the situation to flow. We should use the convertible abilities of the power armor to approach quickly.
column2: 我们必须摧毁这颗星球上的逆流发生器. 它似乎正是导致当前宇宙颠倒混乱的根源. 摧毁其防御工事，并准备好迎接局势的发展. 我们应当利用动力甲的可变形能力，迅速接近目标.

column1: We need to transfer a prisoner from {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} to another system. This prisoner has allies in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} that will stop at nothing to set their ally free. To make it harder for them to target the prisoner, we are doing our best to send out mixed signals on the prisoner and when the transfer will be. We are also sending {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces out as 'dummy' convoys, and sending multiple vehicles in each convoy. However, your convoy will be the real one.
column2: 我们需要从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}转移一名囚犯到其它星系. 该囚犯在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}有同伙，他们会不惜一切代价去救出囚犯. 为了让他们更难锁定囚犯，我们正全力释放关于囚犯身份及转移时间的混淆信息. 我们还派出{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队作为诱饵车队，每队配置多辆车辆. 不过，你的 车队才是真正执行转移的那支.

column1: We need you to Deliver to our Subscription Holders inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They will be carrying highly sensitive scientific materials which must be Delivered quickly. These materials are of a biological nature, and must not be tampered with. Opening or tampering with the materials will be considered a breach of contract.
column2: 我们需要你将物资送达{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究设施内的订阅用户手中. 他们将携有高度敏感的科学材料，必须尽快送达. 这些材料具有生物活性，严禁擅自拆封或改动，否则将被视为违约行为.

column1: We need you to destroy a convoy of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} vehicles that was involved in a strike on our holdings. You like credits, yes?
column2: 我们需要你摧毁一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 的车队，他们参与了对我们领地的一次打击。你喜欢信用点，对吧？

column1: We need you to get in and get out fast.
column2: 我们需要你快速进出。

column1: We need you to get in get and out fast.
column2: 我们需要你进去再快速出来。

column1: We need you to recover our operatives from inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They will be carrying highly sensitive scientific materials which must be returned to us. These materials are of a biological nature, and must not be tampered with. Opening or tampering with the materials will be considered a breach of contract.
column2: 我们需要你从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究设施中救出我们的特工. 他们携带的都是高度敏感的科学材料，必须完好无损地回到我们这里. 这些材料具有生化性质，禁止擅自处理. 打开或擅自处理这些材料将被视为违反合约.

column1: We need you to search for and destroy any pirate stragglers, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你搜寻并消灭任何落单的海盗。

column1: We operate a BattleMech repair facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This base is critical to our 'Mech operations in the system, and we believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are planning an assault. We'd like you to protect the facility, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一座战斗机甲维修设施. 这座基地对我们在该星系的机甲行动至关重要，我们相信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在策划一场袭击. 我们要你保护这座设施，如果遭遇袭击，就拖延住，直到我们的部队能赶到并接替你.

column1: We operate a repair and maintenance facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  This base is critical to our operations in the system, and we suspect that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are going to assault the facility.  We'd like you to garrison the base, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一座修理维护设施. 这座基地对我们在该星系的行动至关重要，我们怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队准备袭击这座设施. 我们要你们驻守这座设施，如果遭遇袭击就拖延住，直到我们的部队能赶到并接替你们.

column1: We operate a repair and maintenance facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This base is critical to our operations in the system, and we suspect that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are going to assault the facility. We'd like you to garrison the base, and if an attack comes, hold off the assault until our forces can arrive and relieve you.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}运营着一座修理维护设施. 这座基地对我们在该星系的行动至关重要，我们怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队准备袭击这座设施. 我们要你们驻守这座设施，如果遭遇袭击就拖延住，直到我们的部队能赶到并接替你们.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them.  This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence.  We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited.  If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们会定期调查那些“荒凉”的星球，确保上面没有意料之外的活动. 这一次，我们走运了. 一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小组捕捉到了来自{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}表面的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，这个信号和一部正在进行试射的重型机甲相符. 考虑到这颗星球本应无人居住，我们怀疑敌人带走机甲是为了做验证性试验. 如果我们能够定位并截下这部机甲，就能够使这部强力武器免于落入敌人手中.

column1: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them. This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence. We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited. If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
column2: 我们会定期调查那些“荒凉”的星球，确保上面没有意料之外的活动. 这一次，我们走运了. 一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小组捕捉到了来自{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}表面的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，这个信号和一部正在进行试射的重型机甲相符. 考虑到这颗星球本应无人居住，我们怀疑敌人带走机甲是为了做验证性试验. 如果我们能够定位并截下这部机甲，就能够使这部强力武器免于落入敌人手中.

column1: We picked up a coded transmission from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scouts report a previously unknown manufacturing plant has been activated by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and they're broadcasting what we believe might be pre-war blueprints to an unknown recipient somewhere in the system. We need you to move in and capture that facility, intact, and protect it while we mobilize a garrison.
column2: 我们截获了一条来自{TGT_SYSTEM.name}地表的加密通讯: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}侦察兵报告称，一个此前未知的制造工厂已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队启用，并且他们正在将我们认为是战前设计图的信息广播给星系内某处的未知接收者. 我们需要你前去完好无损地拿下那座设施，并在我们调动驻防部队期间保护它.

column1: We promised Shugo Yamaguchi we'd do this. May as well get it over with.
column2: 我们已经向山口修吾承诺过要完成这件事，不如赶紧结束吧.

column1: We recently lost contact with one of our forward bases in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. We've heard rumours of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near here so it might be related. We need you to go in and investigate for us.
column2: 我们最近失去了与{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系中一处前沿基地的联系. 我们听闻附近有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}活动的传闻，因此这可能与此有关. 我们需要你们前往那里进行调查.

column1: We require a small but overwhelming military strike to infiltrate {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} territory and disable their communications facility. As prelude to hostile actions elsewhere in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, it's imperative that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} network goes offline, to remove their ability to coordinate a response.
column2: 我们需要一次小型而有力的军事打击以渗透到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的领地，瘫痪他们的通讯设施. 作为{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上其它敌对行动的序幕，必须让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的网络下线，以消除他们协调响应的能力.

column1: We should expect heavy resistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't saying what's in that facility, but whatever it is has them riled up.
column2: 我们应该会遇到强烈的抵抗; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}并没有透露那座设施里究竟有什么，但无论是什么，显然已经让他们极为紧张.

column1: We traced the origin of the Soarece tanks to this location. We're not sure if it's a cache or a functioning automated factory. Either way, it needs to go. Place beacons for our Artillery to target, and exfiltrate while our guns destroy the base.
column2: 我们追踪索阿雷斯坦克的来源到了这里。我们不确定这是一处储藏库还是一座在运转的自动化工厂。不管是哪种，它都得消失。为我方炮兵放置信标，在我方火炮摧毁基地时撤离。

column1: We will be fighting one of the best opponents here.
column2: 我们将与这里最顶尖的对手之一交锋.

column1: We will have a serious opponent here.
column2: 我们在这里会遇到一个难缠的对手。

column1: We will only have a short amount of time to get to the control station to disable the landing pads, Make sure the 'Mechs you drop with have enough speed Commander.
column2: 我们只有很短时间来抵达控制站并瘫痪着陆平台，指挥官，确保你投放的机甲速度足够。

column1: We'd be dead without your assistance, Commander. Full stop. There are at least a dozen different bandit gangs operating on the outskirts of our territory, and any one of 'em would jump at the chance to gun us down. So… thanks for doing what's decent. From all of us.
column2: 没有你的协助我们就死定了，指挥官。句号。我们领地郊外至少有十几伙不同的匪帮在活动，任何一伙都会扑上来把我们打成筛子。所以……谢谢你做了体面的事。我们所有人都是。

column1: We'll be outnumbered and outmatched, Commander, but that's hardly a new experience for us.
column2: 我们将面临人数的劣势，指挥官，但这对我们来说并不是什么新鲜事.

column1: We'll be outnumbered two to one, Commander. I don't particularly like those odds, but we're committed now, so let's buckle down and get the job done.
column2: 我们人数会处于一比二的劣势，指挥官. 我倒不是特别喜欢这种胜算，但既然已经骑虎难下，那就让我们全力以赴把活儿干完吧.

column1: We're almost there, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Just one more push and the derelict is ours.
column2: 我们快到了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 再最后加把劲，那艘废弃飞船就归我们了.

column1: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. Be aware that my people picked up a very large spike in comms chatter right after our previous mission, so they're expecting you.
column2: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官. 一旦你进入作战区域，你需要向基地推进并设置信标进行三角定位，以便我们的隐蔽空投艇，Airavata，能够传输认证代码并下载研究数据. 在廖氏的轨道舰发现我们并前来调查之前，我们只有有限的时间窗口，因此你们的行动时间相对紧张. 请注意，我方人员在上一个任务结束后监测到通讯量激增，这意味着敌人已有所防备.

column1: We're approaching the joint research base, Commander. Once you're in the AO, you'll need to move up to the base and set beacons to triangulate around it so that our covert DropShip, the Airavata, can transmit the authentication code and download the research data. We have a limited window of opportunity before the Liao ships in orbit detect our presence and come to investigate, so you'll be operating under a relatively tight timeline. So far, we've managed to keep things quiet, so while I expect significant opposition, you should be able to handle it.
column2: 我们正在接近联合研究基地，指挥官. 一旦你进入作战区域，你需要向基地推进并设置信标进行三角定位，以便我们的隐蔽空投艇，Airavata，能够传输认证代码并下载研究数据. 在廖氏的轨道舰发现我们并前来调查之前，我们只有有限的时间窗口，因此你们的行动时间相对紧张. 目前我们仍保持隐蔽状态，虽然预计会遭遇强烈抵抗，但你应该能够应对.

column1: We're assaulting a fortified base with an underweight lance, Commander. Sort of feels like old times, doesn't it?
column2: 用一支不足编制的小队攻打一座设防基地，指挥官. 有点像从前的日子，不是吗?

column1: We're currently trying to engage in long-term operations in this system, which runs counter to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} interests. They've hired a well-regarded mercenary outfit to engage {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} operatives on the planet's surface, and the mercenaries have sent a single, well-armed lance. We'd like you to counter that lance, by intercepting and destroying it.
column2: 我们目前正试图在这个星系中展开长期行动，但这与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的利益相悖. 他们雇佣了一支声誉很高的雇佣兵部队，在行星表面对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的行动人员发动攻击，而那支雇佣兵部队派出了一支装备精良的小队. 我们希望你能拦截并摧毁那支小队，以对抗他们.

column1: We're getting a number of reports from agents on the ground of a powerful 'Mech sporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} colors. A single 'Mech operating on its own, out in the middle of nowhere, sounds like a trap. Our plan is to spring this trap and see who comes to investigate. Engage the 'Mech, intercept the forces {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends to defend it, and destroy all of them.
column2: 我们收到多名地面特工的报告，说有一台{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}涂装的强力机甲出现. 一台机甲单独行动、出现在荒郊野外——听起来像是个陷阱. 我们的计划是触发这个陷阱，看看谁会来调查. 与那台机甲交战，拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}派来支援的部队，并将他们全部歼灭.

column1: We're going it alone on this one, so we shouldn't have any infighting to worry about. That's a good thing, because we're gonna be outnumbered enough as it is.
column2: 这次我们要单独行动，至少不必担心内讧了. 这是好事——毕竟我们本就面临敌众我寡的局面.

column1: We're going to keep an assault 'Mech from destroying a facility, without any ground intel. This seems like a really terrible idea, Commander.
column2: 我们要在没有任何地面情报的情况下阻止一台袭击型机甲 摧毁一座设施. 指挥官，这听起来真是个糟糕透顶的主意.

column1: We're going to land in a hot AO, with no idea where we are, capture a well-defended military facility, and hold it against a counter-attack. What could go wrong?
column2: 我们会在一片激烈的行动区域里降落，不知自己身处何地，夺取一座守备森严的军用设施，还要从一轮反攻中坚守下来. 能出什么错呢?

column1: We're going to try to keep an assault 'Mech from destroying a facility, without any ground intel. This seems like a really terrible idea, Commander.
column2: 我们要在没有任何地面情报的情况下阻止一台袭击型机甲 摧毁一座设施. 指挥官，这听起来真是个糟糕透顶的主意.

column1: We're in a bit of trouble. Two of our pilots challenged two long standing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} duelists to a fight. Only now our pilots are nowhere to be found. Can you step in and take their spots please? Of course, you'd have to pretend to be our pilots.
column2: 我们遇到点麻烦. 我们的两名机师向两位资深的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}决斗者发起了挑战. 但现在我们的机师却不知所踪. 你能顶替他们上场吗? 当然，你得假扮成我们的机师.

column1: We're in the middle of nowhere, Commander, so that means no witnesses. Convenient.
column2: 我们在一个荒无人烟的地方，指挥官，这意味着没有目击者. 很省事.

column1: We're looking for a mercenary company with a reputation for discretion. A personal friend of our leadership here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has requested protection for a convoy of his, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} can't commit our own forces to this task. While his convoy is armed and armored, he suspects that his enemies have hired mercenaries of their own to interdict this shipment.
column2: 我们在寻找一家以谨慎闻名的雇佣兵公司. 我们领导人在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一位私人朋友要求保护他的一支车队，但是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不能承诺用我们自己的队伍来完成这项任务. 虽然他的车队武备齐全，但他仍然怀疑他的敌人已经雇了佣兵来阻断这支运输队.

column1: We're on the home stretch now, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 我们进入最后一段了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

column1: We're planning an operation and to pull it off, we need the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities to be temporarily distracted. We need you to create that distraction. We'll point you at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol. You do something loud and fatal to them. Meanwhile, we execute our operation and give you a cut of the proceeds. Oh, and there may be reinforcements. That's good; that's one less lance to get in our way.
column2: 我们正在计划一项行动，为了顺利完成，需要暂时分散{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局的注意力. 我们需要你来制造这个干扰. 我们会指引你找到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队. 你只需对他们来点“响亮而致命”的动静. 与此同时，我们会执行我们的行动，并让你也分一杯羹. 哦还有，也许会有援军. 不过那正好——这意味着又少了一支干扰我们 的机甲小队.

column1: We're starting this simple, Commander. Your job is asset extraction. This is complicated by the Local Government not wanting you to escape, but I'm sure you know what to do. They've posted a heavily armed escort to stop this, but we trust that this won't trouble you.
column2: 指挥官，这次先从简单的任务开始。你的任务是撤离目标资产。麻烦之处在于当地政府不想让你离开，但我相信你知道该怎么做。他们已派出重装护卫来阻止这件事，不过我们相信这难不倒你。

column1: We're taking a gamble on this one, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. But given our options, it's one that I can live with.
column2: 这事儿我们是在赌一把，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 但考虑到我们的可选项，这个险我冒得心安理得.

column1: We're talking about House Steiner here. Considering the context, \"scout\" may not mean what we think it means.
column2: 我们讨论的可是施泰纳家族. 考虑到这个背景，“侦察”的含义可能和我们的理解有所不同.

column1: We're tracking a regular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical convoy through this area, and believe the convoy is carrying critical supplies for an unknown number of military units. We'd like you to destroy the convoy and any supplies it might be hauling. We have no information on what defenses the convoy is likely to have, so assume at least one lance escorting. If so, there is a bonus in it for you if you eliminate that escort lance.
column2: 我们正在追踪一支穿越这一地区的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}定期补给车队，并且相信该车队正在为一支数量不明的军事部队运送关键补给. 我们希望你摧毁车队及其运输的所有物资. 目前尚无关于车队防御力量的情报，请至少假定有一支机甲小队随行护卫. 若存在护卫小队，全歼该小队将获得额外奖金.

column1: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoys that have been delivering weapons and explosives to a self-appointed warlord here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. In return, his fighters have been wreaking havoc on {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities in the region. We need you to interdict the convoy and destroy it.
column2: 我们正在追踪{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，这支车队一直在向{TGT_SYSTEM.name}一个自封的军阀输送武器和炸药. 作为回报，他的战士一直在大肆破坏这一地区的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施. 我们需要你拦截并摧毁这支车队.

column1: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units engaged in a secret military exercise in a remote portion of the planet's surface. This is an ideal time to strike, as they're likely damaged and exhausted from the operation, and we believe they're unaware of our presence. It isn't clear who the other party in the exercises is, but whoever it is, they're a potential witness, so we need you to eliminate them as well.
column2: 我们正在追踪一些{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，他们参与了在行星表面偏远地区开展的秘密军事演习. 这是个发动攻击的理想时机，他们可能在行动中受损，精疲力尽，而且我们相信他们没有意识到我们的存在. 还不清楚演习的另一方是谁，但不管是谁，他们都是潜在的目击者，所以我们需要你也消灭掉他们.

column1: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. There's a decommissioned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we need to take ownership of. As it's undefended, this is a perfect opportunity for our trainees to practice operating as a team in a low-risk environment. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
column2: 我们正在训练一群机甲战士作为当地的防御力量，我们希望你能协助他们的训练. 我们需要得到一座退役的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地. 由于它不设防，所以这是一个绝佳的机会，让我们的受训者在一个低风险的环境中作为一个团队进行练习. 我们需要你派出一名经验丰富的机甲战士来看着他们，给他们做个好榜样.

column1: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
column2: 我们正试图在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上建立一支由机甲战士组成的地方防御力量. 我们的机师缺乏经验，也没有经过测试，我们希望你能帮助我们训练他们. 我们收到了一个令人不安的信号，可能代表了敌对活动，这似乎是一个派遣我们的新防御部队去处理它的好机会. 你能否带一个有经验的机甲战士和机甲过去，让他们远离麻烦?

column1: We're under heavy assault from Kell's Hounds. I need you to take out the advancing forces while I prepare to meet with their leaders. We have almost made it to the goal. I am thrilled you decided to stick around. The party is going to be fun.
column2: 我们正遭到凯尔猎犬的猛烈攻击。我需要你在准备会见他们领袖时干掉那些推进的部队。我们几乎就要达成目标了。我很高兴你决定留下。这场派对会很有趣。

column1: We're up against legends. Again. But the hell with it, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Let's go make a legend of our own.
column2: 我们又在对抗传奇. 但管他呢，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 让我们一起创造属于我们自己的传奇吧！

column1: We're up to our boots in shit, Commander. Mainly because we stomped on them so hard. I am sure one of these guys have to know where Sybil is. At minimum they will stop harassing our daily lives.
column2: 我们陷到靴子那么深的屎里了，指挥官。主要是因为我们把他们踩得太狠。我相信这些人里总有一个知道西比尔在哪。至少他们会停止骚扰我们的日常生活。

column1: We've become aware of a convoy transporting supplies to a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility. We'd like those supplies to become 'lost', if you take my meaning. We will provide the coordinates to locate the shipment, and handle any cleanup after the convoy 'goes astray'.
column2: 我们得知有一支车队正在向一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的设施运送补给. 我们希望这些补给能“意外丢失”，你懂我的意思. 我们会提供找到运输队的坐标，并且会在车队“走失”后清理痕迹.

column1: We've become aware of a target of opportunity. There's a convoy of military supplies moving through unpatrolled regions on the planet below, and we'd like to seize it for ourselves. The problem is that we have credible reports that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are also moving to intercept, and they've hired a skilled mercenary to lead their efforts. We'd like you to capture that convoy instead, and take it to a designated evac zone for pickup.
column2: 我们注意到一个机会. 有支军用补给车队正在下面星球无人巡视的地区穿行，我们想将它据为己有. 问题是我们得到可靠的报告说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队也在前往拦截，他们雇了娴熟的佣兵带队. 我们要你夺取那支车队，并把它带到指定的撤离区接受接应.

column1: We've been able to infiltrate personnel into a contested region to take control of an abandoned base. We've brought the base's primary power and communications systems online, but in doing so, we've made an unfortunate discovery: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force has done the same thing with a nearby facility. They're somewhat ahead of us in the process, and have their base's turrets online; they're also landing troops and 'Mechs to hold their new acquisition. Only one of us can control this area when we're finished; we'd like you to ensure that it's us.
column2: 我们已经成功将人员渗透到一片争夺区，以接管一座废弃基地. 我们已将基地的主要电力和通信系统上线，但在此过程中，我们发现了一个不幸的情况: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队也在附近的一处设施做了同样的事. 他们在进度上略领先于我们，并已将基地的炮台上线. 他们实际上正在派遣部队和机甲以占据新获得的基地. 最终，只有一方可以控制该区域 - 我们希望你确保是我们占据控制权.

column1: We've been following this shipment of Spazz that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} intercepted. You'd think that, given all the things they say about Spazz, they'd have torched the stuff already. But instead they've locked it up in a secure depot. I'm sure they won't mind if we take that stuff off their hands. We have much better uses for it than just blowing it all up.
column2: 我们一直在跟踪这支斯帕齐运输队，就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里截下的那支. 你会这么想，按照他们所说的一切有关斯帕齐的事，他们已经将这批货付之一炬了. 可他们是将它锁在了一处安全仓库里. 我确信他们不会介意我们从他们手里拿走货的. 我们会善加利用，而不是仅仅付之一炬.

column1: We've been having troubles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} for months now, and our negotiations with them have been stalled by a stubborn {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} diplomat. If he were removed from the equation, through a random attack by \"bandits\" for instance, we might be able to make some headway.
column2: 几个月以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上一直和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}有纠纷，我们与他们的谈判因一名固执的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}外交官而陷入僵局. 如果此人能因“土匪”的随机袭击等意外从谈判桌上消失，我们或许能够取得一些进展.

column1: We've been informed by one of the largest news networks that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Governor has taken issue with a recently released report on military fund spending irregularities. She's demanded a duel to fight those allegations. We'd like to hire you to represent and uphold that worthy news report, Commander.
column2: 据我们从一家最大的新闻媒体网络获悉，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}总督对最近发布的一份关于军费支出异常的报告颇有异议. 她要求通过决斗来与报告中的指控作斗争. 指挥官，我们希望雇佣您，代表并捍卫这份值得信赖的新闻报道.

column1: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.
column2: 我们一直在监控{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的通讯流量，最后识别出了一件事情: 那里有一个防守严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，疑似用作安全数据存储设施. 我们希望你们的队伍投放、夺取该基地，并获得他们数据库内容的完整拷贝. 一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队察觉到我们的行动，他们会发动反击，因此需要你们在数据下载完成前坚守阵地.

column1: We've been monitoring communications traffic on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and discerned a pattern. There's a well-defended {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we suspect of being a secure data storage facility. We'd like your team to land, capture the base, and take a complete image of the contents of their databases. Once the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces realize what we're doing, they'll launch a counteroffensive, so we'll need you to stay in the field until the download is complete.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们一直在监视{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的通讯流量，并辨认出一种规律。那里有一处防御严密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，我们怀疑它是安全数据存储设施。我们希望你的团队降落、夺取该基地，并完整拍摄其数据库内容。一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队意识到我们在做什么，他们就会发起反攻，因此我们需要你留在战场直到下载完成。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We've been offering our good friends, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, the opportunity to buy an insurance policy on their 'Mechs. I mean, they're big, complicated pieces of machinery, right? And hardly anyone knows how to fix them? So we're offering to insure them just in case something accidental happens to them. Would you believe they said 'no thanks'? It was a really good offer. We want to show them just how good. We'd like you to cause something accidental to happen to their 'Mechs.
column2: 我们一直在向我们的好朋友，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，提供为他们的机甲投保的机会. 我的意思是，它们是又大，又复杂的机器，对不对? 几乎没人知道怎么修理它们吧? 所以我们提供投保的机会，以防它们发生意外. 你相信他们说“不，谢谢”吗? 这真的是份很好的要约. 我们只是想向他们展示一下它有多好. 我们要你给他们的机甲制造一些意外.

column1: We've been scouring the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system for weeks, looking for a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} spy who took something that didn't belong to them. Recent intelligence has revealed a possible location, but we can't possibly chase every lead with our thin resources. We need you to look into this long shot. If you find the spy, destroy them.
column2: 我们已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系搜寻数周，寻找一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍，他偷走了某样不属于他们的东西. 最新情报显示了一个可能的位置，但凭我们有限的资源，根本无法跟进每条线索. 我们需要你来进行这次希望渺茫的调查. 如果找到了间谍，务必将其消灭.

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended logistics depot. This facility is a key supplier for  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this region, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，那使我们查明了它们的目的地: 一处隐蔽，并且守备森严的后勤仓库. 这座设施是当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的重要补给来源，拿下它将大大削弱他们对我们的作战能力. 我们希望你空投进去，占领仓库，并且抵御敌人的增援.

column1: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended ordnance depot. This facility is a key supplier for local {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and taking it from them will significantly damage their efforts against us. We'd like you to drop in, take the depot, and hold out against any enemy reinforcements.
column2: 我们一直在追踪几支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队的动向，那使我们查明了它们的目的地: 一处隐蔽，并且守备森严的军械库. 这座设施是当地{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的重要补给来源，拿下它将大大削弱他们对我们的作战能力. 我们希望你空投进去，占领军械库，并且抵御敌人的增援.

column1: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
column2: 我们缴获了一台稀有的{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲. 我们的科学家一直在对其进行逆向工程，但现在他们表示需要实战数据才能继续. 我们希望你们提供这些数据. 我们已定位了一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的小队作为试验对象. 将那台机甲空投到该星球上，消灭那支小队. 不用说，我们没有第二台这样的机甲，因此务必将其完好带回.

column1: We've captured the latest pride and joy of the Capellan Confederation: a Cataphract CTF-IM. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering the monster, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the CTF-IM down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
column2: 我们缴获了卡佩兰联邦最新的骄傲与喜悦：一台甲胄CTF-IM。我们的科学家一直在逆向工程这个怪物，但现在他们说需要真实的战斗数据才能继续。我们希望你来提供那些数据。我们已定位一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队用作试验品。把CTF-IM带到行星上，消灭那支分队。不用说，我们没有第二台，所以你必须把它完好地带回来。

column1: We've come across a target of opportunity that we'd like you to take advantage of. There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance conducting a long-range patrol, and it's isolated from its supporting forces. If you strike quickly, it should be possible to destroy the lance before {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command can order reinforcements into the area.
column2: 我们发现了一个可乘之机，希望你能加以利用. 有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队正在执行长途巡逻，和它的支援部队脱离了. 如果你能迅速出击，就有可能在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部下令增援之前将其全歼.

column1: We've cornered them Commander, intel suggest his real name is 'Maurice', the vile ogre responsible for this atrocity. He speaks highly of his own skills on the battlefield but I'm not so certain at all. You'll have to determine that with your own wits, but we warned: His mech is sporting rather rare, expensive gear. It appears as though he hasn’t spared a dime on equipment. Let's slaughter this revolting individual and be done with it.
column2: 我们把他们逼到角落了，指挥官，情报显示他的真名是“莫里斯“，这场暴行的元凶、那个可憎的食人魔。他对自己在战场上的本领评价很高，可我一点也不确定。你得靠自己的判断力去验证，但我们要提醒你：他的机甲装备着相当稀有昂贵的器材。看来他在装备上不惜血本。让我们宰了这个令人作呕的家伙，了结此事。

column1: We've discovered a facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers are developing a new computer. We need you to get one of your Units within range of the research facility and Deliver Parts for the machine, which we took from Yangs machine. Then extract the Unit with reciept so we can recieve payment.
column2: 我们发现了一处设施，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的研究人员正在那里开发一种新型计算机. 我们需要你派遣一个单位进入研究设施范围内，并交付制造该机器所需的零件——这些零件是我们从杨的机器上拆下来的. 之后，携带收据撤离该单位，以便我们付款.

column1: We've discovered a facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers have developed a new computer virus that targets the control mechanisms of our 'Mechs. We can't build an effective defense against this virus without a sample of its code to work with. We need you to get one of your 'Mechs within range of the research facility and download the virus into its systems. Then extract the infected carrier 'Mech so we can analyze the virus.
column2: 我们发现了一座设施，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究人员已研发出针对我方机甲控制系统的新型计算机病毒. 如果没有病毒代码样本，我们就无法建立起对它的有效防御. 我们需要你让一台机甲靠近该研究设施，将病毒下载到它的系统中. 然后撤离受感染的载体机甲以供分析.

column1: We've discovered that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an old manufacturing facility in this system. To maintain the balance of power in this system, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} needs to capture this facility. You'll make a surgical strike, occupy the base, and hold it until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces can arrive to take control.
column2: 我们发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已在本星系重新启用了一个旧的生产设施. 为了维持本星系的力量平衡，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要夺取这处设施. 你的任务是进行一次精准打击，占领该基地，并坚守到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队前来接管为止.

column1: We've earned our rest after this!
column2: 之后我们可要好好休息！

column1: We've established a forward operations base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need a competent lance to watch it while our regular forces are on maneuver. You should expect intermittent enemy contact from probing attacks and skirmishers.
column2: 我们已在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}建立了一个前沿行动基地. 我们需要一支精干的小队在常规部队进行机动演习期间守卫它. 预计会遭到敌人试探性攻击和散兵游勇的间歇性接触.

column1: We've faced fixed emplacements many times commander, but in this case they might not be obviously clustered around a base. If they have good lines of fire it could get interesting, but nothing we can't handle.
column2: 指挥官，我们面对固定炮台的经验很多，但这次它们未必明显聚集在基地周围. 如果它们的射界良好，情况可能会变得棘手，不过还难不倒我们.

column1: We've finally arrived. This is the AI stronghold and its last bastion. This is your moment, Commander. Orbital ordinance is primed and awaiting your firing solution. Move fast and we'll end this.
column2: 我们终于到了。这是AI的据点，它的最后堡垒。这就是你的时刻，指挥官。轨道弹药已就绪，等待你的射击方案。动作快点，我们就能了结这一切。

column1: We've finally tracked down the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists responsible for a deadly attack on one of our facilities. Unfortunately, even though there's only two of them, they're extremely heavily armed and very, very dangerous. That's why we're turning to you; we simply don't have the forces available to reach them before they strike again.
column2: 我们终于锁定了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子的藏身处，他们曾对我们的设施发动致命袭击. 虽然只有两人，但他们武装到了牙齿，且极度危险. 这就是我们找上你的原因; 我们根本没有足够的兵力在他们再次发动袭击之前赶到.
