column1: We've found the Dobrev, and this time, it's in no condition to run. Time is of the essence here, so we're going to deploy alongside the Moderbjörn's drones. Hit the Baumann Group fast, hit 'em hard, and wipe the AO clean. After we've taken the Dobrev, we'll discuss our next steps.
column2: 我们找到多布雷夫号 了. 而这一次，它绝无可能再逃脱. 时间不多了，所以我们将与“熊妈妈”的无人车一起部署，对鲍曼集团发动闪电突袭，予以沉重打击并将行动区域彻底清扫干净. 夺取多布雷夫号 后，我们再商讨下一步行动.

column1: We've got Lees backed into a corner. Time to finish the job.
column2: 我们已经把利斯逼入绝境，该做个了结了.

column1: We've got a developing situation, Commander, and we need immediate aid from a reliable mercenary company. A covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was investigating reports of a cache of bioweapons on an otherwise abandoned world. We've tracked down four of these caches in the Periphery over the last 20 years, and disposed of them safely. The team was about to signal for an extraction when their signal went dead. We have reason to believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have taken control of the cache site, and eliminated our covert team. We need you to take that site and signal our disposal team.
column2: 指挥官，我们这里出现紧急情况，需要可靠的雇佣兵公司立即支援. 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}秘密小队正在调查一颗原本被遗弃星球上的生物武器藏匿点. 过去二十年里，我们在外围追踪到过四处类似的藏匿点，并且将它们安全处理了. 这次，该小队正准备发出撤离信号时，信号突然中断. 我们有理由相信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队已经控制住了那处藏匿点，并且消灭了我们的秘密小队. 我们需要你拿下那个地点并向我们的处理小组打出信号.

column1: We've got a facility down on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} where we store valuable hardware before loading it aboard our DropShips for transport out of the system. Unfortunately, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered our facility, and they're not interested in making any kind of accommodation that lets us get our goods off-planet. We need you to defend the place while we load our valuables up for evacuation.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}下面有一处设施，用来在把贵重硬件装上空投艇运出星系之前存放它们。不幸的是，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局发现了我们的设施，而他们无意做任何让我们把货物运出行星的妥协。我们需要你在我们装载贵重物资准备撤离时防守那个地方。

column1: We've got a little problem, Commander, and you're just the people to help us out. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities raided one of our warehouses. The guns and drugs, they can keep, but they also captured some of our best technicians. We need those people back to continue our work here. They're being transported to the detention center for interrogation, which would not be good for our business at all. We need you to rescue them.
column2: 指挥官，我们遇到了一点小麻烦，而你正是帮我们摆脱它的人. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局突袭了我们的一处仓库. 枪炮、药品他们要拿走就拿走吧，但他们还抓走了我们一些最优秀的技术人员. 我们需要把他们救回来，才能继续在这里开展工作. 他们正被运往集中营进行审讯，这对我们的生意可一点都不妙. 我们需要你去营救他们.

column1: We've got an interesting opportunity for you, Commander. We've recently detected a major engine signature on the planet, probably an assault-class 'Mech. We can't have an assault-class {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech that big wandering around loose, and we'd like you to handle it. The interesting part is that we've also detected another assault power-up, and it's a different 'Mech entirely, and it's closing with the target. It's possible you can just swoop in and pick up the pieces. We're prepared to offer generous salvage terms.
column2: 指挥官，我们有个很有吸引力的机会给你. 我们最近侦测到行星上有一个大型引擎信号，也许是一部袭击型机甲. 我们可不能让一台这么大的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}袭击型机甲四处游荡，所以希望你来处理它. 有意思的部分是我们还侦测到另一台 袭击型机甲，完全不同的机体，而且正在接近目标. 或许你能趁虚而入把两台都收拾掉. 我们准备提供丰厚的打捞奖励.

column1: We've got some downtime in our recording schedule. One of our Stables double booked and decided to bail on the match. We already have all the recording kit set up and it'd be a shame to let it go to waste. Feel up for taking a shot for the cameras?
column2: 我们的录制日程中有一些空档时间. 我们的一家战队安排冲突，决定退出这场比赛. 我们已经把所有录制设备都准备好了，浪费掉实在可惜. 想不想在镜头前来一场试试?

column1: We've got some downtime in our recording schedule. One of our gladiators couldn't show due to a maintenance accident on their 'Mech. If you're up for a quick buck, and maybe a shot at stardom, we could let you go a few rounds and see how you square up. Interested?
column2: 我们的录制日程中有一些空档时间. 我们的一名角斗士因为他的机甲发生维护事故，无法参加比赛. 如果你想赚点快钱，或者也许有机会一举成名，我们可以让你上场打几回合，看看你的表现如何. 感兴趣吗?

column1: We've got to intercept 'Mechs, assault a base, save a base; we've got our work cut out for us on this one, Commander.
column2: 我们得拦截机甲、突袭一座基地、守住另一座基地；这次任务可真是艰巨啊，指挥官.

column1: We've got to intercept 'Mechs, destroy a base, save a base... and there are base defense systems? Sounds like a mess.
column2: 我们得拦截机甲、摧毁一座基地、守住另一座基地——而且还有基地防御系统? 听起来真是一团糟.

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} officer is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'll pay a 20% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard.
column2: 我们已从多方渠道证实，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}高级军官正在公开行动. 这是扰乱其在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}指挥体系的难得机会. 如果你们能同时歼灭他的私人卫队，每支小队将获得 20% 的额外赏金.

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that a high ranking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} officer is moving in the open.  This is a rare opportunity to disrupt their command structure on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.  We'll pay a 33% bonus per lance if you can also destroy his personal guard and any other {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in the AO.
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}高级军官正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上打乱他们指挥结构的难得机会。如果你还能摧毁他的私人卫队以及行动区域内其他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，我们将按每支分队额外支付33%的奖金。

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.
column2: 我们已从多个渠道确认，一支由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱组织的首领正在公开活动. 这是一次难得的机会，可以消灭{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权的主要敌人之一. 此外，要是你能消灭目标人物的所有护卫，我们还会提供额外奖金.

column1: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们已从多个来源确认，一名由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组领袖正在公开行动。这是在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上除掉合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的所有护卫单位，我们将额外支付奖金。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We've had reports of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near one of our outlying bases. Unfortunately, we already have a military supply convoy in the field, and it will be easy prey for a force of 'Mechs. We need you to rendezvous with the convoy and protect it while it's being evacuated.
column2: 我们收到报告称我们的一座边远基地附近有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的活动. 不幸的是，我们有一支军用补给车队留在野外，很容易被机甲部队狩猎到. 我们需要你与车队会合，在撤离过程中保护它的安全.

column1: We've had reports of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near one of our outlying bases. Unfortunately, we already have a supply convoy in the field, and it will be easy prey for a force of 'Mechs. We need you to rendezvous with the convoy and protect it while it's being evacuated.
column2: 我们收到报告称我们的一座边远基地附近有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的活动. 不幸的是，我们有一支补给车队留在野外，很容易被机甲部队狩猎到. 我们需要你与车队会合，在撤离过程中保护它的安全.

column1: We've handled situations like this before, Commander, but I'd still advise caution. If they need a whole merc unit to take out one 'Mech, it must be a pretty serious 'Mech.
column2: 我们以前应付过类似的情况，指挥官，但我仍然要提醒你小心. 如果他们要求整支佣兵去消灭一部机甲，那这部机甲肯定很危险.

column1: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.
column2: 指挥官，我们刚刚失去了与一个设施的联系，需要你的帮助. 今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的设施接收到了一条他们认为是正常的数据传输. 但数据乱码很严重，当他们要求重发时，没有得到回应. 不久之后，基地系统开始故障，然后我们失去了与该基地及覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系. 我们希望你去调查这个设施.

column1: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。[警告：丧尸]

column1: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have constructed a forward base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, ignoring the express wishes of the local government. Naturally, the planetary governor is furious, but he can't make a stand against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs without assistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has offered that assistance. You are to seize control of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base and hold it until we gain a legal claim to the facility. We will then sell it back to the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} government at a considerable discount.
column2: 我们得知，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队无视了当地政府的意愿，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}建立了一座前沿基地. 显然，行星总督是火冒三丈，但他不能在没有援助的情况下对抗{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的战斗机甲; 而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}已经提供了那种援助. 你要控制并守住这个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，直到我们获得该设施的合法所有权. 之后我们将以一个合理的折价把这座设施卖还给{TGT_SYSTEM.name}政府.

column1: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been busy working on a new water filtration technology, which is both extremely valuable and likely to shift the balance of power in the region by opening up more worlds for colonization. We've discovered where they're working on the latest prototype. We know that they are monitoring the location of our own 'Mechs in the area, so we need a mercenary lance to make the vanguard assault and catch them by surprise. We'll then take over the facility with {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
column2: 我们得知{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在忙着搞一种新型滤水技术，这种技术非常有价值，能开辟更多的殖民星球，很可能改变该地区的实力平衡. 我们发现了他们搞最新原型的地方. 我们知道他们一直在监控我方机甲的位置，所以我们需要一支佣兵小队打头阵，打他们个出其不意. 之后我们会派{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}军队接管这座设施.

column1: We've located the secure facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} stores its payroll before distributing it to local forces. We believe we could put that payroll to better use. We'd like to hire you to hit the facility and steal the payroll. It will be well-defended, and there is a bonus if you eliminate all the defenders.
column2: 我们已经找到了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}存放军饷的安全设施，他们在把军饷发放给当地军队之前，会把它存在那里. 我们相信我们可以更好地利用这些军饷. 我们想雇佣你来袭击该设施并盗取军饷. 军饷将被严密防守，如果你消灭了所有守军，你将获得额外的奖励.

column1: We've lost three hidden supply bases on this ball of rock, Commander, and all three losses were thanks to one man, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be lightly defended but given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
column2: 指挥官，我们在这颗岩石星球上已损失三座秘密的补给基地，而这一切都归咎于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}那名专门追剿我方活动的机甲战士. 我们已经厌倦了任由他挑选战斗的时间和地点，所以希望你能在他巡逻时给他一个小小的“惊喜”. 他的防御力量不强，但考虑到他的多疑，很可能在附近埋伏了支援部队，所以小心遭到伏击.

column1: We've only got their word that this target is a terrorist, but that sort of extralegal maneuvering is why they're hiring us instead of using their own forces. Still, best to be alert for anything.
column2: 我们只能凭他们的口头声明得知这个目标是恐怖分子，但这种逾越法律的行为正是他们雇佣我们而不动用自己军队的原因. 总之，对任何状况最好都保持警惕.

column1: We've only got time to load 600 tons, but we know the enemy force will be limited as well.
column2: 我们只有时间装载 600 吨，但我们知道敌方兵力也有限.

column1: We've only got time to load six units, but we know the enemy force will be limited as well.
column2: 我们只有时间装载六个单位，但已知敌方兵力也会有限.

column1: We've received intel that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is reinforcing one of their key fortifications on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. If we allow them to do so, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} destabilization operations here will be set back by months, possibly years. We need you to intercept the supply convoy and redirect it to a waiting dropship, which will carry the supplies to our insurgent forces on the planet.
column2: 我们收到情报，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在加强他们位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处关键防御工事. 如果放任不管，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在这里的干扰行动将被推迟数月，甚至是数年. 我们需要你拦截一支补给车队，并且将其重新开往一艘正在等待的空投艇，这艘空投艇将载着物资送给我们在这颗星球上的起义军.

column1: We've received your message, and MIM operatives are on their way to reclaim our wounded agent. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Taurian and Liao military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect our agent, we suggest that you engage them there, away from the facility. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.
column2: 我们已收到你的消息，MIM特工正在前往接回我方受伤人员. 请注意我方远程传感器侦测到来自戴维恩家族和金牛人的军用空投艇正在前往你附近的作战区域. 为更好地保护我方人员，建议你在该空域实施拦截，使其远离设施. 我们会尽快派遣增援支援你们.

column1: We've received your message, and Maskirovka agents are on their way to take possession of the facility. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Davion and Taurian military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect the facility, we suggest that you engage them there. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.
column2: 我们已收到你的消息，欺敌局特工正在前往接管该设施. 请注意，我们的远程传感器检测到来自戴维恩家族和金牛人的军用空投艇正在前往你附近的作战区域. 为了更好地保护设施，建议你在该区域拦截. 我们会尽快派遣增援部队支援.

column1: We've received your message, and TMI agents are on their way to take possession of the facility. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Davion and Liao military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect the facility, we suggest that you engage them there. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.
column2: 我们已收到你的消息，TMI特工正在前往接管设施. 请注意，我方远程传感器侦测到戴维恩家族和廖氏家族的军用空投艇正在前往你附近的作战区域. 为了更好地保护设施，建议你在该空域实施拦截. 我们会尽快派出增援支援你们.

column1: We've recently discovered a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military outpost in an extremely inconvenient location, strangling trade and movement for our personnel in the area. Your mission: eliminate enemy defenses, then capture and hold the base long enough for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces to take possession. We'll support your action by drawing off some of the defenders ahead of time, so if these units retreat to the base, they'll already be weakened by our troops.
column2: 我们最近在一个极度偏僻的地点发现了一座{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军用哨所，它严重阻碍了我方人员在该地区的贸易和行动. 你的任务是: 消灭敌方防御力量，然后占领并守住该基地，直到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}军队接手. 我们将提前引开一些守军来支援你的行动，所以如果这些单位撤回基地的话，会是已被削弱的状态.

column1: We've seen a rise in the quantity of unregistered small arms on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. A heavily-armed population makes {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations more difficult. We've tracked the weapons back to a hidden smuggling base operated by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. That base needs to be destroyed.
column2: 我们注意到{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上未登记的小型武器数量正在增加. 武装程度高的民众会让{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动变得更加困难. 我们追踪了武器来源，查到了一处由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队运作的秘密走私基地. 该基地必须被摧毁.

column1: Weapons technicians, huh? Well, I suppose a rescue op is a rescue op, no matter who we're rescuing.
column2: 武器技术员? 好吧，无论救援对象是谁，救援行动就是救援行动.

column1: Welcome to Team Gladiator Combat, Mechwarrior. Duncan Fisher here where we are more interested in new sponsorship than a Mechwarrior's life. Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... 'cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的“解说一句倒一家公司“的本事。

Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的“解说一句倒一家公司“的本事。

Speaking of which this match has been brought to you by no one... cause the sponsors are all too afraid of my legendary ability to sink a company with my commentary.
column2: 欢迎来到团队角斗士对战，机甲战士。我是邓肯·费雪，在这里我们对新赞助的兴趣大过机甲战士的性命。说到这个，本场比赛的赞助方是——没有人……因为赞助商都太怕我那出了名的“解说一句倒一家公司“的本事。

column1: Welcome to my Tournament, Commander. Here you will prove your mettle against the Periphery's fiercest champions. Today, your MechWarriors will demonstrate their worth using only the simplest of tools: the UrbanMech. Like a huntsman's spear, it is an instrument with a single purpose. Wield it skillfully, and ascend into triumph.
column2: 欢迎来到我的锦标赛，指挥官。在此你将与外缘最凶悍的冠军们较量本事。今天，你的机师们将只用最简单的工具来证明自己的价值：城市机甲。它就像猎人的长矛，是一件只有单一用途的器具。娴熟地挥舞它，登上胜利之巅。

column1: Welcome to the final round of my Tournament, Commander. Today, your two finest pilots will face off against the cream of the Frontier MechWarrior community. This will be a battle like no other, a clash between veritable gods. I wish your fighters luck, Commander—and I promise you, they will need it.
column2: 欢迎来到我锦标赛的最后一轮，指挥官。今天，你最出色的两名机师将对阵边疆机甲战士社区的精英。这将是一场前所未有的战斗，一场名副其实的神明之间的碰撞。祝你的战士们好运，指挥官——我向你保证，他们会需要的。

column1: Well here it is a ComStar Base on Terra. We will need some heavy firepower for this one.
column2: 好吧，这里是地球上的一处康星基地。这一仗我们需要一些重型火力。

column1: Well we found the base, it is heavily guarded.
column2: 我们找到基地了，守卫森严。

column1: Well, I guess that makes sense.
column2: 好吧，我想这说得通.

column1: Well, I guess this one is unpaid work commander. The local government has taken a beating from the Pirate occupation force.
column2: 好吧，我想这次是无偿劳动了，指挥官。当地政府被海盗占领军打得够呛。

column1: Well, let's see if we can hold off Lady Suiko's geriatric MechWarriors.
column2: 好吧，让我们看看能不能挡住翠子夫人那群年迈的机甲战士.

column1: Well, looks like we're going to stop a disaster today instead of starting one, for a change.
column2: 好吧，看来今天我们是要阻止一场灾难，而不是引发一场，算是换换花样。

column1: Well, this is certainly one way to solve the problem. Luckily, we're not paid to weigh in on whether it's a smart way to solve it.
column2: 嗯，这当然也算是一种解决问题的方法. 幸运的是，我们拿钱办事，可不是来评判这是不是一种明智 的解决方式.

column1: Well, this just got interesting. Saddle up, {COMMANDER.FirstName}, we've got a prison to defend.
column2: 这下有意思了. 准备行动，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们得守住这座监狱.

column1: Well, this should be fun.
column2: 嗯，那肯定会很有趣.

column1: Well. This should be exciting.
column2: 好吧，这应该会很刺激.

column1: What a Charlie Foxtrot, Commander.
column2: 真是一团乱麻，指挥官。

column1: What do you think? Maybe we can get some of this good food and fine wine as part of the deal!
column2: 你觉得怎么样? 也许我们可以把这些美食和佳酿也作为协议的一部分!

column1: What the hell?!?!? They want us to fight a DropShip? With our 'Mechs? They have got to be kidding! Are they paying us enough for this?
column2: 我去，什么鬼?! 他们想让我们用机甲去对付一艘空投艇? 他们一定是在开玩笑吧! 他们给的钱够多吗?

column1: When I hear 'rapid' and 'immediate', I'm thinking 'no intel' and 'expect nasty surprises', Commander.
column2: 当我听到“迅速”和“立即”的时候，我想到的是“没有情报”和“预计会有讨厌的惊喜”，指挥官.

column1: When I hear 'rapid' and 'immediate', it makes me think 'no intel' and 'expect nasty surprises', Commander.
column2: 当我听到“迅速”和“立即”的时候，它让我想到的是“没有情报”和“预计会有讨厌的惊喜”，指挥官.

column1: When I hear 'unknown number of military units', I get nervous. This could be tough, Commander.
column2: 一听到“数量不明的军队”，我就紧张. 这可能会很棘手，指挥官.

column1: When Lady Helen gives Yamaguchi what he wants, we get paid. Let's get to it, Commander.
column2: 当海伦夫人把山口想要的东西给他时，我们就能拿到报酬. 行动吧，指挥官.

column1: Why are you looking at me that way? What'd I do?
column2: 你干嘛那样看着我? 我做错什么了?

column1: Why do pirates always think they need to be so clever about this stuff? This is a standard rescue op, Commander.
column2: 为什么海盗们总自以为自己聪明透顶? 这就是一次标准的救援行动，指挥官.

column1: Why the subterfuge? Why not just come out and say 'we want you to blow up a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance'? I don't understand pirates at all.
column2: 为什么要耍这些花招? 为什么不直接现身说“我们要你去打爆一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队”? 我真不明白海盗.

column1: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
column2: 为什么会有人给他们的目标一个警告?“职业道德”又是什么个鬼东西? 这很离奇.

column1: With Lord Gurung's bodyguard in ruins, we are clear to advance on the armory he's taking refuge in. When the building is ours, I will deal with the man personally. He will pay for what his hirelings have done to my family.
column2: 随着古隆领主的护卫部队覆灭. 现在我们可以推进到他藏身的军械库了. 夺取建筑后，我将亲自处置他. 他必须为雇佣兵对我家族的所作所为付出代价.

column1: With any luck we won't have to do much more than confirm kills, easy money, Commander.
column2: 运气好的话，我们差不多只需要补枪确认击杀就够了，指挥官，这钱赚得轻松.

column1: With our beachhead secured, it is time to start moving against the Capellans here on Kern. There are multiple potential targets in the area, but before we discuss them, we need to clear the field. Our technicians have extracted the force deployment data from the base computers, and we know that there are two heavy lances of 'Mechs on patrol right now, somewhere on the other side of the river. You'll get in by Leopard and sweep the woods; eliminate any Capellan units you uncover.
column2: 我们的桥头堡就位，现在我们必须对克恩的卡佩拉人采取行动. 在这个区域有几个潜在的目标，但在我们谈论它们之前，我们需要清除战场. 我们的技术人员从基地计算机中提取了武装部队的部署命令. 我们现在知道，两支重型机甲正在河对岸的某个地方巡逻. 豹子会让你掉，这样你就可以梳理森林区域. 消除您跟踪的所有卡佩拉单位.

column1: With such light resistance, I figured you would get here pretty quickly. The pirate's forward base is up ahead and I need it captured so I can retrieve any information about their motives. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 抵抗这么弱，我猜你很快就到了。海盗的前沿基地就在前方，我需要它被夺取，好让我取回任何关于他们动机的信息。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: With the LRM Stalker down, you should be clear to rendezvous with Tempest's convoy. Escort the vehicles to the pickup point, and get them there in one piece. All other considerations are secondary.
column2: 现在，LRM“潜行者”已被摧毁，你们应前往与坦佩斯特的车队汇合. 护送车辆至撤离点，确保全员安全抵达. 其他一切都是次要的.

column1: Within the last three months, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has struck our facilities, personnel, and supply convoys over half a dozen times. My superiors in the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} leadership would like to even the score. We'd like to hire you to find a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it, to demonstrate we are not without military resources on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 在过去三个月里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}袭击了我们的设施、人员与补给车队超过六次。我在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}领导层的上级希望扳平比分。我们想雇你找到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队并将其摧毁，以表明我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上并非没有军事资源。[警告：丧尸]

column1: Witness-in-protection? Lost contact? I think we all know how this might turn out. Let's go in with our eyes open, Commander.
column2: 受保护证人? 失联? 我想咱们都知道这可能会是什么结果. 指挥官，咱们睁大眼睛进去吧.

column1: Yang's been filling me in about Song, Commander. He says they're supposed to be the best shot in the entire CCAF. We're going to be lucky to get out of this one without serious losses.
column2: 杨给我讲了一些关于宋的事情，指挥官. 卡佩拉武装部队中的任何人都无法与这位中校相提并论. 如果我们能在没有重大损失的情况下离开这里，我们就很幸运了.

column1: Yang's been filling me in about this Maurice person, Commander. He says the mech signature reads like nothing he's ever seen, but the piloting appears wonky and unconfident. Be aware of any supporting forces, they may pose the real threat.
column2: 杨一直在跟我讲这个叫莫里斯的人，指挥官。他说那台机甲的信号特征是他从没见过的，但驾驶手法看起来别扭而缺乏自信。留意任何支援部队，他们可能才是真正的威胁。

column1: You Did What!
column2: 你做了什么!

column1: You are cordially invited to partake in COCKPIT-VENTING, MECH-CRUSHING, FACE-BREAKING gladiatorial combat action. Should you be victorious, you can expect a handsome payout and a variety of salvage perks. And of course, the coveted love from millions of our fans.
column2: 诚邀你参加驾驶舱弹射、机甲碾压、面部粉碎的角斗战斗。若你获胜，可期待一笔可观的报酬和各式打捞福利。当然，还有数百万粉丝的渴慕之爱。

column1: You dare take up arms against the Galedon Regulars?! Your hubris will destroy you, mercenary dog—and I will personally put your broken corpse into the ground!
column2: 你竟敢对加勒登正规军举兵？！你的狂妄会毁了你，雇佣兵野狗——而我会亲手把你那具破碎的尸体埋进土里！

column1: You don't hire mercenaries on a whim. They know there's an attack incoming, and we're going to absorb it. Thankfully, all we need to do is hold out.
column2: 你不能一时兴起雇佣佣兵. 他们知道会有攻击来临，而且要承受它. 谢天谢地，我们需要做的就是坚守.

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challange League'. Your opponent is expecting you.
column2: 你受邀参加“角斗士挑战联赛”的分区轮次。你的对手正等着你。

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challange'. The opponent should be ready for you.
column2: 你已被邀请参加“角斗士挑战赛“的分区轮。对手应该已经准备好迎战你了。

column1: You have been invited to a Divisional Round in the 'Gladiator Challenge'. The opponent should be ready for you.
column2: 你已被邀请参加“角斗士挑战“的分区轮。对手应该已做好准备。

column1: You have been invited to the Gladiator Challenge Divisionals. The opponent should be ready for you. Now, we want an honest fight from you with nothing below the belt. Eyes front and claws out.
column2: 你已被邀请参加角斗士挑战赛分区赛。对手应该已经准备好迎战你了。现在，我们希望你打一场干净的对决，不打阴招。目视前方，利爪亮出。

column1: You have been invited to the Gladiator Challenge Divisionals. We want a good, honest asskicking from you and no shots below the belt. Your opponent awaits your challenge.
column2: 你已被邀请参加角斗士挑战赛分区赛。我们希望你打一场干净利落、堂堂正正的痛击，不打阴招。你的对手等着你的挑战。

column1: You heard Lady Suiko. Let's put Luthendorff down, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 听到翠子夫人的话了吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 我们去把卢森道夫解决掉.

column1: You heard her. Let's go make ourselves useful.
column2: 你听到她的话了. 咱们去派上点用场吧.

column1: You heard the man, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. This deployment is just setup for a larger fight to come, so try not to get too beat up out there.
column2: 你听到他说的了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这个任务只是一场更大的战斗的第一部分，所以尽量别在外面伤得太重.

column1: You heard the man. Hold the base and take out all comers.
column2: 你听到他说的了. 守住基地并消灭所有来犯之敌.

column1: You heard the man. Let's get this job done.
column2: 你听到他说的了. 让我们把这事搞定.

column1: You heard the man. Let's go make ourselves useful.
column2: 你听到他说的了. 走吧，让我们发挥点作用.

column1: You heard those scare quotes didn't you boss? Civilian Liaison means Spec Ops. They're in a rush so I got them to promise a few crates of ammo would 'fall off the truck' as a bonus.
column2: 老大，你也听出那话里打的引号了吧? 所谓“平民联络队”，就是特种作战部队. 他们急着办事，所以我让他们答应，会有几箱弹药“不小心从卡车上掉下来”，算是给我们的额外报酬.

column1: You heard what Lees did on Shaul Khala. The galaxy will be a better place without a man like him in it.
column2: 你已听闻利斯在绍尔哈拉的暴行. 这个星系少了他这样的恶徒只会更加安宁.

column1: You know the drill, Commander. Get in there, take down the strike team, and rescue Gwydion Company. I'll call out targets for you as I see 'em.
column2: 你懂流程，指挥官。进去，干掉打击队，救出格威迪恩连。我看到目标就给你报点。

column1: You mean I can just type anything here and Darius will say it?
column2: 你是说我在这里随便打什么，达里乌斯就会照说？

column1: You need to protect the Mobile Field Emplacement, Commander. The enemy has marked it for destruction.
column2: 指挥官，您必须保护那座机动野战炮台，敌人已将其列为摧毁目标.

column1: You will need to fight through to get to the base we talked about. They have it guarded pretty decently.
column2: 你得一路打过去才能抵达我们谈过的那座基地。他们守得相当严密。

column1: You won't like this, but Tubbs is signaling for a rescue. Talk about choosing beggars. He is currently up to his ass in debt, and our Solaris reps want him off planet alive. We are to pick him up and then turn him over to local authorities for processing.
column2: 你不会喜欢这个，但塔布斯正在发信号求救。真是会挑人。他目前深陷债务，而我们的索拉里斯代表要他活着离开这颗星球。我们要去接他，然后把他交给当地当局处置。

column1: You'll find my brother waiting for you at the Red Roost. It looks like a commercial office park, but don't be fooled. The structure is reinforced to withstand military payloads. Engage my brother's security team and raze the Red Roost. Let his stronghold serve as his tomb!
column2: 你会发现我兄弟在“红栖”等着你. 那地方看似一片商业园区，可别被外表骗了. 其建筑结构经过加固，足以承受军用荷载. 与我兄弟的安保小队交战，把“红栖”夷平. 就让他那堡垒充当他的坟墓！

column1: You'll find the Davion munitions factory at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Take it from them, that it may serve as the bait for the trap that I'm paying you to set.
column2: 你会在我标出的坐标找到戴维恩军工厂，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 夺取它——这将作为我付钱设下陷阱的诱饵.

column1: You'll find the Pirates Forward Base at the coordinates I've outlined, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Make sure to crush them... to make an example of course.
column2: 你会在标出的坐标找到海盗前沿基地，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。务必碾碎他们……当然，是为了以儆效尤。

column1: You're over the halfway point now, Commander. You're also pulling exceptional ratings, which means you've got a one-way ticket to the Solaris City arena for the rest of your matches! Don't disappoint and you'll be rolling in cash in no time!
column2: 你已经过了一半路程，指挥官。而且你拿到了卓越评级，这意味着你余下的比赛都拿到了通往索拉里斯城竞技场的单程票！别让人失望，你很快就能财源滚滚！

column1: You've chosen to complete your contract, to satisfy your obligation to House Kurita. Good. On my honor, you will receive your pay when Okada is dead—and not a moment before.
column2: 你选择了完成合约，履行你对栗田家族的义务。很好。以我的荣誉起誓，冈田死后你才会拿到报酬——一秒钟都不会早。

column1: You've done well to get this far, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, but it looks like the gloves are off. At this point a lot of the chaff has been discarded. Give us a good show!
column2: 能走到这一步你干得不错，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，但看来现在不再留手了。到这一步，很多杂鱼都已被淘汰。给我们一场好戏！

column1: You've done well to get this far, Commander. It's a fresh day, the arena is prepped, and the turnout is massive! Unsurprisingly, your opponent is one of the best Mechjocks around, in a nasty piece of work 'Mech. Good luck!
column2: 能走到这一步你干得不错，指挥官。这是崭新的一天，竞技场已准备就绪，而观众爆满！不出所料，你的对手是周围最顶尖的机师之一，驾驶着一台棘手的机甲。祝好运！

column1: Your challenger has a reputation for dishonest tactics. Watch yourself out there, Commander.
column2: 你的挑战者以手段不光彩而闻名。在外面多留神，指挥官。

column1: Your directive is simple: fight your way through the AI's lines and eventually, locate their forward base. Then ruin it all.
column2: 你的指令很简单：杀穿AI的防线，最终找到他们的前沿基地。然后把它彻底毁掉。

column1: Your lance will be dropping directly in the path of Yoshito Okada's convoy. Smash it flat—there can be no survivors. When the defector's death has been confirmed, you will receive your reward.
column2: 你的分队将直接降落在冈田义人的车队路线上。把它彻底砸平——不能有幸存者。叛逃者的死亡得到确认后，你就会收到报酬。

column1: Your mission requires you to act as our can opener. We are preparing to punch a hole into the installation to see what's inside and your lance will provide the targeting data.
column2: 你的任务要求你充当我们的开罐器。我们正准备在该设施上打出一个洞看看里面有什么，而你的分队将提供瞄准数据。

column1: Your next objective is in Jessup Downs, on the far side of Gauthier. Your point of contact, a former militia member and paroled felon who operates under the callsign \"Jailbird,\" has been holding the Downs with no outside support for nearly a month. She has reported signs of a heavy Steiner patrol lance moving through the area. I need you to assist her in bringing down that patrol.
column2: 你的下一个目标位于高蒂尔另一端的Jessup Downs. 你的联络人——一名曾为民兵、已获假释的犯人，呼号“监狱鸟”——已在该镇坚守近一个月，未得到外部支援. 她报告发现一支施泰纳重型巡逻小队在该地带活动. 我需要你协助她将那支巡逻队歼灭.

column1: Zeta Lance moved Captain Magorian out of Alamedo Province two days ago. They're holding him in a bunker somewhere under the ruins of New Vulci, a city that fell victim to a nuclear accident in 2977. Engage Zeta Lance and destroy their 'Mechs. When you're finished, I'll scour their combat computers for the bunker's coordinates.
column2: 两天前，Zeta小队将马格里安船长从阿拉米多省转移了出来. 他们把他关押在新武尔奇废墟下的某处地堡中——这座城市在2977年遭受过核事故. 与Zeta小队交战并摧毁他们的机甲. 完成后，我会从他们的作战计算机中查找地堡的坐标.

column1: \"Former militia member and paroled felon.\" I think I'm getting why Cheval doesn't trust her.
column2: 前民兵队员，假释期罪犯……我有点明白“骑士”为何不信任她了.

column1: \"His honor,\" my ass. Let's just get this done, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
column2: 狗屁荣誉. 赶紧完事吧，{COMMANDER.FirstName}.

column1: {COMMANDER.FirstName}, time to remove some Pirates from this planet.
column2: {COMMANDER.FirstName}，是时候把一些海盗从这颗行星上清除了。

column1: {COMMANDER.LastName}, We will be dropping in hot near a ComStar operations base. We will be disrupting their communications while the clan leaders gather.
column2: {COMMANDER.LastName}，我们将在通讯之星一处作战基地附近热投。趁部族首领们聚集时，我们将破坏他们的通讯。

column1: {COMMANDER.LastName}, you're being asked to take control of a data storage facility under local government jurisdiction. This mission should be straightforward enough. Payment will be supplied as per standard procedures. Good hunting.
column2: {COMMANDER.LastName}，你被要求夺取一处受当地政府管辖的数据存储设施。这次任务应该相当直接。报酬将按标准程序发放。祝狩猎顺利。

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.CapitalizedName} has heard rumors that over the coming weeks, one of their foes plans to launch a raid against {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, aiming to catch the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders off guard before they can properly mobilize. They've put out a call for mercenary commands like ours to supplement their forces.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.CapitalizedName}听闻有传言称，未来数周内，其敌对势力计划对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}发动突袭，意图在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}守军完成充分动员前将其打个措手不及. 为此，他们已公开发出征召令，招募像我们这样的佣兵部队来增援其兵力.

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.CapitalizedName} has heard rumors that over the coming weeks, one of their foes plans to launch an offensive against {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, aiming to catch the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders off guard before they can properly mobilize. They've put out a call for mercenary commands like ours to supplement their forces.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.CapitalizedName}听闻有传言称，未来数周内，其敌对势力计划对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}发动攻势，意图在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}守军完成充分动员前将其打个措手不及. 为此，他们已公开发出征召令，招募像我们这样的佣兵部队来增援其兵力.

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has requested we field test a new pilot from their Alpha Sibko. {COMPANY.CompanyName} has been a valuable ally and we would like our new generation to pick up some skills. Don't hold back, the pilot is going to be putting everything they learned into this fight. The Clan wants to teach some real life lessons to them, and their Sibko.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}请求我们对来自其Alpha Sibko的一名新机师进行实战测试. {COMPANY.CompanyName}一直是宝贵的盟友，我们希望我们的新一代能学到一些技能. 不必手下留情，这名机师将全力以赴投入战斗. 氏族想要给他们及其Sibko上一堂真正的实战课.

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are not the only ones interested in this lance.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队并非唯一对该小队感兴趣的一方.

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been hitting {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} bases the past few days. All signs point to this base being next. We've been asked to defend the base long enough to evacuate its occupants.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队近几天一直在袭击{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地。种种迹象都表明下一处就是这里。我们被要求守住该基地足够久，以便撤离其人员。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have identified the location of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s forward operating base. Friendly elements are preparing to withdraw, but enemy units are rapidly closing in. We are tasked with providing support to delay the enemy's advance. They'll need escorting out while under fire, so be prepared to split our forces.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已定位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}前进作战基地的位置。友军单位正准备撤退，但敌军部队正迅速逼近。我们的任务是提供支援以拖延敌军推进。他们需要在火力下被护送撤离，所以要做好分兵准备。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has attacked our Employer's forces. They seem particularly interested in one specific lance. It may be a vendetta, or they may just be after certain technology. Whatever the case, we need to defend the lance at all costs.
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}攻击了我方雇主的部队. 他们似乎对某一特定小队特别感兴趣. 这可能是私人恩怨，也可能只是为了夺取某种技术. 无论如何，我们必须不惜一切代价保护该小队.

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has an ongoing rotation of public Mech games taking place like usual. The Battle Royale is a brawl that pits 6 warriors against each other with the last one standing as the winner. Allegiances are born and die with the shift in the wind during these fights so expect anything, Commander. This circuit is for the Assault Mech class. Go out there and show these gladiators what mercs are capable of!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}像往常一样，正在进行轮换的公众机甲比赛. 大逃杀是一场近战，让 6 名战士互相对抗，最后站着的就是赢家. 在这些战斗中，联盟会随着风向的转变而诞生和消亡，所以要做好应对任何情况的准备，指挥官. 本次巡回赛是袭击型机甲级别的. 去那里向这些角斗士展示雇佣兵的实力吧!

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been challenged to a Trial of Possession by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}. We would like you to represent us in this Trial, as all our troops are involved elsewhere. If you lose, we will just deny it was ever agreed to, or that you weren't representing us.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}挑战进行一场所有权试炼. 我们希望你能代表我们参加这场试炼，因为我们所有的部队都另有任务. 如果你输了，我们只需否认曾达成过协议，或否认你当时是在代表我们即可.

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is hosting a bit of a rumble between a variety of local government militias. Apparently there's a lot of bad blood between the local militias and they're finally having it out in a major 6-way throwdown. Our employer wants us to step in on their behalf and show these local yokels how it's really done. Some of them might be on our side at first but allegiances will change rapidly as the situation evolves, keep an eye on things down there, Commander.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}正在举办一场由多个地方政府民兵组织参与的大近战. 显然，这些当地民兵之间积怨已久，他们终于要以一场六方大近战来一决高下. 我们的雇主希望我们代表他们介入，让这些乡巴佬见识一下真正的战斗是怎么打的. 其中一些人一开始可能会站在我们这边，但随着战局发展，阵营会迅速变化，密切关注下面的情况，指挥官.

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} seems so insignificant. Why are there so many fighting over it?
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}看起来如此不起眼. 为什么会有这么多人争夺它?

column1: A soon-to-be-operational planetary sensor array and a missile defense battery will form the backbone of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regional defense operations.  The two facilities are linked through a common targeting network, and the destruction of either asset will compromise the effectiveness of the entire system, once operational.\n\r\n{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} units are expected to probe defenses before committing heavier assault forces against whichever site appears weakest.  The governor's office has declared both installations mission-critical.
column2: 一座即将投入使用的行星传感器阵列与一座导弹防御炮台，将构成{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域防御体系的骨干。两处设施通过统一的制导网络相连，一旦投入使用，任何一处被毁都会让整个系统失效。\n\r\n预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队会先试探防御，再集中重兵攻击看起来较弱的一侧。总督办公室已宣布两处设施均为任务关键目标。

column1: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to an Union-class DropShip having recently landed and beginning to deploy its cargo. We need someone to go in and destroy the entire operation including the Union itself. Bring your A-Game, Commander, Unions aren't easy targets.\n\n THIS CONTRACT IS QUITE DIFFICULT, UNIONS ARE NOT EASY TARGETS. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}侦察队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}地表探测到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一艘刚着陆、正在卸载货物的联盟级运输舰。我们需要有人杀进去，把整个行动连同那艘联盟级一起摧毁。拿出你的全力，指挥官——联盟级可不好打。\n\n 这份合约相当困难，联盟级不是好对付的目标。已经警告过你了。

column1:
A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to an Overlord-class DropShip on final approach to the surface of the planet to deploy its complement of 'Mechs. We need someone to go in and destroy the entire operation including the Overlord itself. Bring your absolute level best, Commander... Overlords are very hard targets. \n\nTHIS CONTRACT IS VERY DIFFICULT, OVERLORDS ARE NOT EASY TARGETS, BRING YOUR BEST.

IF YOU BRING TANKS TO THIS MISSION THEY CAN BUG OUT ON CONTRACT COMPLETION AND YOU MIGHT LOSE THEM PERMANENTLY. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.
column2:
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}侦察队探测到{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}传来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一艘正在最后进近、准备投送其机甲编队的霸王级运输舰。我们需要有人杀进去，把整个行动连同那艘霸王级一起摧毁。拿出你绝对的巅峰水准，指挥官……霸王级是非常难打的目标。\n\n这份合约非常困难，霸王级不是好对付的目标，拿出你的最强实力。

如果你带坦克执行此任务，它们会在合约完成时撤离，你可能会永久失去它们。已经警告过你了。

column1: All right, we're going to be using the transponder on a single 'Mech with the whole purpose of getting my friend's men out. In and out then let ComStar clean up the mess.
column2: 好，我们要用一台机甲的应答器，只为把我朋友的人救出来。进去再出来，剩下的烂摊子交给通讯之星收拾。

column1: Alright, Commander. I'd like to give this data collection mission a try. We have a small group of pirates and I'll ambush them. I need you as my eyes in the sky. You direct the fire and I'll bring it down.
column2: 好的，指挥官。我想试试这次数据收集任务。我们对付一小股海盗，由我来伏击他们。需要你当我在天上的眼睛——你指引火力，我来落下。

column1: Always wanted to be a MechCommander.
column2: 一直想当个机甲指挥官。

column1: An ordnance plant and its associated munitions depot have come under threat from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces seeking to cripple local {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} military production.  While each facility can function independently, the loss of either would halt wartime manufacturing efforts across the region.\n\r\n{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} intelligence suggests coordinated attacks intended to split defending forces between the two objectives.  Your company must maintain defensive control over both locations simultaneously throughout the operation.
column2: 一座军械厂及其附属弹药库正受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队威胁，他们企图瘫痪当地{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的军工生产。虽然两处设施各自都能独立运转，但失去任何一处都会让整个区域的战时生产停摆。\n\r\n{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}情报显示敌方将发动协同攻击，意图把守军分散到两个目标上。你的部队必须在整个行动中同时守住两处。

column1: Commander, It seems our employer has been cornered in. We may have to get them out of there hiding spot before we talk to them.
column2: 指挥官，看来我们的雇主被围住了。在跟他们谈之前，我们可能得先把他们从藏身处救出来。

column1: Commander, a battalion sporting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s colors are operating covertly in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Your mission: draw their focus, hold them in place while we close their escape. Disrupt, disable, and buy us time --- extraction to follow. We will send an allied force to support your evac as soon as you draw enough enemy attention.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 指挥官，一支打着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}旗号的营正在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}秘密行动。你的任务：吸引他们的注意力，拖住他们，好让我们封锁退路。扰乱、瘫痪、为我们争取时间——之后安排撤离。等你吸引到足够多敌军注意，我们会派一支友军支援你的撤离。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again - without asking too many questions. There's a bonus if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's at your discretion.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 指挥官，这事透着政治味道，让我很不安。我建议进去、解决车队、再撤出来——别多问。清光所有敌军有额外奖金，但那由你决定。[警告：僵尸]

column1: Commander, we need you in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system immediately. We lost contact with one of the minor royals of the region - Henriette Bosh. They frequently bombard us with a constant stream of requests yet, since some time, we haven't heard from them.\n\nPlease check on them and report back to us.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你立刻赶到{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系。我们与该地区的一位小贵族亨丽埃特·博什失去了联系。他们平时总是一刻不停地向我们提各种请求，可最近一段时间我们却再没收到他们的消息。\n\n请去查看情况，然后回报我们。

column1: Commander, we need you to confirm the status of a supply cache in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system that we established in case we need to execute local operations. Your company will run a patrol through the region, passing by the dumps and establishing communications by tightbeam only.\n\nDo not attempt to contact the cache by radio and maintain a low profile, discretion is paramount on this operation.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你确认{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系一处补给藏匿点的状况——那是我们为执行当地行动而设立的。你的部队将在该区域巡逻，途经这些藏匿点，并且只能用定向波束建立通讯。\n\n不要试图用无线电联系藏匿点，保持低调，这次行动中谨慎是第一位的。

column1: During a local battle reenactment, a large force wearing {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} colors unexpectedly landed and disrupted the event. We've now been tasked with defending the settlement using the fully immersive --- and actually functional --- bases. Fortunately, the actors are equipped with real working units instead of props...which might explain why this reenactment is so realistic and attracts such a big crowd. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 在一次当地战斗重演中，一支打着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}旗号的大部队意外降落，打断了活动。我们现在奉命用那些完全沉浸式——而且真的能用——的基地来防守定居点。 幸运的是，演员们装备的是真家伙而非道具……这或许能解释为什么这场重演如此逼真，还能吸引这么多观众。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: Even though we've had some wins in other parts of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} region, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s stepping up their game. Right now, several units have arrived at {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and it's looking like it might fall into their hands. Your job is to back up the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s lance and hold the line for as long as you can. Reinforcements are on the way, but we need to buy some time.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 尽管我们在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}区域其他地方取得了一些胜利，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}却在加大力度。眼下已有数支部队抵达{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}，看来那里有可能落入他们手中。你的任务是支援{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的小队，尽可能久地守住防线。援军正在赶来，但我们需要争取一些时间。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: Fierce fighting has erupted in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and our defenses won't hold without immediate support. We're contracting anyone who can get boots on the ground now.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}爆发了激烈战斗，没有立即支援我们的防线就守不住。我们正在雇佣任何能立刻把人送上地面的队伍。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: Good showing so far, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Our early matches tend to have the lowest turnout, but don't let that dissuade you\n\nYour next match is against one of our underdogs. They're a regular, but never seem to strike it big. Good luck!
column2: 目前表现不错，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官。我们的早期比赛观众通常最少，但别因此泄气\n\n你的下一场对手是我们的一位陪跑选手。他是常客，却似乎总也打不出名堂。祝你好运！

column1: Great work everyone. Let's make the universe a better place.
column2: 大家干得好。让我们把这个宇宙变得更好。

column1: Hold of the pirates while we secure the assets here.
column2: 拖住海盗，我们好在这里夺取物资。

column1: I am AI
column2: 我是 AI

column1: If these guys are that expendable, this just might be easy. Expect dirty tricks, Commander.
column2: 如果这些家伙真这么无足轻重，那这次或许很轻松。提防阴招，指挥官。

column1: Lay on Hands
column2: 圣手回春

column1: Looks like the Pirates have brought in the 5th fleet commander.
column2: 看来海盗把第五舰队指挥官都请来了。

column1: May want to leave this planet alone after this.
column2: 这之后你大概会想离这颗星球远一点。

column1: Nothing fancy, go get our pilot back. Drop light, go fast. No one is paying us to grind dozens of mechs into dust.
column2: 别搞花的，去把我们的飞行员救回来。轻装降落，速战速决。没人花钱请我们把几十台机甲碾成灰。

column1: Obviously, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} are paying us well in salvage. Let's stop that convoy from escaping and get out.
column2: 显然，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在打捞分成上给得很痛快。别让那支车队跑了，然后撤。

column1: Our employer has been cooking up some extremely questionable science. Unfortunately, they forgot one tiny detail: they don't actually have permission to do any of it here. Despite repeated calls by the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities, they kept right on bubbling their beakers and poking their mysterious gizmos. Now, they're being evicted forcefully. Our mission? Give them a little breathing room to grab all their scientific doohickeys, pack up their suspiciously dubious supplies, and evacuate the place.
column2: 我们的雇主一直在搞些科学性极其可疑的东西。可惜他们忘了一个小细节：他们在这儿其实根本没得到任何许可。 尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局一再上门，他们照样烧着烧杯、戳着那些神秘小玩意儿。现在，人家要来强制清场了。 我们的任务？给他们腾出点空间，好把那些科学小装置统统带走、打包好那些来路可疑的物资，然后撤离此地。

column1: Our source has been moved to a secure location, at least according to the Local Government here on Staffin. We are going to do an old fashioned Prison Break. Take down the base and then get Shifty Mcshadeson. So he can let us know how to save my friend's men.(Darius Notes: wait that's his name, who wrote this?!?)
column2: 据斯塔芬当地政府说，我们的线人已被转移到安全地点。我们要来一场老派的劫狱。先端掉基地，再救出“滑头墨镜佬”，这样他就能告诉我们怎么救出我朋友的人。（达里乌斯批注：等等，这是他的名字？这剧本谁写的？！）

column1: Recent clashes between the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s and the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s respective forces have drained our employer's resources, forcing them into a retreat. The remaining bases are serving as final holdouts, intended to inflict as much damage as possible on {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} before pulling out of the area. The employer doesn't expect us to wipe out all attacking forces, but they do want to send a clear message: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will return stronger and reclaim the territory they've lost. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}双方近期的冲突耗尽了雇主的资源，迫使他们撤退。剩余基地成了最后的据点，打算在撤出该地区前尽可能重创{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}。 雇主并不指望我们全歼进攻部队，但他们想传达一个明确的信号：{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会以更强的姿态回归，重新夺回失去的领地。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: Seems the Pirates are after something here. And they have come in full force.
column2: 看来海盗是冲着这里的东西来的，而且全员出动。

column1: Sounds like a trap to me.
column2: 这在我看来像个陷阱。

column1: Specialized Pilot?
column2: 专业飞行员？

column1: Sumire's suggestion worked, and we have a chance to shut this planet down for good, as well as retrieve my friend's Merc Group. This is what it feels like to be a big damn hero, Commander.
column2: 苏米尔的建议奏效了，我们有机会彻底端掉这颗星球，还能救回我朋友的佣兵团。指挥官，这就是当个大英雄的感觉。

column1: The Black Market exchange on Tiverton's moon is hiding a powerful sensor array. We're approach under the guise of making a deal and Sumire will drop our Lance just outside the perimeter. Destroy the facility's structures to disable their long-range sensors. The base is likely to be guarded; destroy the units guarding it and there's a bonus in it for you.
column2: 蒂弗顿卫星上的黑市交易所藏着一座强力传感器阵列。我们假装前去交易，苏米尔会把我们的小队投放到外围。摧毁设施建筑以瘫痪他们的远程传感器。基地多半有守卫；干掉守卫还有额外奖金。

column1: The Muscle is the primary target. This is the last of the cabal's power on Tiverton. They're fighting for keeps, best to be alert for anything.
column2: “肌肉”是首要目标。这是密会在蒂弗顿最后的势力。他们是在拼命，最好对任何情况都保持警觉。

column1: The Muscle is throwing his finest at us. Expect very heavy resistance and unconventional elite units. This is their last stand on Tiverton. We can't let the people here down now.
column2: “肌肉”把他最强的手下都派出来了。预计会遇到极顽强的抵抗和非常规的精锐单位。这是他们在蒂弗顿的最后一战。我们绝不能让这里的人失望。

column1: The time-frame on this is tight, since we need the beacons placed before the Q-Ship is passing overhead. And Commander, I wouldn't try and take them all on this time.
column2: 这次时间很紧，我们得赶在 Q-Ship 从上空经过之前把信标放好。还有，指挥官，这次我可不建议你跟他们硬碰硬。

column1: There is a small {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that has been attacked by raiders.  Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power.  We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale.\n\r\nWe'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地遭到袭击者攻击。他们最近一次进攻的组织性和装备水平都远超以往，说明袭击者正从某个敌对势力获得后勤与战术支援。那样的规模再来一次，我们恐怕顶不住。\n\r\n我们想雇你提供额外防御支援。

column1: There is an old Kuritan theory of warfare that says that numbers matter more than skill. Our enemies here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} have decided to put that theory to the test and have lined up a swarm of BattleMechs to attack us. We need a few elite pilots to hold off the swarm as best we can. We'll send you what help we can manage. Prove the theory wrong and be on the right side of history, Commander.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: 库里塔有一种古老的战争理论，说数量比技巧更重要。我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的敌人决定验证这套理论，已经集结了一大群战斗机甲来攻击我们。我们需要几位精锐飞行员尽量拖住这支大军。我们会尽力给你支援。证明这套理论是错的，站在历史正确的一边，指挥官。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: This is going to be a hard fight against the enemy's best. Keep your eyes open for traps.
column2: 这将是一场对抗敌方精锐的硬仗。睁大眼睛提防陷阱。

column1: This seems risky, Commander. If things get out of hand, remember you can just blow up the buildings and make a run for it.
column2: 这看起来很冒险，指挥官。如果局面失控，记住你随时可以炸掉那些建筑然后跑路。

column1: Two cargo terminals are being operated by the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} in the system.  Cargo operations have been divided between both terminals, if either terminal is destroyed, precious supply and logisticical assets would be lost.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders are exepcted to launch repeated attacks intended to disable loading infrastructure and fuel depots.\n\r\nBoth facilities must reamin operational until reinforcements arrive.
column2: 该星系内有两座由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government}运营的货运终端。货运业务分由两座终端承担，任何一座被毁都会损失宝贵的补给与后勤资产。预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}袭击者会反复发起进攻，企图瘫痪装卸设施和燃料库。\n\r\n两处设施都必须在援军抵达前保持运转。

column1: Two power stations provide the energy required to sustain a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilian complex.  {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} forces have launched a campaign to seize or destroy the installations, knowing the loss of either station would destabilize the entire power grid.\n\r\nYour orders are straightforward: both power stations must survive the engagement intact.
column2: 两座发电站为一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}民用综合体提供能源。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}部队已发动攻势，企图夺取或摧毁这些设施，他们清楚任何一座失守都会让整个电网失衡。\n\r\n你的命令很明确：两座发电站都必须在战斗中完好存活。

column1: Two water purification plants supply separate population centers and are considered vital to planetary stability.  {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} intelligence indicates {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders intends to overwhelm both facilities, forcing defenders to spread thin.\n\r\nYour contract is explicit: both facilities must remain operational until relief forces arrive.
column2: 两座净水厂分别供应不同的人口中心，被视为行星稳定的关键。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}情报显示，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}袭击者打算同时压上两处设施，迫使守军兵力分散。\n\r\n你的合约写得很清楚：两处设施都必须在援军抵达前保持运转。

column1: Wallo's got a mercenary company on retainer to protect his private aerospace hangar, the imaginatively named \"Security Solutions, Inc.\" I looked 'em up, and they're the real deal—they've got combat vehicles, BattleMechs, the works. But we'll have the element of surprise on our side, given that Wallo's never heard of us. That's something, right?
column2: 瓦洛雇了一支佣兵团驻守他的私人航空机库，名字起得很有想象力——\"安全解决方案公司\"。我查过他们，是货真价实的狠角色：有战斗载具、战斗机甲，一应俱全。不过我们占着出其不意这一条，毕竟瓦洛从没听说过我们。也算个优势，对吧？

column1: We are engaged in delicate negotiations with a private manufacturer from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} space, but we have reached an impasse. Our representative has requested a demonstration. \"Something dramatic,\" she said. So we turn to you. Your team will provide on-site assistance to target an abandoned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base near the trade conference. We'll have a WarShip standing by to light it up… dramatically.
column2: 我们正与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}境内一家私人制造商进行微妙谈判，但已陷入僵局。我方代表要求来一场演示——\"要够有戏剧性\"，原话。于是我们找上了你。你的队伍将为贸易会议附近一处废弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地提供实地目标标定。我们会备好一艘军舰，把它\"戏剧性地\"点亮……

column1: We are going to use that Q-Ship's Long Toms to destroy the Black Market rally point. They will need assistance targeting the installation during their sub-orbital pass. Place the targeting beacons and disable the anti-air turrets so Sumire can get you out of there. Their's limited time-frame for this and a lot of moving parts. Bring something fast, but tough.
column2: 我们要用那艘 Q-Ship 的长汤姆炮摧毁黑市集结点。它们将在亚轨道掠过时锁定设施，需要有人协助。放好制导信标、瘫痪防空炮塔，好让苏米尔把你接出去。这次时间有限，变数很多。带点又快又硬的东西来。

column1: We bargained with The Muscle to let his best men slip through. However, we still have to face his expendable units with black market specialists. Expect unconventional forces geared for advanced warfare. This is going to be very dangerous even if they're amateurs.
column2: 我们跟“肌肉”谈好了，放他最精锐的手下通过。但剩下的炮灰配上黑市专家还是得我们对付。预计会遇到为高端战事打造的非正规部队。就算他们是业余的，这一仗也会非常危险。

column1: We found the beacon, now we got to pick it up.
column2: 我们找到信标了，现在得去把它取回来。

column1: We have a small, disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.  We need it and are preparing to reactivate it.\n\r\nWe'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in.  We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
column2: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}偏远地带有一处废弃小基地。我们需要它，正准备重新启用。\n\r\n我们想雇你侦察该设施并坚守到我们的部队进驻。半天内会有一支小队与你会合，24 小时内会有后勤团队到达。

column1: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们有个极其离奇的委托给你。我们在下面那颗星球上有一处生产设施，也知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直在周边侦察。我们料到他们会动手，但没料到他们会……事先通知我们？据说他们雇的佣兵主动联系我们，告知了进攻时间，理由是——原话——\"职业操守\"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。[警告：僵尸]

column1: We have to defend this warehouse, our real payment is inside. The rookie pirates left behind are coming for us, but they'll still be riding in high end gear. We're making a big spectacle for the Planetary Government's forces, so take it seriously.
column2: 我们必须守住这座仓库，我们真正的报酬就在里面。留守的海盗新手正冲我们而来，但他们装备依然是高档货。我们正在为行星政府的部队上演一场大戏，所以认真对待。

column1: We need to catch and eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. Intercepted radio chatter suggests the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. Maybe this time it will be for real. Make sure all convoy vehicles are destroyed, there is also a bonus for any escorts we take out.
column2: 我们要截住并消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队。截获的无线电显示，这支车队运的是武器，其中至少有一套完好的星际联盟时代武器系统。也许这次是真的。确保摧毁所有车队车辆，干掉护送部队也有额外奖金。

column1: We need to keep moving on this one. Looks like the Raider presence is thick.
column2: 这次我们得一路推进。看来袭击者的兵力很密集。

column1: We need to pick up a specialized pilot for the next mission. They were separated from us and the IE and they're mission critical to this operation. I'm sure this will pay off.
column2: 我们需要为下一个任务接一位专业飞行员。他们与我们和 IE 失散了，对这次行动至关重要。我相信这会有回报。

column1: We should expect resistance, but no one is paying us to shoot up the place. We're here for our person. A quick in and out is an option.
column2: 预计会遇到抵抗，但没人花钱请我们把这地方打成筛子。我们是来救人的。速战速决也是一个选择。

column1: We're going to finish the criminal element on Tiverton. The Muscle is your primary target and there's a bonus if you take out his goons. These guys are the enforcers used to keep Black Market systems in line. Expect them to be decked out in the best gear available.
column2: 我们要终结蒂弗顿的犯罪势力。“肌肉”是首要目标，干掉他的手下有额外奖金。这些人是维持黑市体系运转的打手。预计他们会装备最好的家伙。

column1: We're putting on a show and getting something special in return, so we'll be expected to take the brunt of the attack until reinforcements arrive on site.
column2: 我们在演一场戏，也能换来点特别的东西，所以在援军抵达前，预计要顶住主要攻势。

column1: We've been having troubles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} for months now, and our negotiations with them have been stalled by a stubborn {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} diplomat. If he were removed from the equation, through a random attack by \"bandits\" for instance, we might be able to make some headway.[WARNING: Zombies]
column2: 我们跟{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}已经纠葛好几个月了，与他们谈判一直卡在一位顽固的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}外交官身上。要是他消失了——比如被\"土匪\"随机袭击——我们或许能有所突破。[警告：僵尸]

column1: We've marked a data store as an optional objective, may as well see if they have any intel we can sell.
column2: 我们把一处数据存储点标记为可选目标，不妨去看看有没有能卖的情报。

column1: We've tracked our missing personnel. They're being held in a facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Go get them. Make a show of force, commandeer a transport and escort them to a pickup point.
column2: 我们追踪到了失踪人员。他们被关在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处设施里。去把人救出来。展示武力，征用一辆运输车，护送他们到接应点。

column1: Welcome to the Solaris Seasonal Assault 'Mech Championship, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! In case you're unfamiliar, this is a standard 64-bracket single elimination tournament. Defeat each opponent to move further up the rankings for fame, fortune, glory, and fame! Just be warned that if you lose a match, you're out. We don't faff around with losers bracket nonsense here.\n\nFor your first match, it looks like we have you penned in with some fellow newcomers in the Tennesee Valley arena. Break a leg!
column2: 欢迎来到索拉里斯赛季突击机甲冠军赛，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官！如果你还不了解，这是标准的 64 强单败淘汰赛。击败每位对手，一路攀升排名，赢得名声、财富、荣耀，还有名声！只是提醒你，输一场就出局。我们这儿不搞败者组那套废话。\n\n你的首场比赛，看来把你和几位新面孔一起安排在了田纳西谷竞技场。祝你好运！

column1:
Your company is tasked with protecting two communications relay support stations.  These installations form a single communications network; if either station is destroyed, the entire regional communications grid will collapse.

{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are expected to sabotage teams and strike exploiting weak points of the defenses.

{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} has designated both sites as irreplaceable strategic assets.The contract will be considered failed if either relay station is rendered inoperable.
column2:
你的部队奉命保护两座通讯中继支援站。这些设施组成一张统一的通讯网络；任何一座被毁，整个区域通讯网都会崩溃。

预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会派出破坏小组，专攻防御薄弱点。

{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}已将两处站点列为不可替代的战略资产。任何一座中继站瘫痪，合约即视为失败。

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence reports a massive {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force advancing on several recently captured bases following their successful occupation. They'll almost certainly attempt to reclaim --- or even destroy --- the sites. The main {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have already reached the neutral zone and are doubling back, but they won't make it in time to stop the initial assault. We've been hired to engage the enemy and delay their attack long enough for the main forces to return. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat! A mighty host of foes advances upon the captured fortresses, intent on ruin. The main army hastens, but shall not reach the walls ere the first clash. We are charged to hold and harry the enemy, that the returning force may smite them in full strength.
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报显示，一支庞大的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正朝几处刚被成功占领的基地推进。他们几乎肯定会试图夺回——甚至摧毁——这些站点。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}主力已抵达中立区并正在折返，但赶不上阻止首轮进攻。 我们受雇接敌并拖延他们的攻势，为主力回防争取时间。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！ 一支敌军大队正扑向被夺的堡垒，意在毁灭。 主力正加速回援， 却赶不及在首轮交锋前抵达城墙。 我们奉命坚守并袭扰敌军， 好让回师的部队以全力痛击他们。

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s area in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} just got hit with a surprise attack, and right now, the only thing standing in the way is a single lance. Our main forces are too far out to help in time, so we're calling on anyone willing to step up and lend a hand.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的区域刚遭到突袭，眼下挡在路上的只有一支小队。我们的主力太远，来不及救援，所以我们向所有愿意挺身而出的人求援。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has been pulling back their forces in large numbers after taking heavy casualties. The last remaining bases are being kept online as a decoy, so the bulk of their troops are retreating without being attacked. Our task is to create a diversion, with no reinforcements coming from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s. Be advised that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} are sending a massive force, we're on our own here; save for some stationary turrets. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在遭受重创后正大规模撤军。仅存的基地被留着当诱饵，好让他们的大部队能不受攻击地撤退。我们的任务是制造牵制，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}方面不会有援军。 请注意，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正派来一支庞大的部队，这里只能靠我们自己——除了一些固定的炮塔。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1:
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has contracted us to defend their fort, a munitions depot and BattleMech refit yard positioned in a strategically vital but undisclosed theater.  The installation serves as a critical logistics hub for its' operations, stockpiling advanced weapon systems and replacement parts for frontline units.

Intelligence confirms that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned  strike force is en route, intent on seizing or destroying the facility before a major {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} offensive can be launched.

Your orders are to hold the installation, repel all enemy forces in open combat, and ensure the fort remains fully operational.
column2:
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}雇我们防守他们的堡垒——一处弹药库兼战斗机甲改装厂，位于战略上至关重要但未公开的战区。该设施是其行动的关键后勤枢纽，储备着先进武器系统和前线部队的替换零件。

情报确认，一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}打击部队正在赶来，企图在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}发动大规模攻势前夺取或摧毁该设施。

你的命令是守住设施、在正面战斗中击退所有敌军，并确保堡垒始终保持全功能运转。

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}'s is forcing our employer back, so this is where they're making their stand. Our job is to hold the line and stall the enemy's advance until reinforcements arrive. Our employers say they've got some static defenses set up and even a volunteer militia backing us up. Stay alert and hold this position as long as possible. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}正把我们的雇主逼退，这里就是他们的立足之地。我们的任务是守住防线、拖延敌军推进直到援军抵达。雇主说他们已布置好一些固定防御，甚至还有一支志愿民兵支援我们。 保持警觉，尽可能长久地守住这个阵地。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have been pushing into this region, so there are big bounties out on them. Take out as many as you can --- the more you drop, the bigger your payout.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在向这一区域渗透，所以针对他们的赏金很高。尽可能多地消灭他们——你干掉越多，报酬越丰厚。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s incursions have been escalating, and a massive force is gathering to deliver a decisive strike and destroy all of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}'s fortifications in the area. We've been hired to slow them down, taking the brunt of the attack upfront. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s second-string units have been deployed to support us. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的入侵不断升级，一支庞大的部队正在集结，准备发动决定性打击，摧毁{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在该地区的所有防御工事。我们受雇拖慢他们的脚步，正面承受主要攻势。 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的二线部队已被派来支援我们。 纵深防御可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！

column1: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under attack --- invaders are here to take everything. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are holding but starting to break. We need every able hand on the frontline now. Any help you can offer will mean the world to us.\n\n Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
column2: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}正遭到攻击——入侵者要夺走一切。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队还在坚守，但已开始崩溃。我们现在需要每一个能上阵的人。你能提供的任何帮助，对我们都意义重大。\n\n 战区战斗可能极其漫长，做好持久作战的准备！
